dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa/pad+ma 'tshos rtsom sgrig byas/—mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
dpe skrun gsal bshad/shes ldan pad+ma ji'atshos rtsom sgrig gnang ba'i 〈dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa〉zhes pa ni rang re'i bod kyi gzhon nu rtsom pa po dgus brtsams gnang ba'i rtsom yig la dpyad gtam brjod pa zhig yin zhing / khong gis rtsom yig la dpyad gtam brjod pa ma zad rtsom pa po dgu po 'tshar long byung ba'i lo rgyus yang ngo sprod kha gsal gnang yod/ 〈dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa 〉zhes pa klog rjes deng rabs bod kyi rtsom yig gi skyon yon dang /snying stobs/ dmigs bya bcas gsal po shes thub pa ma zad/ bod rigs kyi 'tsho ba skyel stangs dang / bod gangs can gyi rig gnas kyi khyad chos sogs shes rtogs thub la/ bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas phyin pa'i lo rgyus thog nas bshad na'ang deng rabs rtsom rig gi skyon yon la dpyad gtam brjod pa'i deb gsar pa zhig red ces kyang bshad chogde min deb 'di'i rtsom sgrig sogs kyi bya ba'i thad 'grig min gyi cha mang tsam yod nges pas rgya che'i klog pa po lhan rgyas nas skyon sel dge spel 'a sman pa'i dgongs 'char lhug rtsol yong ba zhu rgyu dang bcas/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
dkar cha ga—rtsosngon 'gro'i gtam/ — wa wawa reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis bris/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (1)— — gcod pa don grub kyi lo rgyus mdorabe sdus/ — ༷ 9 (7)〈phyir log pa 〉zhes pa las 'das pa'i bsame gzhigs/ wa wa gcod pa don grub kyi rtsom yig bklags pa'i 'char snang / ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ri/ ༷ ༷ ca ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ (11)zlonga dang nga'i rtsom yig ༷༷ su ༷༷༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ༷༷ (19)bab chags pa'i 'phrul gyi rtse da ga'/ wa wawa dkon lo'i rtsom yig bklags pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷༷༷ ༷ (27)kho dang kho'i rmi lam/ ༷ ༷ ༷ cho ༷4 ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ (41)rig gnas 'gyur ba 'byung bzhin pa'i khrod kyi bod mi/wa wa bkra shis dpal ldan gyi brtsams sgrung bklags pa/ — ༷ (67)rang si byung ba ma'ido tsam zhu ba/ ༷༷ 'u ༷ ༷ cho lha ༷ ༷ ༷ (95)sems gting nas 'phos pa'i re 'dun/ — —wa wa sgom pa bkra shis kyi rtsom yig bklags pa/ ༷ ༷༷༷ ༷ ri (99)mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyi lo rgyus/ ༷ ༷༷༷༷༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ (111 )1
66lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉las 'phyur ba'i rlabs kyi zegs ma/wa wawa mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyi rtsom yig bklags pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (123)rang gis rang smra ba/wa wawa chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gis bris/ ༷ ༷ (132)brtse sems kyis 'khyud pa'i gangs ljongs/wa wa chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi rtsom yig bklags pa/ ༷ ༷༷༷ (139)rang gi lo rgyus/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (156)rtsom rig la 'jug pa'i myong tshor thor bu/wa wa rdo rje gcod pas bris/ ༷ ༷༷ — ༷ (167)mig gi bdud tsir 'gyur ba'i mdzes sdug gi ri mo/wa wa rdo rje gcod pa'i lhug rtsom bklags pa/ ༷ ༷ (172)dkon mchog skyabs kyi lo rgyus/ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ (181)mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i kha sang gis de ring gi tshab byed mi thub/wa wa dkon mchog skyabs kyi sgrung thung 〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du 〉bklags pa'i 'char snang / ༷ ༷ (184)khyung thar rgyal gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (196)zhib tu bklags pa las byung ba'i skyo snang/wa wa khyung thar rgyal gyi rtsom yig bklags pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (206)mjug byang / ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (219)2
sngon 'gro'i gtam/sa la dge ba bcu'i dpal gyis mngon par phyug pa'i gangs can ljongs la yun ring gi lo rgyus gzi byin lham mer 'bar ba dang /'dzam gling gi mi rigs gzhan pa rnams kyis 'gram chu dbang med du ldang ba'i rig gnas gtsug lag rgya mtsho lta bu yod pas/ bod kha khu can gyi yul ni chos lugs kyi lte ba dang / shes rig gi pha sa/ sgyu rtsal gyi 'byung gnas/ glu gar gyi rgya mtsho/ rtsom rig gi bang mdzod cig yin zhes bsngags brjod kyi rol mo sa gsum mya ngan med par 'khrol ba'ang don la gnas par sems/ji de yang mkhyen dpyod nyi ma stong phrag lhan cig brtsegs pa ltar gsal ba'i bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis dus yun ring bor chos lugs dang / mtshan nyid rig pa/ lo rgyus/ sgyu rtsal bcas kyi glegs bam glang chen bye ba phrag brgya'i rgyab khal longs pa re mdzad nas bod kyi rig gnas sngar las phun tshogs dar rgyas su 'gro ba'i rkyen du phul yod/ de min rtsom rig gi thad nas bshad na'ang bod la klog mkhan mtha' yas pa'i mig gi bdud rtsi dang / yid kyi gsos sman/ rna ba'i bcud len du 'gyur pa'i snyan rtsom mang du rmachis te/1
dper na bod mi rigs kyi rirnam dpyod rig pa'i 'phrul las legs par 'khrungs pa'i 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bod mi rigs la nyag phran mda' las drang ba'i gzhung rgyud dang /g.yang dkar bal las 'jam pa'i gshis rgyud/ zla ba'i 'od las dkar ba'i lhag bsam/ nyam thag zhabs nas skyor ba'i snying rje bcas lhan skyes su yod cing / de ni gdod ma nyid nas ya rabs kyi lugs su 'jug par bskul ba'i snyan ngag gi brjod bya zhig yin pas/ kun gyi rna bar snyan zhing yid dbang gi brtan pa rang dbang med par 'phrog pa'i 〈mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba 〉 dang / 〈 rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod 〉/〈sa skya legs bshad 〉/ 〈gzhon nu zla med 〉/ 〈slob gnyer bslab bya〉/ 〈mi la ras pa'i mgur〉/ 〈skal ldan mgur ma 〉/ 〈rgyal po sprin gyi bzhon pa 〉sogs tshig don gnyis bar snyan ngag gi nyams rtsol med du thon pa'i mgur dang / legs bshad/ bslab bya/ sgrung gtam/ snyan ngag rtogs brjod/ zlos gar gyi bstan bcos/gtam rgyud bcas rtsom pa po'i snyan rtsom sa chen rdul gyi grangs la 'gran nus pa zhig mdzad yod/ de yang bod kyi rtsom rig la bskal ba ya thog gi rtsom rig dang / gna' rabs kyi rtsom rig nyi rabs kyi rtsom rigdeng rabs kyi rtsom rig bcas khag bzhir dbye bar 'os shing /gnya' khri btsan po'i yar sngon gyi bod kyi rtsom rig la bskal ba ya thog gi rtsom rig dang / gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal khab sil bur thor ba'i bar gyi bod kyi rtsom rig la gna' rabs kyi rtsom rig rgyal khab sil 2
bur thor nas dga' ldan pho brang gi bar gyi bod kyi rtsom rig la nye rabs kyi rtsom rig dga' ldan pho brang gi man nas da lta'i bar gyi bod kyi rtsom rig la deng rabs kyi rtsom rig zer ba dang / dus skabs so po'i rtsom rig la'ang phyi'i rnam pa dang nang gi brjod don gnyis kyi thad khyad par chen po yod/ de dag gi khyad par gang dang gang zhig yin pa shes par 'dod pa rnams kyis dus skabs so po'i rtsom rig la thugs rab tu snyoms pa dang / gzu bor gnas pa/ phyogs su ma lhung ba bcas kyi sgo nas zhib 'jug byed dgos te/ ma'o tse tung gi zhal nas/ brtag dpyad zhib 'jug ma byas na gtam bshad pa'i dbang cha med ces gsungs pa lta bu zhig yin pa'i phyir/ nye sngon rtsom rig gzhung lugs la nges shes 'drongs shing / rtsom yig gi legs nyes dpyad pa'i rnam dpyod ldan pa dang / rtsom yig gi skyon yon brjod pa'i yon tan mnga' ba'i shes ldan pad+ma 'tsho yis deng rabs bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po du ma zhig gi blo gros kyi rtsal las nye bar 'khrungs pa'i snyan rtsom rnams la phra zhib rig pas —zhib tu brtags te skyon yon brjod pa'i don ldan gyi dpe deb 〈 dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa 〉zhes pa btsams nas bod kha ba can gyi klog mkhan yod do cog gi 'dren byed zung gi dpyid du spel bas/ de ni bod 4kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas phyin pa'i lo rgyus la cha mtshon nas bshad na deng rabs snyan rtsom gyi skyon yon brjod pa'i thachod kyi dpe debatshogasar pa zhig yin/ dpe deb 'di ni bod kyi rtsom rig gi deng 4rabs kyi snying stobs shes byed kyi 'phar rtsa 4dang / bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi skyon yon 3
shes byed kyi 'phar rtsa/ rtsom mkhan dang bod 'bangs dag gi deng rabs kyi dmigs bya shes byed kyi 'phar rtsa zhig yin pas/ dpe deb 'di'i nang du dga' skyo 'dres ma'i 'chi ma 'khyil zhing / dpe deb 'di'i nang du skyid sdug 'dres ma'i rnam thar 'khod pa dang / dpe deb 'di'i nang du skyon yon gnyis kyi khyad par rgosal bas/ rtsom rig la don gnyer che ba'i blo gsal rnams kyis dpe deb 'di gces su bzung nas bklags na mjug mthar 'bral bar mi bzod pa'i grogs su 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o/ /bod ni snyan ngag gi mi rigs shig ste/ de'i rtsom rig kyang snyan ngag gi rtsom rig cig yin pas/ nga tshos snyan rtsom 'di bklags na bod mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang don dang bod gangs can gyi rig gnas kyi khyade chos sogs gsal zhing yang dag par shes thub/spyir lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i dus su bod kyi dus skabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig gi nyi gzhon thog mar rnam dpyod kyi skya rengs shing rtas nye bar drangs shing / skabs de'i rtsom rig phal mo che zhig ni yab mes dag gi shul bzhag rig gnas kyi rgyun legs par bskyangs par rgya dang phyi gling ba'i rtsom thabs kyis zur brgyan pa sha stag yin pas/ bklags na kha la bde ba dang / nyan na rna bar snyan pa/ bltas na yid du 'ong ba'i tshig gi phreng ba dang / bsams na chu gter chen po las gting zab pa zhig yin/ don ldan gyi snyan rtsom de dag ni bod kyi phyi rabs pa rnams rtsom pa'i phyogs su 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ la rgya'i ngar shugs ldud pa'i sbyin bdag rig pa'i gnas la slob pa'i skul lcag tu gyur yod/4
de'i rjes su rtsom mkhan gsar bu skor zhig bod kyi rtsom rig gi pad tshal skyong ba'i bdagayor 'byor ba na/ yab mes kyi shul bzhag rig gnas mtha' dag dug rdzas su brtsis te rgya dang phyi gling gi rtsom yig mthong tshad bod skad du bsgyur rjes rang nyid kyis bris khul byas nas dus deb tu bkod pa dang / tshig sbyor rnamasakyang sum rtags dag gsum gyi dgongs pa dang 'gal ba ltag sprod du gyur pa zhig yin/ de'i mthar thug gi dmigs yul ni bod kyi yab mes kyi shul bzhag rig gnas rnams mig gi rdul bzhin spangs shing / rgya dang phyi gling gi rig gnas dang goms srol bod du drangs nas bod kyi rig gnas dang goms srol gyi tsha ba byed du 'jug rgyu de red/ bod 'di ming gi lhag ma tsam du byed par 'dod pa'i mi de'i rigs la ngo tsha ci yangasad par da dung bod mi rigs kyi la rgya dang / bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas/ bod me rigs kyi brtse dung sogs kha la mi shetshong bar brjod pa ni wa mos sha rdog 'khyer ba'i khu ta la ngo bstod byed pa dang chos mtshungs shig / de rnams kyi gtam spyod la bltas na dngos gnas snying rul klad stong dang /— de dag gi bshad pa 56ri skyag gzan gyi stong gta ma sha stag yin pa rtogs thub pas/ mi jirigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa zhig yigan/ cad gzod 'dzam gling la ris med du brin pa yin zhes pa'i gtam de snying gi thig ler bzung nas legs nyes blang dor dang / nayin len gnod dor/ snyigs dor bcud len/ rdzun spangs bdesaganyer bca sa byed pa'i thad la bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis gtong rgyu ni gal bo che la nan tan byed dgos 5
pa zhig yin/lo rabs brgyad cu ba ste bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed byas pa'i bgrang bya bcu phrag zung gi ring la/ bod kyi rtsom rig ni brlan dang 'phrad pa'i ljon shing ji bzhin dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa dang snyan ngag gi rgyu skar/sgrung gtam gyi nyi ma/ lhug rtso ma gyi zla ba bcas kyis bod kyi rtsom rig gi nam mkha' mdzes par byag na yang / rtsom pa po re re'i rtsom yig la zhib dpyad chu thub dang rags dpyad go thob gang rung gi sgo nas skyon yon brjod pa ni bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di na mang po zhig med pas/bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed byas pa'i lo ngo nyi shu'i ring gi bod kyi snyan rtsom gyi brjod bya'i don dang / rjod byed kyi tshig sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos sogs ji lta bu zhig yin pa shes par 'dod na 〈dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb 'dir gzigs tshe bod kyi dus skabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig gi khyad chos rags bsdus shig rtogs thub pas na/ de ni shes par 'dod pa rnams la dpag bsam gyi ljon pa lta bu dang / dpyong par 'dod pa rnams la gnas lugs kyi rgya mtsho lta bu/ slob par 'dod pa rnams la man ngag gi nor bu lta bu/ gzigs par 'dod pa rnams la dwangs shel gyi me long lta bu zhig yin no/ /reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis/1998lo'i zla 6tshes 1nyin pe cin nas bris/—46
gcod pa don grub kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/rtsom pa po gcod pa don grub ni/ rang lo drug bdun lon pa nas bzung chab cha zhang rgya ra'i slob chung dang gdum pa zhang ra gong ma'i slob chung gnyi sa su zhugs te rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi btsugs/chig stong dgu brgya re bzhi'i ngalor kho rang mtsho lho khul dge 'os slob grwar zhugs te bod yig dang rgya yig la sbyangs pa gang legs byas/chig stong dgu brgya cabadun cu tham pa lor mtsho nyo dge 'os slob grwa las ma/thar phyin te gung ho rdzong du lo lnga drug tsayol dge rgan gyilas 'gan khur nas 'brog khul gyi mi rabs rjes ma skyed sring byed pa'i thad la sgrub 'os pa'i bya ba bsgrubs/tshig stong dgu brgya don bdun lor kho mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mor zhugs/ slob grwa'i neng du slob dpon skad grags can a lags shar gdong dang rdo rgyal sku lo/ dpa' ris blo gros snang ba sogs la bsten te brda sprod rig pa dang snyan ngag tsom rig lo rgyus/7
gna' rtsom/ rgya bod yig bsgyur dang bcas par lhod med sdug rus kyis sbyangs te slob 'bras cung legs po blangs pas gsum bzang slob ma'i mtshan snyan yang thengs 'gar thob myong / chig stong dgu brgya gya gnyis lor mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo las mthar phyin rjes rtsa 'dzugs kyi las bgos ltar du slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gyi las 'gan khur zhing phyis su bya ba'i dgos mkho'i dbang gis phyir mtsho lho khul gung ho rdzong du song ste snga gzhug tu rdzong rig slob kho yi kho krang gzhon pa dang gung ho rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi rdzong dpon gzhon pa'i las 'gan khur nas lo lnga drug tsam la bya ba bsgrubs/tshig stong dgu brgya gya drug lor bya ba'i dgos mkho ltar du kho las gnas spar te mtsho sngon zhing chen gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung zhib 'jug khang du yong ba dang / da lta mtsho sngon zhing chen rig gnas sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung zhib 'jug 4khang gi su'o krang gi 'gan 'khur yod cing /krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom pa po'i tshogasas pa'i rgyun las las 'dzin pa dang krung go'i rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs mtsho sngon yan lag mthun tshogs kyi tshogs mi bcas yin/ zhib 'jug pa gzhon pa'i thob thang thob yod/lo bcu phrag gcig lhag 'das pa'i sngon te chig stong dgu brgya gya gnyis lo nas bzung khos gsar rtsom gyi las la 'bad pa byas te/ tsho thog mar gsar 'gyur mang po zhig 〈 mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur 〉steng 8
du bkod/ de nas bzung ste snga gzhug tu 〈bod ljongs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉dang / 〈 zang char 〉〈 mang tshogs sgyu rtsal 〉/ 〈 rtser snyeg〉/〈mtsho sngon slob gso〉/ 〈 zla zer〉 bcas kyi dus deb steng du sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag tshig lhug klu tshig dmangs sgrung sogs bsdoms pa'i rtsom yig mi gcig pa drug cu lhag phud pa dang / tshig stong ngagu brgya gya gcig lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis kho dang dge rgan dpa' ris blo gros snang ba gnyis kyis sdud sgrig byas pa'i deb chung 〈bod kyi gab tshig phyogs bsgrigs 〉zhes pa de dpar skrun byas shi nga / chig stong dgu brgya rgya brgyad dang gya dgu calor khos dag sgrig dang rtsom sgrig byas pa'i gling —sgrung 〈 'dan ma'i nas rdzong 〉 dang /〈 bsdu sa sgrung rab snyan dre za'i pi wang 〉/ 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i shul rten gyi ngag rgyun ngo mtshar me tog phreng mdzes〉dmangs khrod kyi rtsom rig phyogs bsgrigs te 〈 mdo smad yul gyi ngag rtsom pad+ma'i chun po 〉sogs dngos su dpar skrun byas/ gcig dgu dgu bcu tham pa lor khos dag sgrig byas pa'i gling sgrung 〈khyung tsha spun lnga〉dang gsar rtsom 〈snying gtam shel dkar me long 〉zhes pa de dpar skrun gnang ste klog pa po rnams dang mjal thub par gyur/ gcig dgu go gsum lor 〈 brtse dung gi mig chu 〉zhes pa si khron zhing chen nas dpar skrun byas/ gong du gleng pa'i rtsom yig de dag las 〈sras mo zla bzang ma 〉dang / 〈bde skyed kyi klu dbyangs〉/ 〈 mdo smad yul gyi ngag rtsom pad ma'i chun po〉/〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra 〉sogs la snga gzhug tu mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi 9
phul byung rtsom rig gi bya dga' thob myong / 〈snying gtam shel dkar me long 〉zhes pa 'dir go gsum lor rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig phul byung can gyi bya dga' thob/zhib 'jug gi thad du/ snga gzhug tu 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉dang 〈krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉〈rtser snyeg〉sogs dus deb steng du 〈snyan ngag me long gi gal chen rang bzhin brjod pa 〉dang / 〈gling rje ge sar sgrung gi rjod byed tshig gi khyad chos la dpyad pa〉/ 〈sgrung pa grags can tshe ring dbang 'dus〉/ 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i skyes rabs lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa〉bcas dpyad rtsom nyi shu lhag bkod cing /go gsum lor rgyal yongs kyi spyi tshogs tshan rig zhib 'jug las tshan nang bkod pa'i 〈ge sar sgrung la dpyad pa mun gsal sgron me〉zhes pa bris grub ste rang zhing gi mi rigs dpe skrun khang la sprad zin/ rgyal spyi'i 〈ge sar sgrung 〉rig gzhung gros tshogs su thengs gsum la zhugs myong zhing /gzhan yang khong gi ming 〈 klung go'i na gzhon rtsom pa po grags can gyi ming mdzod〉dang 〈krung go'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal pa'i rnam thar〉bcas kyi nang du bkod yod/10
〈 phyir log pa 〉zhes pa las 'das pa'i bsam gzhigs /gcod pa don grub kyi rtsom yig bklags po'i 'char snang /rtsom pa po gcod pa don grub ces pa'i ming thos pa'i mod la klog pa po rnams kyi sems la dpa' bo'i snyan rtsom ring mo 〈ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉bsdu sgrig gi bya ba lhang nger dran nges pa dang / gya brgyad lo nas jibzung gcod pa don grub ni ge sar sgrung bsdu sgrig dang zhib 'jug gi dpung khag tu zhugs shing lo du ma'i nang grub 'bras kyang g.yur du za ba thob/ kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar 〈ge sar sgrung 〉ni bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig bang mdzod nang gi gzi 'odang 'bar ba'i rin chen nor bu zhig yin la bod kyi gna' bo'i spyi tshogs mtshon byed kyi me long zhig kyang yin pas/ de bsdu sgrig dang zhib 'jug byed pa ni bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel bya ba'i mdzad gzhi zhig yin la bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la gdeng tshod gnang ba zhig kyang yin/ khyad par du dus rabs nyer gcig pa la slebs bzhin pa'i dus skabs 'dir/11
bod rkya rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkhos bod kyi rtsom pa po rnams kyi phrag par ba'ag pa'i 'os 'gan ni srol rgyun rtsom rig gi snying bcud gzhib ste rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi shes rig gi lus stobs rgyas par byed rgyu de yin pa dang / der yang srol rgyun rtsom rig ni rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi brtsams chos kyi lha mo bzhugs pa'i gdan du legs par btings te/da yod bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rmang gzhi'i steng du rnam pa gsar ba'i rtsom rig gi glegs bam gsar ba spel ba dang / srol rgyun rtsom rig las lhag pa'i bsam gzhigs gsar ba gtod dgos pa de'o/ /gcod pa don grub kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed pa'i brgyud rim la phyir mig gis bltas na klog pa po rnams kyi yid la kho'i brtsams sgrung 〈pha yul du log pa 〉zhes pa de 'char nges pa dang / brtsams sgrung 'di ni kho'i brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom gyi 'thus tshab tu brjod chog pa zhig yin te/ brtsams chos 'di'i nang rtsom pa pos dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom stangs spyad nas dmigs bsal gyi khor yug nang dmigs bsal gyi mi sna gson nyams ldan pa gsar bzhengs byas yod/ de yang lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i 'go tsam la rig gnas gsar brje'i mun skal mjug rdzogs shing bya ba thams cad lam du 'gro ba'i 'go brtsams pa dang /bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed kyi gom pa spo 'go tshugs pa dang mnyam du 'khol ba'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs 'og tu/ bod kyi sa char byung ba'i don rkyen dag rtsom pa po'i blo ngor 'gog med du 'char bas gsar byung gi brjod bya 'di rtsom gzhi'i mdza' mor bkugs te yid kyi skyid sdug dga' sdang 12
rnams brtsams chos lasagagasal par mtshon/ skabs —der mtshoman na brjod bya 'di ni gsar ba zhig yin la bod kyi zhing 'brog mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba dang bsam blo mtshon thub pa zhig kyang yin/ brtsams sgrung gi mi sna gtso bo ni phyir pha yul du log pa'i slo nga 〉〉 dang chung 'dris grogs po lha 'bum yin la/ rtsom pa pos mi sna'i gzugs brnyan gsar bzhengs dang bsam blo'i dran rtogs zhib 'bri byas nas rig 4/nas gsar brje'i skabs su byung ba'i don rkyen rnams phyir dran pa dang /bod kyi 'brog mi dag gis sduge myangs pa'i rnam pa bcas mtshar sdug ri mo ji bzhin gson — nyams ldan par yid kyi me long du mngon sum du 'char thub pa lta bu byas pa ste/ dper na/ mi sna gtso bo slong 99brtse )spra rdzu dīX) bzlod nga (ba spri pache shā sprihā parnyi lja ldar+sha ༈rdzo ༷la sbyang gh+nā hūm̐ ༵ dang / snyan dbang gso ba'i lug dzi'i snyan 'jibs kyi klu dbyangs/| ṣ+ṭṛ myu wa wa miX ṭ+wāṃ snye khro spri ༷/ ||/ rmeX/ dhī ༷ snye khro yang mthong zhing thos pas phyir log pa'i yong 99yi yid kyi mtsho mo pha yul gyi rnam pa gsar ba'i rlung gis bskyod pas dga' spro yi rlabs phreng rnam par 'phyur ba dang / gzhan du brtsams chos kyi mi sna gtso bo 64nga 99dang nga'i a khu gnyis kha brda'am gleng mol byas pa brgyud nasarig gnas 13
gsar brje'i lo bcu'i ring la bod kyi sa char yang spyi tshogasas kyi 'du long che ba dang mi'i rang bzhin 'khyog bsgyur bhas pas bzang ngan legs nyes dge sdig thams cad go ldog par gyur pa gzugs can bzhin du mtshon pa dang / bod kyi rong 'brog mi dmangs kyis bde skyid la mos pa'i 'dun pa dang bod mi rigs kyi bla na mtho ba'i dge sgrub kyi rang gshis kyang gsal ler mtshon yod/ rtsom pa pos bod mi'i rang bzhin steng du gnas pa'i drang bden dang / dge bzang / byams snying rje sogs la bstod pa dang dus mtshungs su rig gnas gsar brjes grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sa khul du gtor brlag byas pa'i gnod nyes rnams ther 'don byas yod pas/ spyir btang du brjod gzhi 'di dag brtsams chos su 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig bkod pas lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan la sgyu rtsal gyi bogs kyang thon yod/ brtsams chos 'di'i brjod bya skabs der mtshon na gsar ba yin pas klog pa po'i yid 'phrog cing sems bkugs pa dang / rtsom pa po khong rang nyid la mtshon na'ang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi sgyu rtsal steng gi 'pho 'gyur zhig kyang red/ yid phangs pa zhig la rtsom pa po de'i rjes su brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom gyi 'phro ma 'thud par lha sgrung dang rab rtog gi sgrung sogs dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi phyogs la snyug kha bskor pa dang dus mtshungs su tshigs bcad snyan ngag dang lhug rtsom bcas kyang mang du brtsams pas/ de'i phyogs su klog pa po rnams la bag chags zab mo bzhag kyang kho'i brtsams sgrung la dga' ba dag gi sems khong du chud par byas so/ /14
spyir rab rtog gi sgrung ni bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig giri grub cha gtso bo zhig yin la/ de'i gson nyams ldan zhing mi'i yid dbang 'gugs pa'i gtam rgyud kyi byung rim dang /9 ltabs bde zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam pa/ rjod byed tshig bsdus shing bde la brjod bya'i don zab cing gsal pa'i khyad chos bcas kyis mi rnams la slob gso thebs su 'jug —pas don snying lhag par ldan pa dang / kho'i rab rtog gi sgrung 〈 rin chen sgo nga 〉zhes pa de'ang mi'i phasam blor skul ma gtong ba'i bslab bya bzang po zhig yin te/ mi sna gtso bo blo gros kyi 'jam zhing zhi ba'i kun spyod dang drang zhing bden pa'i gshis rgyud/ dkar bo dge chos la rab tu spro ba'i bsam pa bcas ni rang gi khe phan kho nar bsam pa dang g.yo sgyu khram gsum 'dzoms pa'i ham 'dod can zhig dang bsdur pas so so'i gzugs brnyen mngon sum du 'char te/ bzang ngan legs nyes rgyadang dge sdig thams cad kyang mngon gsal dod par gyur pas bstod smad kyi yul kyang mi'i yid la lhang nge bar gyur to/ / rtsom hril bor rab rtog gi rgyan bkod pas mngon pa'i dpe ni srog chags yin la shugs kyi don ni drin chen la drin lan 'jal dgos pa dang las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam smin ni bzlog thabs med pa'i gnas lugs brjod pas/mi rnams la 64bya ba gang zhig zhib mo'i blos/ brtags te rtsom mam mi brtsam bya/〉〉zhes pa'i ba4slab bya'ang btang ngo / /gal te 〈 pha yul du log pa〉dang 〈 rin chen sgo nga 〉las bod mi rigs kyi drang bden gyi gshis rgyud dang dge sgrub sdig spong gi bsam blo 15
la bstod bsngags phul yod zer na/ kho'i lhug rtsom 〈 mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra 〉zhes pa las rtsom pa pos mi thams cad kyi snang med rtogs med kyi yul du bskyur tshoba'i mnyen 'jam rtsa phran dper drangs nas ngag gi phreng ba spel bsi de las kyang bla med kyi rang bzhin brjod yod pa ste/yod tshad gzhan du sbyin par phangs med pa'i/ / rtsa yi rang tshul la 'gran 'brog dmangs kyi/ / gzhan phan snying rus bskyed pa'i mtsho mo'i mtha'/ /nyin lam stong gis bgrod kyang gzhal nus min/ /zhes rab rtog dang bcas pa'i rgyan gos kyis rtsom gyi bu mo rnam par spras pas/bod mi rigs kyi brtan zhi nga 'gyur ba med pa'i gsar gtod kyi snying stobs dang gzhan phan gtong phod kyi bsam pa sogs la bstod bsngags byas/ brtsams chos 'di'i nang du rtsom pa pos rang nyid rjod byed tshig rgyan sogs la lhag tu mkhas pa'i khyad chos btod yod kyang brjod bya'i don zab pa'i gnas lugs mtshon pas dngos yod kyi don snying ldan pa dang / gal te nga tsho bod kyi rtsom pa po rnams kyis rang rigs kyi gsar gtod kyi snying stobs dang brtson pa'i rta pho 'dir legs par bcibs te phun sum tshogs pa'i spyi tshos/sa 'tsho bar brtag dpyad byas nas srog gi bcud dang ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos mang du spel te bod kyi rtsom rig sga sdum rar 'gengs nga ra bya ba dang / bod kyi rtsom rig la phyir mig lta phod pa'am bsam gzhis gtong thub pa zhig byung na bod gyi rtsom rig gi dbyar mtsho rang sngom las rgyas pa zhig 'byung srid pa ni smos ma dgos la/ mjes sdug ldan pa'i gangs ljongs kyi yul gru 'di'ang de yi 16
rba rlabs kyi zegs ma dgod sa'i gnas mchog tu 'gyur thub nges red/kho'i brtsams chos re re sna rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi 'gro lam du mdun nas mdun du bskyod jipa'i rkang rjes re re yin pas/ gcod pa don grub la rtsom pa'i 'bras bu legs tsam thob yod ces brjod chog pa ste/ dper na/ 〈sras mo zla bzang ma 〉dang / 〈snying gtam shel dkar me long 〉/ 〈 mnyen 'jam rtsa'i glu sgra'i/ 〈 bde skyid kyi glu dbyangs 〉/ 〈 a mdo dmangs khrod gtam rgyud phyogs bsgrigs 〉sogs mang du yod par ma zad/ kurang sems skul ba'i rol mo〉dang /〈stag tshang thang 〉/ 〈brtse dung gi mig chu〉lta bu bslab bya'i rin thang dang ldan pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo'ang yod/ yin na yang / de dag ni srol rgyun gyi bkag rgya dang bslab bya'i rnam pa las ma 'das pas/ klog pa po'i yid la bag chags de 'dra'i zab mo 'jog ma thub/ 'on kyang sgrung gtam 〈pha yul du log pa 〉las nga tshos kho'i sems kyi dran tshul dang /khog gi brtse sems/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi blo gros dang sgyu rtsal bcas tog tsam rtogs thub pas de'i phyogs su yid ches bcangs yod pa dang /ga' te rtsom pa pos rang gi rnam dpyod kyi sgo mo yangs su phye zhing nyams myong gi dri bzhon rab tu bskyod pa dang sbrags/ gsar rtsom gru gzings rtsokyi kha lo mdun du bsgyur pa dang / kho la slar yang sgrung gtam gsar 17
rtsom gyi gral du zhugs par rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig yod pa'i khar/ sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom yang ldab 'gyur gyis 'phel rgyas 'gro zhing / klog pa po rnams la'ang 〈 pha yul du log pa〉las mngon par mtho ba'i 'char snang dang myong tshor zhig stsol ba smos ma dgos so/ /18
nga dang nga'i rtsom yignga'i ming la dkon lo'am ming gzhan la dkon mchog sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho zer zhing / skyes yul ni bsang klung sngon mo dal gyis 'bab pa'i nye 'gram du chags pa'i klu grags zhes 'bod pa'i sde ba de yin/nga rang chung chung byis pa'i dus nas bzung yi ge sbyangs par shin tu mos pas/ lo dgu'i steng pha rgan gyis bsang chu rdzong bod dmangs slob chung du bskyal te bod rgya zung gi yi ge la thog mar bag chags 'jog pa'i skal ba ldan/ yin rina'ang nga rang slob chung de las kyang thon dbang ma phyin par rgyal yongs kyi yul gru kun tu rig gnas shes bya mkho med smra ba'i rlung ngan zhig rgyu ba'i rkyen ngan des nga la rig gnas sbyong rgyu'i las skal ldan du ma bcug par re zhig rang sder song nas ngal rtsol gyi las la zhugs dgos byung /dus der nga rang lo na bcu bzhi yin/ ngal rtsol de 'dra ma byas stabs dang thoge nga'i lus stod gzer ba dang rkang lag na ba sogs kyi sdus/ mi nyung ba zhig myangs/ yin na yang / skabs der nga'i sems la 19
ngal rtsol gyi zhor la rang gis bod yig cig sbyangs thub na 'phro phyin chad phan thogs yod srid nges snyam ste/ nam rgyun dkar gsal sgron me'i 'og tu bung ba sprang rtsir sred pa ltar sgrung dpe dang rnam thar gyi dpe cha sna tshogs la sun snang med par bltas shing / dpe cha'i nang du dka' gnad re la 'phrad tshe rgyun par sde ba'i nang gi a khu yon tan can dag la dris te rang sbyong byas/spyir sbyong bar 'dod pa'i shes bya gang zhig yin rung gal srid rang nyid de la ldab 'gyur gyis spro ba skyes tshe nam yang de'i rtsa ba'i shes bya gsal bor rtogs thub/ gnas lugs de ni phal cher dri ma med pa'i legs bshad cig yin pa 'dra/ lo ngo gsum tsam gyi ring la dngos sbyong gi shes bya dag la nan tan gyis sbyang brtson lhod med byas mthar/ ngas lo gsar dang yang na shing slong gi skabs su sos dal dus sde ba'i mi tshor rnam thar dang gtam rgyud bshad thub song /tshig dgu don lnga lo ste nga rang lo na bco brgyad lon pa'i lo der/slob grwa chen mo'i rgyugs gzhi rnams cung zad sla bas ngas bde blag gi ngang nas nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor rgyugs 'phrod song bas/nga rang dga' nas zhag kha shas la gnyid ma khug rgyu mtshan ni rig gnas sbyong rgyu'i 'dun pa des nga'i yid du go gnas gal chen zhig zin yod pa de yin/nga rang slob grwa chen mor zhugs nas lo ngo gsum gyi slob sbyong gi dus yun nang / ngas rang gi bsam pa rgya yan du ma btang bar bslab 20
gzhi khag gi 'os 'gan legs 'grub byas rjes/ las zhor dus tshod skar gang tsam yang chud zos su ma btang bar mkhas dbang dkron mchog tshe brtan —gtso mdzad pa'i da gi rgan ming grags can du ma'i mdun du/sum rtags dag gsum dang snyan gzhung / de min rgya'i rtsom rig la sogs blo yis zhib par sbyangs te/ slob mthar phyin pa'i dus kyi tshe slob grwa'i 'go khrid pas nga rang slob grwa de gar da ge rgan la bzhag rtsis byas na'angaka nga'i semaso la 'brog phyogs su rig gnas pa mang po zhig gso sbyong bya thub na las gal chen po zhigayin par snyam ste/ 'go khrid par nga rang kun lho khul gyi rma chu'i rtswa thang du song nas dge rgan byed rgyu'i re ba bton pa na/ 'go khrid pas kyang ngadzi bsam tshul la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur mdzad nas nga rang rma chu'i rtswa tha nga bdu mngags/ lo der nga lharang pho lo nyer gcig yin/ ga 'brog phyogasakyi bod yig tshodge rgan zhig tu gyur pa ni nga rang nya mo chu la 'phrad pa dang 'dra ste/ngas nan tan gyis slob ma rnams la bodari yig slob khrid byas shing /lhag par du slob grwa ru nga la sngar las kyang dus tshod mang po zhig la dpe cha blta rgyu'i go skabs byu nga ba dang / gsar rtsom gyi 'dod mos drag po zhig gis nga la bskul b.re brten/ / theras shig la ngas rtswa thang gi yul ljongs gzhir byas pa'i kuna'abrog thang la bsngags pa lhag bsam sprin gyi sgra dbyangs 〉 zhes pa'i snyan rtsom ring po zhig bris/ cung ma 'gor bar 〈kan lho'i gsar 'gyur 〉du bkod 'dug pas/ skabs der nga rang dga' drags te gsar 'gyur de la yang yang du lta dgos byung /21
dus de nas bzung nga'i yid la rtsom yig 'phro rim 'phror 'bri 'dod kyi kun slong ni mtsho mo'i rlabs phreng bzhin du 'phyur nas bstud mar sgrung rtsom dang snyan rtsom/ lhug rtsom/ 'bol rtsom sogs rtsom yig nyi shu lhag 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉dang 〈 lha sa'i skyid chu 〉/〈bod ljongs mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉/ 〈 lho kha'i rig rtsal〉/ 〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par〉/ 〈gangs dkar ri bo〉/ 〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉/ 〈zla zer〉/ 〈 mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉/ 〈kan lho'i bod yig gsar 'gyur〉sogs dus deb dang tshags par du bkod/ ngas 'di ltar rang 'khri'i dpe khrid kyi zhor la dpe cha lta kor dang rtsom yig 'bri zhor bcas byas nas phal cher rang gi las phyi'i dus tshod yongs su btang /tshig dgu gya lnga lor bya ba'i dgos mkho'i dbang gis nga rang rdzong yig sgyur khang gi 'go 'dzin par bskos/ lo ngo gsum gyi dus yun nang du ngas sems zhib mos srid 'dzin gyi yig cha sna tshogs (yig 'bru khri tsho sum cu lhag) bod yig tu bsgyur nas sa de'i ka ngo yig ngo chod pa'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi rgyud la bag chags bsub dka' ba zhig bzhag pa dang / de'i mtshungs su ngas rgyud rim ldan pa'i sgo nas rgya'i deng rabs kyi rtsom rig la bltas nas rang gi rgyud la yon tan re 'go bar brtson pa bskyed/ skabs der ngas snga gzhug tu brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed kyi tshig sogs gang gi cha nas kyang 'bur du thon pa'i snyan rtsom dang lhug rtsom/ ched rtsom la sogs kyi rtsom yig bcu lhag bod yig tu bsgyur nas 22
kunub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i rig gzhung dus deb 〉dang 〈 gangs ljongs rig gnas〉/ 〈zlo zer〉/ 〈 mtsho sngon khrims lugs gsar 'gyur〉/ 〈 kan lho'i gsar 'gyur〉/ ku rnga ba'i gsar 'gyur〉/ 〈 dkar mdzes gsar 'gyur〉la sogs bod yig gi dus deb dang tshags par steng du bkod/chig dgu gya dgu lo'i da49da gar gong rim rtsa 'dzugs kyis nga'i 'jon thang la gzhiganas te/ nang la gan 49khulu gyi tshortsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyi 4〈 zla zer〉rtsom sgrig khang gi kru'u ren gyi 'gan dkris pa dang / ngas kyang gong rim gyi bka' ngag dang du blangs nas rtsom sgrig go bya bca phrag tu blangs/ dus der nga'i ya chung gangs dka ra sems su bod rang gi rtsom rig dar rgyas su gtong dgos na/ kha bshad tsam las mi chog par lag len dngos su bltar dgos snyam ste/mu mthud du blo sems rtse gcig gis bod rang gi rtsom gyi las dang po ba rnams skyed sring byed par rang nus gang yodo bton/ sgos su bgrang bya du ma'i ring la rang nyid kyis gsar rtsom gyi skyed mos tshal las snyan rtsom gyi me tog btus te klog pa po blo mchog dman bar gsum gyi mig gi bdud rtsir spel/ snga gzhug khu sgrung gtam lnga ba cu dang snyan rtsom brgya lhag lhug rtsom sum cu lhag snyan zhu'i rtsom yig bcu phrag cig rgyang bsgra gas kyi 'khrab gzhung dang ched rtsom brgyade lhag bsgyur rtsom nyi shu lhag bcas mdo dbus khams gsum gyi bod yig gi dus deb dang tshags par sna tshogs kyi steng du rime par bkod/ —23
gzhan yang lhug rtsom kurma chu kha yi ngang phrug〉zhing ljongs lnga'i slob grwa chen mo khag drug gi khrid gzhi ste 〈deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gces bsdus〉kyi nang du bdams/ 〈ca thang gi glag phrug〉sogs sgrung gtam drug pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bsgrigs pa'i 〈gsar bzhad me tog tshom bu〉zhes pa'i deb dang po dang gnyis pa gsum pa bcas kyi nang du bdams/ snyan rtsom 〈deng dus kyi 'brog thang 〉dang lhug rtsom 〈pha yul du 'byor ba'i bde skyid〉sogs rtsom yig bzhi deng rabs bod kyi dpe tshogs su bdams/ 〈mdzub gu lnga'i rtsod gleng 〉sogs dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud khag lnga 〈bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud 〉ces pa'i dpe cha'i nang du bdams/ bsgyur rtsom 〈rdo ring 〉sogs kyi 'khyab gzhung khag lnga so sor kun lho'i bod kyi zlos gar tshogs pa dang glu gar tshogs pa gnyis kyis 'khrab ston byas/ don brjod snyan rtsom ring po ku rma chu'i yul bstod kyi rab snyan glu dbyangs 〉zhes pa de khul rgyang bsgrags khang gis sgra thag tu phab pa yin/ngas lo du mar gsar rtsom gyi las la brtson pa lhur blangs pa'i 'bras rtags su lhug rtsom kurma chu kha yi ngang phrug〉la zhing ljongs lnga'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bya dga' ang gnyis pa thob cing / de min sgrung gtam 〈zhe sems sdug pa'i gnyen ston〉la thengs dang po'i 〈zla zer〉rtsom sgrig khang gi gsar rtsom gyi bya dga' ang dang po thob pa dang /sgrung gtam 〈gser chen rtswa thang gi rtsod gzhi〉la ldan su'u zhing chen gyi 24
skabs dang po'i dus deb mnyam 'brel gyi phul byung rtsom yig gi bya dga' thob/ sgrung gtam 〈 chang 〉la gan lho khul gyi skabs gnyis pa'i skal bzang me tog gi bya dga' thob/ sgrung gtam 〈sdug 'bras〉la kun su'u zhing chen grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom rig phul byung gi bya dga' thob/rgyang bsgragase 'khrab gzhung 〈gser chen thang gi gyod gzhi〉la rgyal yongs thengs bcu pa'i bod skad rkyeng bsgrags rtsom rig gi bya dga' ang dang po dang / 〈sduge pa'i 'bras bu〉zhes pa'i 'khrub gzheng la rtsom rig gi bya dga' ang gsum pa thob/ ched rtsom 〈 snyan ngag pa zhig gi lam〉la bod ljongs phyi phyogs rgyang bsgrags rtsom rig gi phul byung bya dga' thob/dpyad rtsom 〈rtsom rig gi zhing sa 'dul ba po〉la kun lho'i rgyang bsgrags khang gi rtsom rig dpyad rtsom gyi bya dga' ang dang po thob/ gzhan yang las khungs rim pa'i bya dga' kha shas thob kyang 'dir re re bzhin brjod na mang bar dogs te mtshon byed tsam zhig yi ge'i ri mor bkod pa yin/da lta rang nyid 〈 klung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs 〉dang 〈 krung go'i snyan zhu'i rtsom rig gi mthun tshogs〉/〈 krung go'i deng rabs rtsom rig zhib 'jug mthun tshogs〉la sogs kyi mthun tshogs dgu'i nang du zhugs yod pa ma zad/ nga'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus re snga gzhug tu 〈 krung go'i deng rabs na gzhon rtsom pa po'i ming 25
mdzod〉dang 〈 krung go'i rtsom rig pa dang sgyu rtsal ba'i ming mdzod〉/〈shar phyogs rgyal spyi'i grags can mi sna'i tshig mdzod〉/ 〈krung go'i rig rtsal mkhan grags can gyi ming mdzod〉la sogs kyi ming mdzod bcu'i nang du bdams yod/spyir nga la mtshon na mkhas pa'i dbang po tshe brtan zhabs drung mchog gis gsungs pa'i 〈shes bya'i ri mgor 'gro thub min de brtson 'grus yod med la rag las yod 〉ces pa ni dri ma med pa'i legs bshad cig yin no/ / 26
bab chags pa'i 'phrul gyi rtse dga'/dkon lo'i rtsom yig bklags pa/rtsom pa po dkon lo zhes pa'i ming de sgra 'dzin dbang bo'i bu gar 'dzul ma thag zla zer dus deb 4ces pa de nying yid la rang dbang med par shar yong zhing / de nas bdag gis zla zer dus deb bzhi lnga tsam la ci dgar bltas tsa na/ de'i nang du rtsom mkhan 'di bas dkon mchog sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'am klu dkon zhes pa dag gi ming thog nas bris pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos mtha' yas pa zhig bkod yod pa mthong byung / lo rabs bdun cu ba nas da lta'i bar du dkon los bris pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos nyis brgya lhag yod cing / brtsams chos de rnams kyi nang du 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul mi 'dra ba gzhir bzhag byas te bod rigs 'brog pa rnams brjod yod pa dang / lta phyogs mi 'dra ba mang po'i thad nas bod kyi spyi tshogs mngon par mtshon yod/ kho'i cibrtsams chos rnams las 〈rma chu'i kha yi ngang phrug 〉dang / 〈zhe sems sdug pa'i gnyen ston〉/ 〈chang 〉/ 〈sdug 'bras 〉sogs la zhing 27
ljongs lnga dang kun su'u zhing chen gyi rtsom rig gi bya dga' thob myong zhing /bod kyi gtsug lag rtsom gyi rig pa'i bang mdzod du kun gyis khas mi len ka med yin pa'i byas rjes khyad du 'phags pa zhig bzhag yod/dkon lo'i rtsom yig bklags tsa na/ de las rtsom pa po skyes sa'i mtho sgang gi bod 'bangs kyi bab chags shing mda' las drang ba'i gzhung rgyud dang / rtsom mkhan gyis dngos don ji ma ji bzhin du bris pa'i khyad chos sogs tshegs med bde blag tu shes thub/ mngon sum 'tsho ba'i khrod du dekon lo la nyi ma'i 'od las gsal ba'i gsar rtsom byed pa'i blo gros rig pa ldan pas/ 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che ba gas tshab byed kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i don rkyen dang / mi/ 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim bcas sand du bzung ste ji ma ji bzhin du bris yod pas/bklags pa tsam gyis rtsom yig nang gi gzugs brnyan mtha' dag mig lam du 'char yong ba red/ kho'i rtsom yig rnams thog mar sgrung gtam dang lhug rtsom zhes dbye bar mi bya ste/ pha yul gyi le'u/ gnyen don gyi le'u/ zin bkod kyi le'u/ mi sna'i le'u bcas su phye na shin tu 'os par mngon/ rtsom yig de dab] gi nang du/ dkon los 'tsho ba dngos de nyid rtsom nyams btod pa'i gzhi ru byas shing / de nas rdzun bral bden pa'i lugs kyi 'bri stangs dang / sdeb legs snyan pa'i tshig gi phreng ba/ yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog pa'i nyams 'gyur sogs legs par spyad de spyi tshogs dang 'tsho ba dag gi gnas tshul de nyid med pa la sgro 'dogs dang yod pa la skur 'debs kyi cha phra mo tsam gyis kyang ma reg 28
par yi ge'i ri mo'i gzugs su bskrun yod/ khos yi ge'i ri mo'i gzugs su bskrun pa'i brjod bya gtso bo thams cad kyis dus rabs kyi khyad chos gtso bo dam por bzung yod pas/ 'brog 'bangs kyi yid dbang gi bung ba 'gugs pa'e sbrang rtsi dang / mi rnams kyi dran 'dzin dbang po'i chu gter du dga' sdang chags gsum gyi rlabs phreng ci dgar 'phyur du 'jug pa'i rkyen du gyur yod/ kho'i pha yul gyi le'u nang gi 〈'dzum mdangs 〉ni a khu nyi ma tshang dper mtshon du byas te 1985lo'i bsgyur bcos lhug grol byas rjes 'brog 'bangs phyug por gyur pa dang bsam pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs su gyur tshul sogs mngon par mtshon yod/ (phyug lung rtswa thang du byung ba'i gtam rgyud 〉ces pa'i nang du da lta'i dus rabs kyi 'gyur ldog sna tshogs kyis rjes nas ded pas rtswa thang gi 'brog pa rnams kyis srol rnying mkhregs bzung mi byed cing / kho tsho'i 'du shes gsar bar 'gyur bzhin pa dang / 'tsho bar 'gyur ldog ci rigs 'byung bzhin yod pa sogs bris yod/ 〈dpyid gsar skabs kyi mthong snang 〉dang / 〈tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba'i dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug 〉las/ rtsom mkhan gyis rtswa thang dar rgyas phun tshogs su gyur tshul de spro nyams 'phel ba zhig bris thog 'brog pa'i 'cham zhing mthun pa'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la bsngags brjod kyi me tog rgya cher thor yod/ kho'i pha yul gyi le'u nang gi pha yul brjod pa'i skabs su/dkon los 〈pha yul du 'byor ba'i bde skyid sminas 〈snying nas dran pa'i pha yul 〉bar gyi rtsom rig gi brtsams chos rnams las bsgyur bcos lhug 29
grol byas rjes/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus bzang pos mdun bsus te sngar pha yul dang bral ba'i phyi sdod bod mi spun zla kun slar yang pha yul du log nas pha yul dar rgyas song ba mthong zhing / pha yul la bcangs pa'i re 'bras mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par smin pa dang / pha yul dran pa'i sems la ngal gso thob tshul sogs mngon par mtshon yod/zin bkod le'u nang du/ dkon los don rkyen dang 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim zhig gzhir bzhag byas te kho'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug dang deng skabs kyi bod gangs can pa'i spyi tshogs kyi khrod du gnas pa'i spyi tshogs kyi gnad don mtshon yod de/ 〈 gser chen thang gi rtsod gzhi 〉las/ rtsom mkhan gyis bod yul du rtswa sa rtsod gleng byed pa'i demangs/ khrod kyi gnad don la sems rtse gcig gis dmigs shing / gtam brjod zlos gar gyi jirtsom lus spyad nas gser chen thang gi sa rtsod kyi gnas tshul mtshon yod/rtsom rig gi brtsams chos 'di klog pa'i dus su/ 64mi rgyud gcig nas mched pa kun/ phan tshun 'khon na 'gyod pa'i rgyu 〉〉zhes pa'i gna' mi'i gtam dpe de nga'i sems la ngang gis shar yong zhing / de la brten nas ci yin 'di yin la nges pa med pa'i skyo ba'i snang ba zhig 'gog med du skyes pa dang / ngas bltas na de ni rtsom mkhan kyis gsar rtsom byed pa'i dmigs yul nyag cig yin par sems/ khos brtse ba'i sems kyis kha lo sgyur ba'i pir gyis bod mi spun zla rnams la rang bkur rang gces dang blo sems gcig mthun yong ba byas nas khyim tshang legs par skyong dgos pa'i re ba bton yod/30
bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi srol lugs la bltas na/ bod kyi bud med rnams ni zhe 'jam zhing ngang rgyud dul ba/ sems bzang zhing sazhan la gces pa/ mdzangs shing rang 'khri'i las la brtson pa bcas kyi ya rabs shig yin na yang / gnye na sgrig pa'i skabs su kho mo tsho gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i gnas su lhung zhing / rang 'dod ltar gnyen don gdam ga byed pa'i dbang cha med pa zhig yin/ rtsom pa po dkon los de 'dra'i srol rnying la mtha' gcig tu dgag cing / spyi tshogs kyi go gnas 'dra mnyam micha par ngo rgol byed pa dang —/ rang dbang rang 'thad kyis gnyen sgrig byed par bstod bsngags byas yod/ dkon lo'i gnyen don gyi le'u nang / khos dus rabs gsar ba'i bud med kyi khyad chos dang / srol rnying la ngo rgol byed pa/ bsam blo gsar ba ldan pa bcas kyi bod kyi bud med bris yod de/ 〈bcos min gyi brtse dung sminang du/ rtsom mkha na gyis khul mi rigs slob grwa nas thon pa'i bu mo sgrol mas zol med pa'i 'dod brtse rgyan du thob pa dang rang dbang rang 'thad kyis gnyen sgrig byed ched pha ma gnyis dang bral nas dga' rogs bkra shis kyi rjes su 'brangs te song tshul bris yod pa lta bu dang /sgrung thung 〈zhe sems sdug pa'i gnyen don 〉nang gi 'brug skyid kyang rtsom mkhan gyis bris pa'i srol rnying la ngo rgol byed pa'i bud med cig yin zhing / srol rnying gi 'du shes ldan pa'i blo bzang khyo shug gnyis kyis rang gi bu mo 'brug skyid mi cha med rgyus med cig gi mna' mar byin nas rgyu rin blangs pa dang / bu mo 'brug skyid de la ma 'thad nas khong khro 31
dang sdug bsngal 'gran pa bzhin skyes te yul gzhan du bros tshul bris yod/gong gsal kyi brtsams chos de dag gi nang du rtsom mkhan gyis rang nyid kyi 'dod pa'i brtse dung gi lta tshul bris yod cing / bod kyi na gzhon rnams la lhad med rnam dag gi 'dod pa'i brtse dung dang rang dbang rang 'thad kyi gnyen sgrig bcas spobs pa chen pos don du gnyer dgos pa'i re ba bton yod/ dkon los khong gi mi sna'i le'u nang du mi'i spyod lam ga ge mo zhig 'bri bar brten nas mi'i gshis rgyud mtshon yod de/〈sems khong nas brdol ba'i mchi ma 〉las/ grong khyer gyi mi dang kha ba can gyi mi gnyis zhib tu bsdur ba'i thabs kyis grong khyer du 'tsho ba'i mi rnams sems ngan zhing rgyud sdug pas/ kho tsho thos pa tsam gyis skyug bro ba'i ham sems kyis dbang du gyur nas rgol lan sprod nus med pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig la btsan thabs dbang gis gdug rtsub sna tshogs spyad tshul dang / kha ba can ni grong khyer dang ring nas bral na yang / de gar bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba dang ya rabs kyi srol bzang yod pa'i khar/de ga'i 'brog pa rnams byams brtse ldan zhing gzhung rgyud drang ba/gzhan gces par 'dzin zhing dpa' snying ldan pa/ rgyu 'bras brtsi zhing bab chags bcas yin tshul mngon par mtshon yod/ sgrung thung 〈mtha' mjug gi sdug 'bras 〉las/ rtsom mkhan gyis bzang la bzang lan dang ngan la ngan lan yod pa'i 64rnam par smin pa 99zhes pa'i lta ba'i thog nas tshong pa dar rgyas kyis lha sar mar rdzun ma btsong nas gong lhag blangs shing / phyis le dbar stong gis chod pa'i pha yul du bros kyang 32
khrims lugs gser gyi gnya' shing 'og nas thar ma thub pa'i gtam rgyud bris yod/ des da lta'i bod kyi tshong pa'i spyod ngan la dgag yod cing /lha la mchod pa 'bul sa'i bar skor gyi sems bsam pa bzang ba'i mi rnams kyi khrod du khe spogs kho na gces su 'dzin pa'i tshong pa dag gis bod mi sems bzang kun dang tshong log brgyab nas khe log len bzhin yod par kha rdung dpag med kyang btang yod/ 'di'i nang du rtsom mkhan gyis tshong pa'i spyod ngan la dgag pa brgyab yod pa ma zad/ da dung gangs can pa'i mi rnams la khrims lugs kyis rang nyid srung skyob byed dgos pa dang / bar skor gyi mi ngan ngo tsha med pa rnams mtha' skrod gtong dgos tshul gyi gnas lugs kyang zhib tu bgrang yod/dkon 'o 'i brtsams chos kyi nang du pha yul la dga' ba nas pha yul dran tshul sogs gang dang gang zhig yin yang / mi gshis kyi bzang ngan la brtag cing dpyod pa nas mi yul gyi brtse ba ngo ma 'tshol ba'i bar gyi tshig gi phreng ba dag las rtsom mkhan 4gyis gsar rtsom byed pa'i bab chags kyi rtsom gshis nyams med du brdol zhing / de rnams la bsam tshul rnyog 'dzing che ba zhig med pa ma zad/ da dung rtsom mkhan rang nyid kyi lhad med khyad 'phags kyi 'tsho ba'i bshul lam de nyid sdeb legs snyan pa'i tshig gi phreng bar spel yod/ 〈'dzum mdangs sminas 〈snying nas dran pa'i pha yul 〉dang 〈tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba'i dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug 〉bar bcas la bltas na nga tshos rtsom mkhan gyis gsar rtsom byed pa'i brgyud rim gsal zhing 'khrul med du rtogs thub pa ma zad/ da 33
dung de rnams las bod khul gyi spyi tshogs dar rgyas song ba'i brgyud rim dang / 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba'i thad nas bod kyi lo rgyus dar rgyas song ba sogs kyang tshegs med bde blag nyid du rtogs thub pa yin/dkon lo'i brtsams chos kyi nang nas lhug rtsom gyi skor la bltas tshe/la tse bstod pa'i skabs kyi snyan lhang lhang gi ki dir byed pa dang lha rgyal lo zer ba'i skad gdangs/ rngam brjid ldan pa'i pho brang po ta la/bsang dud 'phyur ba'i bsam yas gtsug lag khang sogs dngos su mthong thos byung ba lta bu'i snang ba 'bad med du ster zhing / bod kha ba can gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang / bod kyi dgon sde dang 'jam thing nger gnas pa'i mdzes sdug gi rnam pa sogs sor mo'i 'du byed kyis yi ge'i gzugs su skrun pa'i tshe/ rtsom mkhan gyis bab chags pa dang zol med bden pa'i thabs nye bar spyad pa'i dbang gis rtsomathag bklags pa na khyod rang rtsom yig tu bris pa'i yul der dngos su slebs pa lta bu'i snang ba ster/ don rkyen dang mi sna dag zhib tu brjod pa'i tshe/mngon sum 'tsho ba'i stobs kyis gtam rgyud dang khor yug dag gi cha rkyen la tshod 'dzin byed mi thub cing / zhib tu brjod stangs kyi thad nas khong gi lhug rtsom dang sgrung gtam gnyis la dmigs bsal gyi dbye ba ci yang med pas/ nga la yang khong gi lhug rtsom dang sgrung gtam so sor 'byed par cung zad rmongs pa'i tshor ba zhig skyes su bcug de nas bdag gis slar yang 〈rtsom rig rags bshad 〉ces pa'i gzhung la bltas nas de dag gi dbye ba dang 'brel ba sogs blo'i rgyud du 'byor 34
bar gyur/ dkon lo'i lhug rtsom dang sgrung gtam gnyis kyi 'bri stangs gcig tu mtshungs pa des khong gi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom byed par gnod pa cung tsam zhig skyel bzhin yod na yang / khong gi bab chags snying bsdus kyis gsar rtsom byed stangs la yid dbang 'phrog pa'i nus pa dang khyad par can gyi yon tan zhig ldan pa yin te/ bskal brgyar gnas pa'i phul byung brtsams chos khrag cig ni sna mang rnyog 'dzing gi 'bri stangs la brten nas spyi tshogs dang / 'tsho ba/ mi gshis dag mtshon bzhin yod pa'i phyir ro/ / dkon lo la cha mtshon nas bshad na /ga kha ba can gyi mi'i bsam pa bco lnga'i zla ba las dkar zhing / gshis rgyud g.yang dkar bal phung las 'jam pa dang / gzhung rgyud nyag phran mda' mo las drang ba bcas kyis rtsom mkhan gyi yid dbang brtan pa cig car du 'phrog pas/ brtsams chos la 'dzoms dgos pa'i sna mang gcig sdeb kyi mdzes sdug dang yid 'phrog gi byed las bsam bzhin du don gnyer ma byas pa rtsoyin shas che/ khong gi brtsams chos rnams las 〈zhe sems sdug pa'i gnyen don sminang gi 'brug skyid dang / 〈chang 〉nang gi don grub/〈mtha' mjug gi sdug 'bras 〉nang gi dar rgyas/ 〈bcos min gyi brtse dung 〉nang gi sgrol ma/ 〈snying nas dran pa'i pha yul 〉nang gi lha mdzes me tos la sogs pa'i mi sna de dag la rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gshis rgyud dang sems khams zhib tu bris pa las byung ba'i gzugs brnyan gyi rang bzhin med pa/ gtam rgyud la rab btags dang rgyan gyis spras pa med pa/ khor yug la nyams dang 'gyur ba 'gog med du 35
