dpyod rta ljang 'od las gsal ba'i pha rgan dang btsun pa gnyis kyis bsngags brjod dang rgyab skyor byed par brten nas mjug mthar slob grwar 'gro rgyu de bdams pa red/ don grub kyis deng rabs slob ma'i 'tsho ba'i dga' tshal 'grim pa sogs gal che la nan tan gyis gsungs yod/ sgom pa bkra shis kyis brjod rim can gyi lhug rtsom gyi rnam pa snying bo nyid du byas shing / dper mtshon gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i don rkyen gsar pa dam por bzung thog da lta'i dus rabs kyi 'brog 'bangs kyis deng rabs can gyi rig gnas la bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur dang / slob grwa'i slob gso la mthong chen byed tshul sogs zhib tu bris te deng rabs can gyis 'a brog pa dang dge 'dun pa'i sde bcas la bag chags rdo la ri mo brkos pa lta bu zhig bzhag pa dang / mi rnams kyi rig gnas kyi 'du shes la 'gyur ba byung dang 'byung bzhin yod tshul mngon par mtshon yod/sgom pa bkra shingakhokyis bris pa'i lhug rtsom 〈 kha ba babs rjes kyi zhogs pa 〉zhes pa'i brjod bya yang slob grwa yin zhing / lhug rtsom de'i nang du kho'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so bris yod de/ 88dkar zhing gtsang ba'i kha ba'i 'dab ma nam mkha'i mthongs nas lhab lhub tu 'bab pa'i tshe na/ bdag gi yid la bag phebs nyams bde'i tshor ba zhig skyes/khor yug 'dzin ma'i khyon yongs su rab dkar kha bas kun nas g.yogs pa'i dus su/ kun rtog yid kyi snang ngor rang nyid chu shel nor bu'i pho brang du gnas pa'i snang ba zhig 'char 'ong /92zhes pa de yin pa'i phyir/102
lhug rtsom 〈kha ba babs rjes kyi zhogs pa 〉las/ sgom pa bkra shis kyis dri mas ma gos pa'i kha ba'i khrod dang / —kha bas phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu khebs pa'i sa gzhi'i steng du 'char snang gi 'dab gshog brkyangs te kha bas rab tu mdzes pa'i mtho sgang gi mtshar sdug 'bum gyi dpal yon longs su spyod par 'phur zhing / kho'i brtse dung gi snang bas 'khyud pa'i pir gyis bltar phreng —tshar du dngar ba'i sa 'dzin gyi lhun po dang / lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i dwangs bsil gyi chu klung yul gyi mdzes ljongs rnams zhib tu bris yod/ rtsom mkhan gyis rang byung khams ('di'i 'o ma ji bzhin rab tu dkar ba'i kha dog las mi gshis kyi lhad med pa'i rang bzhin dang khyad du 'phags pa'i yon tan 'tshol bzhin mchis shingaka rang nyid dang mi gzhan rnams la gangs chu ltar dwangs pa'i blo gros dang / gangs ri ltar 'gyur ba med pa'i blo spobs/yun ring gi phugs bsam bcas ldan par re ba chen po byed bzhin yod de/ dper na gong gsal gyi 'char snang phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyud las drangs pa'i lhug rtsom de lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ sgom pa bkra shis kyis da dung 〈 star bu'i snying khu 〉dang 〈snum sgron 〉sogs mang po zhig brtsams yod cing / rtsom mkhan gyis don dkyus ma zhig dmigs su bzung bar brtem nas mi rnams kyis gzhan gces 'dzin gyi bsam blo khyad du 'phags pa mnga' bar bstod pa'i 'brug sgra ldir ba dang / des rtsom mkhan gyi yid 'phrog rig pa'i lta tshul ji lta bu zhig yin pa mtshon yod/sgom pa bkra shis kyi lhug rtsom ni rgyan gyis rab tu phyug pa zhig min 103
par bab chags shing sgra 'dzin dbang bo'i bdud rtsir 'gyur ba zhig yin zhing / lhug rtsom re re ni rtsom pa po'i sems kyi rgyud mangs las byung ba'i dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug cig yin/ lhug rtsom 〈zhu ho rdzong bod rigs slob 'bring gi gnas tshul rags tsam bris pa 〉dang 〈〈thugs khur 〉gyi nang du rtsom mkhan gyis rang byung mig la snang ba'i dngos po dang rang byung ngag gas shor ba'i brtse gtam gzhir bzhag byas thog bab chags pa'i 'bri thabs spyad nas mtho sgang gi mdzes sdug longs su spyad tshul yi ge'i ri mo'i gzugs su bskrun yod/ lhug rtsom 〈kha ba babs rjes kyi zhogs pa 〉dang / 〈snum sgron 〉/ 〈star ba'i snying khu 〉la sogs pa'i nang du rtsom mkhan gyis 'char snang gi glog dmar drag tu 'khyug pa las legs par byung ba'i nyams dang 'gyur ba'i dpal gyis klog mkhan dag gi yid kyi brtan pa cig car du 'phrog pa dang / klog mkhan rnams kyi sems la mdzes snyan du snang ba'i bab chags shig skyes su brdzangs yod de/phyogs bzhi'i gnas kyi ljon shing rnams la g.yu mdog gi lo ma'i rgyan cha med mod/ 'on kyang dkar mdzes kyi me tog phreng ba'i ljid kyis ljon pa'i yal ga dud du bcug yod pas/ phar bltas na yid du 'ong ba zhig yin/ zhes pa lta bu dang / 〈star bu'i snying khu 〉las/ 9de la gsom sdong lta bu'i g.yu lo dang / ma gal lta bu'i skye gzugs/ lcang ma lta bu'i mnyen lcug med cing / ༷ ltar bu'i sdong bos mi rnams la tsha gdung sel ba'i grib bsil sbyin pa dang / brjid chags khang brtsegs phub pa'i ka gdung gi tshab byed mi thub kyang / ༷ nged cag 104
dga' ba'i ltar bu'i nying khu gang nas len/ g.yang gzar brag ri'i sul gyi mdzes rgyan gang gis byed/ bye thang du dpung 'jug byed pa'i ru sne su yis 'dren/ chu chen 'gram gyi rags kha su yis srung bar byed/〉〉ces rtsom mkhan gyis bab chags pa'i tshig gi phreng ba'i lam nas mtho sgang du 'tsho ba'i bod mi'i gzhan gces 'dzin gyi bsam blo dang rtsom pa pos nang gnas kyi mdzes pa'i dpal yon don du gnyer bzhin yod tshul bris yod/ 〈snum sgron 〉nang du/ nyin zhig gi mtshan mor/ smag rum gyi yol ba nag pos 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs su khebs shing /rlung nag 'tshub mas khros pa'i ngar sgra sgrog bzhin mchis/ kho bo mi med rtswa thang du rgya mtsho'i khar g.yeng ba'i shing lo bzhin du gdong gtod sa'i yul dang / rkang spo sa'i lam ma rnyed par yid skyo ba'i mchi mas bzhin ras brlan zhing / blo pham pa'i sdug yus kyis mgrin pa rnong bzhin yod pa na/ rgyang thag ring ba'i sbra gur zhig nas sran rdog lta bu'i sgron 'od cig mig lam du snang bar gyur/ des nga la mdun du bgrod pa'i lam ston mdzad cing / gom pa'i 'degs 'jog sgyur ba'i blo spobs kyang gnang byung / zhes pa la sogs pa lta bu'i don zab la tshig mtshar ba'i lhug rtsom bris yod/ lhug rtsom de dag las nga tshos rtsom mkhan gyi bab chags shing yid du 'ong ba'i khyad chos mngon sum du rtogs thub pa yin/sgom pa bkra shis kyi lhug rtsom la bab chagaso shing yid du 'ong ba'i khyad chos ldan zhing / de bzhin du kho'i snyan ngag la'ang rang nyid kyi khyad chos yod pas/ srol rgyun gyi g.yu lo rgyas pa dang / dus rabs 105
kyi me tog bzhad par phan slebs che ba'i mthun rkyen bla na med pa zhig bskrun yod/ srol rgyun gyi 'gros dang mtshungs pa'i tshig sbyor du dus rabs kyi khyad chos dang / snyan ngag mkhan gyis skabs bcu gcig pa'i krungaci u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs dang / mi rigs srid jus kyi dge mtshan/ mi rigs khrag gi 'tsho ba dang mthun sgril/ mi rigs sa khul du tshan rig shes bya dar ba sogs la dmigs thog snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor snyan mo dang rtog pa'i lam nas bstod pa'i rdza rnga snyan par brdungs yod de/ dper na kho'i snyan ngag 〈spro klu nyidang 〈zhu 'phrin co ga'i drug 'gyur 〉/ 〈 bsngags brjod gdong bzhi'i sgra dbyangs 〉sogs ni mngon sum ring lugs kyi rtsom stangs legs par spyad de bris pa sha stag yin te/ ma smad tang gi srid jus gdugs dkar po'i/ /kun snyoms bde dga'i grib bsil snum po'i 'og / rab yangs mes rgyal khyon gyi mi rigs khag / dge mtshan gsar ba'i dpal la rol 'di spro/ / ༷ mi rigs mthun sgril dpal be'u mdud rgya dam/ / rgyal srung lcags ri gzhom gzhig kun nas bral/ / rlabs chen mes rgyal mnga' thang rgyus 'di spro/ / zhes pa lta bu yin/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi nyi 'od 'og tu mes rgyal gyi yul gru kun la dpyid kyi dpal yon shar zhing /mi rigs rnams 'cham zhing mthun pa'i sgo nas mes rgyal gyi khyim tshang chen po bskrun pa la sogs pa'i gnas tshul kun rtsom mkhan gyi yid du dran pa na/ dga' zhing spro ba'i snang ba zhig byung nas tshul de dag la bsngags 'dod cig skyes pa dang / de nas sdeb legs snyan pa'i tshig gi sbyor 106
ba'i lam nas klog mkhan rnams la skul lcag 'debs thub pa'i snyan ngag bris yod/ kho'i snyan ngag las yid 'phrog rig pa'i dpal yon don du gnyer pa mtshon pa'i tshe/ skyug bro ba'i snang tshul kha shas la dgag sgrub byed pa'am kha rdung btang yod de/ 〈zhu 'phrin co ga'i drug 'gyur 〉las/ skye dgu'i rmongs dang dbul ba 'joms byed pa'i/ / tshan rig nor bu legs rgu'i 'byung gnas che/ / gces nor phal gyis do min gces par zungs/ / khro gtum gzu lum g.yo sgyu dbyen la sogs/ /rnam mang skyon gyis ma gos shes rgyud brling / / des shing mdzangs la dkyel che'i dpal mnga' ba'i/ / thabs mkhas blon po rtag tu 'bral med ston/ / zhes pa lta bu yin/ de ni rtsom mkhan gyi sems gting gi re ba dang gangs can ljongs kyi bu phrug rnams la khyad du 'phags pa'i spyob lam rgyan du 'dzin dgos shing / nga rgyal dang / le lo/ g.yo sgyu sogs spong ba dang / rjes lus dang dbul phongs khrod nas tshan rig rig gnas dang deng rabs can gyi shes rig slob pa'i las la brtson dgos zhes gdams yod pas/ ngas bltas na de ni rtsom mkhan gyi 'tsho ba'i dmigs yul dang tshad gzhi zhig kyang yin par sems/ sgom pa bkra shis kyi snyan ngag tu rigs ba'i lam nas drangs pa'i tshig sbyor med na yang / dus rabs kyi 'phel phyogs la dmigs nas rang nyid kyis mi tshe 'grim pa'i myong tshor legs par brjod yod de/ 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung bklags pa'i 'char snang 〉las/ rtsom pa po'i snyan ngag ni bab chags shing 'jam snyan gyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i pir rtse yis 107
dus rabs kyi myong tshor mtha' dag ci dgar mtshon pa zhig yin zhing /bgrang bya stong phrag gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i ge sar gyi lo rgyus snyan rtsom gyis rtsom pa po la mngon sum gyi don snying ldan pa'i tshor ba byin pa dang /snyan ngag mkhan gyis dus rabs gsar pa'i bsam tshul gyis slar yang 'das pa'i dus la legs par gzhal ba'i thabs kyis srol rgyun gyi lo rgyus dang dus rabs kyi snying stobs gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbrel thog ge sar rgyal po'i dpa' zhing 'jigs pa med pa'i gsar skrun gyi snying stobs la bsngags pa'i 'brug sgra ldir yod/ 'dzam bu'i gling la nyin mor byed pa'i 'od ltar khyab pa'i dpa' bo'i mdzad rjes la bstod pa'i rgyud mang 'khrol ba'i tshe/ rtsom mkhan gyis dus rabs kyi brtse sems dang dus rabs kyi snying stobs gces su bzung yod de/ 64lo rgyus shog lhe gsar pa phye na yang / / khyed kyi mdzad rjes ri mo bsub pa med/ / tshe gang gzhan don sgrub pa'i snying stobs des/ / nga tshor brtson pas can bzhi bsgrub la skul/ /99zhes bris yod pa'i phyir na/ 66bsam gzhigs byed pa'i dus rabasag zhes pa'i dus 'dir nga tshos rtsom pa po la dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur dang / dus rabs kyi don snying / dus rabs kyi bsam blo bcas kyis legs par phyug pa'i snyan ngag 'bri bar re ba byed bzhin yod/snyan rtsom la mi rigs kyi brtse sems dang mi rigs kyi snying stobs dag gis brgyan pa'i sgom pa bkra shis kyis snyan ngag gi me tog bzhad pa'i do ra na snyan ngag rtsom pa'i las la ring nas brel zhing / rang nyid 108
—kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan ngaganyagi khyad chos kyi sa bon rtsom rig gi zhing sar 'debs bzhin yod pa dang / khyad chos kyi rgyud mang las gtam gyi dbyangs snyan 'byin pa'i brtse dung gi snang brnyan gzugs su skrun pa'i khrod du zol med brtse cadung gi rba brlabs drag tu 'phyur ba dang snyan 'jibs yid 'phrog gi gnas lugs brjod pa'i thabs kyis kho'i tshe 'di'i don du gnyer bya dang re 'dun rnams mngon par mtshon yod de/〈khu byug bu mo'i gsung gleng 〉las/ rtsom mkhan gyi brtse dung ni 'char snang gi 'dab gshog tu brdzus te bsam tshul gyi nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur lding gar la rol zhing / khu byug gi gsung snyan gyis mi rnams snyam ngag gi dga' bde skyid gsum gyi lding khang du bsus pas/ sa gzhir dpyid dpalagyis legs par spud pa'i mdzes ljongs shig 'dren byed kyi dpyid du shar ba ste/ g.yu yi mdog la 'gran pa'i rtswa ljang dang /sprim dkar 'dzin mar 'phos 'dra'i lug khyu/ mgo la me tog btsugs pa'i lus phra/ rlung 'jam gyis ldem pa'i rtswa ljang gi phreng ba rnams dang 'o ja'i dri zhim phyogs kun 'thul ba las rtsom mkhan gyi sems 'dun dang bsam tshul zhib tu brjod pa dang / snyan ngag 'di'i thog ma'i skyo lhang lhang gi snang ba dang kha mtshar gyi pi wang gis klog mkhyen rnams kyi yid la snyan mdzes yid 'ong gi tshor ba spom po zhig ster ba dang / snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur tha dad pa dag las rtsom mkhan gyi yid du dpyid kyi dpal mo mi yul du dus gtan du gnas pa nyal re sgug byed bzhin yod pa rtogs thub pa'i khar/ rtsom mkhan gyis brtse dung dang mdzes ljongs 109
gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbrel ba'i khrod nas rtsom gshis shig mngon par mtshon yod/sgom pa bkra shis kyi snyan ngag ni mi rigs rang gi khyad chos rmad du byung bas legs par phyug pa zhig yin zhing / skabs rer mthong thos gnyis kyi yul du 'gyur bar 'dod pa'i glu gzhas shig dang nye bar mtshungs te/ 〈 gangs dkar sems kyi smon 'dun 〉zhes pa ni rtsom mkhan gyis dmangs gzhas gzhir bzhag byas te brtsams pa zhig yin pas/ gsar rtsom byas par mngon sum gyi don snying yod de/ dper na/ lag mdzub chung nu mar 'jus nas/ / shing gsom dkar ze'u'i nang la/ /dkar 'o ma shag shag 'jo ba/ /pir smyu gu 'dzin rgyu byung na/ /gos za 'og ri mo 'dra ba'i/ /phyi'i 'jig rten khams kyi ltad mo/ / dus deng rabs gnas tshul gsar pa/ / zhes pa lta bu yin/ rtsom mkhan gyis de ltar snga phyi gnyis ka zhib bsdur byed pa'i thabs kyis bod gangs can ljongs 'di'i lo chung byis pa rnams kyis nor lug 'tsho ba'i las kho nar 'jug pa spangs te slob grwar 'gro ba dang / bab chags pa'i nga'/ rtsol dang 'tsho ba'i khrod nas shes rig dang tshan rig rgya cher dar ba'i 'jig rten du 'gro dgos tshul gyi bslab bya'i bdud rtsi dga' ston du spel yod/ sgom pa bkra shis kyi bsam tshul de kho'i brtsams chos kyi srog shing lta bur gyur yod cing / de ni sgom pa bkra shis kyis bod mi rigs kyi spyi tshogs dang rig gnas la rnam dpyod rtsal gyis zhib tu brtags pa dang zhi 'dun dpag tu med pa bcangs pa'i rtags mtshan zhig yin no/ /110
mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyi lo rgyus/4de yang sngon gyi las bzang smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas yul phyogs gang du rang gi sku'i skye ba blangs tshul ni/ dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing khams kyi 'dzin ma'i shar phyogs bod chol kha gsum du phye ba'i mdo smad rta'i chol kha'i nang tshan/ (mtsho zhing chen mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul thun te rdzong ho pe zhang ) rma byang gser smug ljongs zhes bya ba'i sa la dge bcu tshang ba mi rnams rang bzhin gyis blo rig bkra zhing dpa' rtsal che ba/ chung byis pa nas bzung rgan mgo dkar gyi skye bo thams cad tshul ldan ya rabs kyi lugs las mi 'gongs pa sha stag yin pa/ stobs 'byor klu yul las che zhing bde skyed lha yul las phul du son pa'i bkra shis lha dge mtshan gyi mtshan ma rnam par bkra ba dang /lho phyogs na bod kyi lo rgyus las bshad pa'i srid pa chags pa'i dgu zhes pa'i ya gyal rnam 'dren thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan sngar dang po thugs bskyed pa'i sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra bzhugs shing / mdun phyogs su rgyu ba'i rma klung dal ba ring mo ni g.yu 'brug sa ru nyal ba dang 111
gnyis su ma mchis la/ shar phyogs su gser chen 'dus ri zhes ri rgyal lhun po mtho zhing brjid nyams dang ldan pa rtse ru dar lcog gi co pan rlung gis lhab lhab tu skyod bzhin pa zhig yod/ nub phyogs na rdza dkar chab chen zhes rtse mo sprin dkar gyi gseb tu zug pa stong na chos dad kyi mi rnams kyis lab rtse bstad pa'i gnas ri chen po rtse mor bltas na spyi bo'i zhwa yang sa la lhung 'gro ba zhig 'gying stabs su yod/ de lta bu'i yul ljongs su brag ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba lta bu dang / ri rgyal lhun po shel gyi mchod rten lta bu ma byas rang byung gis tshar du dngar ba ni 'jig rten byed pos ched du bzhings pa dang mtshungs la/ nags tshal me tog gis mdzes pa'i rtswa thang na/ ri dwags gcan gzan gyi tshogs ni khyu dang khyu byas nas bag phebs su 'tsho ba dang / gnyis skyes 'dab chags kyis mgrin glu snyan len bzhim bar snang du gshog 'gyur byed pa sogs dge mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab la/ da dung dud 'gro phyugs rigs kyi khyu ni dgung a sngon dbyings kyi skar tshogs sa la bkram pa bzhin rta pho brig zheng can/ rgod ma ther zheng can/ mdzo khyung dkar rwa kha can/g.yag rog po zhol tsid can/ lug g.yang dkar bal rdzong can dag gis khyu dang khyu byas nas ri klung thang gsum khyab nas yod pa dang /gzhan yang gtsang paṇ+ḍi ta blo bzang bstan pa rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya ste spyi lo 1765lor btab pa'i gtsang dgon don grub rab brtan gling zhes snyan grags kyi gdugs dkar bo bla na 'khor ba'i dgon chen de nyid dang / a rig dge 112
bshes chen mos rab byung bcu sanyis pa'i me pho rta spyi lo 1726lor btab pa'i rwa rgya dgon bshad sgrub byams pa gling ngam bkra shis 'byung gnas zhes snyan pa phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna ba'i 'phyang 'phrul du bkod pa'i dgon chen de gnyis rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar gnas pa'i yul ljongs 'di ko ni/ kho bos sku'i skye ba blangs pa'i sa cha yin/ sa cha 'di nas bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i phur bu zhes ba sa pho sprel gyi spyi lo 1968lo'i dbyar zla brgyad par/ bod kyi rus chen po bzhi'i zhang bor 'os pa sgo lha sde dkar bo'i rigs la rus chen rgyal mo tsho bco brgyad byung ba'i nang tsham mgar keng 'gor gsum du grags pa'i mgar zhes bya ba'i gdung rgyud du nga rang skyes/ chung dus nas bzung rdza kha dang ri kha nas lug rdzi dang nor rdzi byas pa dang / zhor du 'tsho slob slob chung du bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong byas/ 1980lor mtsho lho mi rigs dge thon slob grwa'i nang zhugs pa dang / bod kyi brda sprod dang / snyan ngag lo rgyus sogs la slob gnyer legs po byas pa dang / nang sgos su snyan ngag me long dang rtsom rig gi phyogs su 'bad brtson byas/ spyi lo 1985lor slob grwa 'di nas mthar phyin te rdzong bod yig slob 'bring du bya ba bgos nas/ bod yig dge rgan gyi las ka bsgrubs/ 1988lor slob grwa chen mor slob gnyer gnang du song ba dang / 1992lor nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas slob mthar phyin te/ mtsho lho bod rigs rang —skyong khul slob gso zhib 'jug khang du mi rigs slob gso'i zhib 'jug gi bya ba sgrub bzhin yod/ 1981lo nas bzung bod kyi rtsom yig 'bri ba'i 113
'go brtsams pa dang ༈/ snga rjes su 〈 smrang char〉dang / 〈 zla zer〉/〈 gangs dkar ri bo〉/ 〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉/ 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉 / 〈mtsho sngon bod yig nyin re tshags par〉/ 〈kan lho'i bod yig gsar 'gyur〉/ 〈 dkar mdzes bod yig tshags par〉sogs kyi steng du snyan ngag dang / sgrung gtam/ lhug rtsom bcas bsdoms pa'i rtsom yig brgya dang nyi shu lhag bkod pa dang / de las 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉steng bkod pa'i 〈pha yul gyi 'gyur ldog〉ces pa'i snyan rtsom la/ ljongs dang zhing chen lnga'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bya dga' ang gnyis pa thob/ bod mi rigs ni bod gangs can gyi ljongs su byung zhing lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring gi lo rgyus yod pa dang /spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i lo rgyus thog tu mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i lo rgyug kyi shog lhe mang bo bris yod par ma zad/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 'phel ba'i lo rgyus thog tu'ang mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos mtshon pa'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin gyi dpe ris gsar ba zhig bris yod/ mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i go rim thams cad ngal rtsol dang kha 'bral mi thub pas/ 88ngal rtsol gyis mi'i rigs gsar du bskrun pa dang / ngal rtsol gyis mi'i rigs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gsar du bskrun pa red 〉〉/ mi'i rigs kyi rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal la sogs pa'ang ngal rtsol dang kha 'bral mi thub pas na/ bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yang ngal rtsol las byung ba dang / ngal rtsol gyi khrod du dar rgyas gong 'phe'/ byung ba zhig yin/ rtsom rig ni spyi tshosas kyi 'du shes 'dzin 114
stangs kyi rigs shig yin pa dang / mi'i rigs spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba nges can zhig mi'i rigs kyi klad pa'i nang tshur snang ba'i thon dngos shig red/ de bas bod kyi rtsom rig ni bod mi rigs kyi spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig yin pa dang / bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba nges can zhig bod mi'i klad pa'i nang tshur snang ba'i thon dngos shig red/bod mi rigs la rtsom rig gi brtsams chos sa gzhi snod du chung ba zhig yod pa dang / rje tsong kha ba dang mkhas grub rje sogs kyis mtshon pa'i 'char yan ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa byung myong ba ma zad/ dran dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel dang sku zhabs don grub rgyal lta bu'i dngos yod ring lugs kyi snyan ngag pa'angakhung myong ba red/nga tsho'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar ba ni nang don dang rtsom stangs gnyis kyi cha nas dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i 'go nas byung zhing dar ba dang / rim gyis yar rgyas gong 'phel du song nas da lta'i bar sngar las je bzang la 'gro bzhin yod/ ca bod kyi rtsom rig gsar ba ni gtso bo mi rigs gzhan pa'i rtsom rig gi shugs rkyen thebs pa'i 'og dang / lad 'bri'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas gsar rtsom byas pa sha stag yin/ bod kyi rtsom rig la mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan dgos la dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur yang thon dgos/ deng rabs kyi rtsom rig yin na nges par du dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur ldan dgos/ bod kyi rtsom rig la bod kyi khyad chos dang bod kyi rtsom gshis ji ltar gsal bo zhig yod na/ de ltar rang rigs kyi klog pa po'i yid kyi brtan pa dbang 115
med du 'phrog nus pa red/ phyi phyogs la sgo 'byed pa dang sgo kun nas bcos bsgyur byed pa'i dus rabs 'dir rang rgyal rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas 'tsho ba/bsam blo'i rnam pa/ bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ mdzes dpyod kyi 'du shes bcas gang ci'i thad la 'pho 'gyur gting zab mo zhig byung dang 'byung mus su yod pas/ 'pho 'gyur 'di dag gis mi rigs kyi gshis rgyud dang / mi rigs kyi sems khams/ mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i rnam pa bcas kyi thad la ngang ngam shugs kyis shan zhugs par ma zad/ sngar bas kyang gting zab pa'i 'gyur ldog cig 'byung ba red/ nga tshos mthong rgya che ru btang ste mi rigs gzhan dang nang sgos su rtsom gyi rig pa ches cher dar ba'i mi rigs kyi sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs mtshon rtsal legs po yod tshad la yongs khyab kyis slob sbyong dang de la dpe bltas nas sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon shugs mthor 'degs byas na/ da gzod gsar rtsom gyi khrod du nyapho 'gyur 'di dag gi gnad zin cing de yang dag par mtshon thub pa yin pas/ mi rigs can dang / deng rabs can/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur bcas zung 'brel byas te/dus rabs dang mi rigs la mkho che zhing nyams pa med pa'i rtsom yig 'bri thub pa yin/ 'tsho ba'i zhing sar rtsa ba tshugs par byed pa dang mthong rgya rgyun mi 'chad par je cher gtong ba/ 'tsho bar zab zhugs byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng dus rabs kyi 'tsho bar spyi khyab tu lta ba'i nus pa mthor 'degs byed dgos/ rtsom pa po su zhig yin rung rtsom rig gi ོ116
brtsam bya phul du byung ba zhig 'bri dgos na/ nges par du rtsom rig gi ches rgya che ba dang ches phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byung khungs 'ba' zhig ste mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi me ltar tsha ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi nang du bskyod nas lta zhib dang / nyams len/ zhib 'jug bcas byas te rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom bya dgos shing / de ltar byas tshe rtsom rig gi brtsam bya de ni dus skabs de'i rang bzhin dang dngos yod kyi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yong thub/ rtsom rig legs po zhig 'bri bsam na/ rtsom pa pos rang gi brtsams chosanang gi mi sna de dus rabs kyi rgyab ljongs klong yangs po zhig gi nang du bzhag nas 'bri bzhengs byed pa dang / bye brag tu lta ba'i zhib 'bri dang spyi khyasatu lta ba'i sgyu rtsal gnyis gcig tu sbrel thub par byas na/ji da gzod brjod bya'i nang don legs shing /mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa/ mi sna'i byung ba'ang bden par snang zhing gson nyams ldan pa zhig yong bar ma zad/ zab cing brling ba'i lo rgyus kyi tshor snang khyad par can dang khyab che ba'i spyi tshogs don snying gis phyug pa red/dus rabs 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba dang chabs cig klog pa po'i mdzes dpyod kyi goms srol la yang 'gyur ldog phra mo 'byung bzhin yod pas/ bod kyi rtsom pa po dag gis bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed pa'i bya rim khrod thog mtha' bar gsum du/ klog pa po rnams kyi mdzes dpyod goms srol dang dga' kha 'khyer phyogs de gtsigs su 'dzin dgos/ gzhan yang nga tshos bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom kho na las/117
bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig la do snang ma byas na gtan nas mi chog ste/nga tsho'i bod mi rigs la srol rgyun rtsom rig phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa ma zad/ nang sgos su srol rgyun snyan ngag ches phul du byung ba mang po —yod/ de bas nga tshos bod kyi rtsom rig gsar ba gsar rtsom byed pa dang lhan du/ bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel bya dgos/ bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag la tshig sbyor dang / rtsom stangs/sgyu rtsal sogs kyi cha nas ches thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mnga' ba'i yon tan khyad par can yod pas/ nges par du rgyun 'dzin dang khyab spel bya dgos/ dper na/ rje blo bzang grags pa'i snyan rtsom/mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi snyan rtsom/ zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa'i snyan rtsom/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi snyan rtsom/sges steng blo bzang dpal ldan gyi snyan rtsom sogs kyis mtshon pa red/srol rgyun snyan ngag 'di dag gi rtsom stangs bkol nas/ da lta'i dus rabs gsar ba'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos de nang don du byas pa'i snyan ngag bris na shin tu nas legs par sems/de yang sgyu rtsal gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i snyan rtsom la tshig gi sdeb sbyor snyan zhing brdzid pa glu dbyangs kyi khyad chos dang / don gyi rang mtshan snang brnyan du shar ba ri mo'i khyad chos/ gnas lugs zab mo ston pa lta bu'i khyad chos/ tshig nyung la gnad 'dus pa rin chen ril bu'i khyad chos/ bsam don khong du sbed pa na chung mig zur gyi khyad chos/ yid 'gyur gyi nus pa thon pa lha'i byin rlabs kyi khyad chos sogs 118
tshang ba yin na snyan rtsom legs shos su btsi ba yin pa dang / de dag kyang mdor bsdus na don steng du byung ba'i mdzes sdug yid 'ong gi nyams dang / tshig gi sdeb sbyor steng du bton pa'i mdzes sdug snyan 'jibs kyi nyams genyis su 'du ba red/ snyan rtsom la don nyams dang sgra nyams rtsom stangs sogs kyi thad nas khyad chos bzang bo zhig thon dgos pa dang / u ru su'i mkhas pa pe lin zi khe yis/ 66snyan rtsom gyi rang bzhin ni/ gzugs med pa'i sems kyi ngo bo la/ gson nyams thon pa dang / mngon sum gyi snang yul dang / mdzes sdug gi rnam pa dang ldan par byed pa yin ha zhes dang / dbyin ji'i snyan ngag pa zho lad kyis 46snyam ngag ni kun rtog pa'i sems kyi nyams 'gyur ston pa yin 29zhes dang / sa zi le thad nas/ 46snyan ngag ni rtog btags kyi 'char snang dang / yid kyi 'gyur ba shugs drag las byung ba red ha ces gsungs pa red/ deng dus kyi bod kyi shes rig smra ba'i mkhas pa'i khyu mchog chen po a lags dor zhi rin po che'i zhal nas/ 44dang po/ sgyu rtsal snyan tshig la dga' sdug chags sdang gi nyams 'gyur thon dgos shing / de yang bcos pa ma yin par snying khong nas 'phyur zhing brdol ba'i rba rlabs yin dgos pa dang / gnyis pa/ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i tshig sbyor dang don mtshon byede kyi tha snyad kyang rdo chag btsan sgrig dang / 'phyor 'dod kyi sadong gi tshon rtsa lta bu ma yin par/ rang byung lhun grub kyi mig dang gdong gi mdzes pa ltar/ 'phrod bde gsal brjid snyan 'jebs 'gyur khug gi dbyangs kyi yon tan 'dzom dgos pa 119
dang / gsum pa/ klog pa po dang nyan pa po'i yid g.yo ba'i shugs dang ldan pa dang / bzhi pa/ snyan ngag rtsom pa pos rtog snang gis bskyed pa'i snyan ro'i zhing khams/ mi rang rang gi myong stobs kyis gzhal dgos shing brjod yul las 'das pa der klog pa po dang nyan pa po'i sems drang bar nas pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa'i don no/ /99zhes gsungs pa ni snyan ngag 'bri ba'i mtshan nyid thad kyi legs bshad dri ma med pa zhig yin pas/ dpral ba'i mig dang khog pa'i snying ltar tshang mas gces su 'dzin dgos pa zhig red/ bod mi rigs ni lo rgyus ches snga zhing rig gnas sgyu rtsal sogs kyang 'dzam gling mi rigs khrod kyi dar snga gras yin la/ rtsom rigs kyi dbang du btang na dmangs khrod kyi rtsom glu gzhas sgrung gtam sogs ches snga mo zhig nas yod pa lo rgyus kyi yig tshang rnying ba dang / rgyal rabs deb ther sogs su dpyad na shes shing / yi ger bris pa'i sgrung dang gtam rgyud snyan tshig glu gzhas sogs sgyu rtsal rtsom rigs skor da lta'i bar ma nyams par yod pa dag kyang lo ngo stong phrag gi sngon nas bzung rim par byung ba yin la/ grangs tshad dang spus tshad gang gi thad nas kyang / gna' dus nas bzung rig gnas sgyu rtsal dar che ba'i mi rigs gzhan dag la 'gran zla byed thub cing zhan skyon cung zad kyang med pa red/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs dang re 'dun mtshon pa'i sgyu rtsal rtsom rigs ni/ yod kyang chog la med kyang chog pa zhig gtan nas min pas/ mthong rgya dang thos rgya che la mig rgyang yod pa'i mi sna dang spyi tshogs tshang mas mthong chen 120
bya dgos/ mdor na/ bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig rgyun 'dzin gyi rmang gzhi'i thog nas/ sngon thon mi rigs gzhan dag gi rtsom rigs la blang dor yod pa'i sgo nas slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gnang ste/ legs pa'i cha thams cad tshur blangs nas bod kyi rtsom rig gsar ba mu mthud nas gsar rtsom byed dgos pa dang / ma 'ongs par bod kyi rtsom rigs nang don dang sgyu rtsal sogs cha thams cad nas sngar las gzi brjid che zhing /gting zab la/ rin thang ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur bar brtson dgos/gzhan yang / mi rigs gang zhig yin na'ang mi rigs de'i rtsom rig ni mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad dang yi ge las 'bri dgos shing / mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos dang yon tan nges par du tshang dgos/bod kyi rtsom rig nang gi don gyis bod kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs dang re 'dun mtshon pa dang phyi'i rnam pa bod mi rigs rang gi skad dang yi ge las brtsams shing bod kyi rtsom stangs ma nyams pa zhig yin degos te/de ltar byas na gzhi nas bod kyi rtsom rig gi dgos pa yongs su 'grub pa yin/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig ni mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad dang yi ge las byas shing / m+mu rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos yongs su tshang ba zhig yin na/ bod mi dmangs kyis dga' bsu dang dgyes snang chen ngo sa bstod bsngags bgyid par ma zad/ rtsom yig de ni bod mi dmangs kyi kha yi rgyan du gyur cing rna ba'i gsos dang mig gi bdud rtsi lta bur gyur yod pas na/ bod rigs kyi rtsom pa po rnams ni bod kyi rtsom rig gi srog shing dang bod rigs mi dmangs kyi snying nye ba'i grogs po 121
yin pa don dngos las bden dpang gsal po byung yod/ bod kyi rtsom pa po zhig la mtshon na/ rtsom pa po de'i rtsom rigs klog pa po dang de longs su spyod pa po ni bod rigs 'brog pa mang tshogs dang zhing pa mang tshogs rnams yin la/ de tsho ni rtsom pa po de'i rtsom rig gi dngos po longs su spyod mkhan kho na yin/ gzhung lugs dang lag len gnyis kyi thad nas bod kyi rtsom rig ni bod kyi skad dang yi ge las byed dgos pas/de ltar ma byas na khyod kyi rtsom rig des bod rigs mang tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu thub rgyu ma red/ dus rabs gsar pa'i cang shes kyi gom 'gros bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi rlung shugs dang bsdebs nas mdo dbus mtho sgang gi mgron du phebs pa'i skal bzang gi dus 'dir/ rtsom rig gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i kha phyogs ltar/ 64me tog mnyam bzhad nyagadang 66mkhas brgya 'gran gleng 〉〉gi byed phyogs lag len du bltar zhing / dus rabs kyi dbyangs rta gtso bor shugs snon byas nas/ mi 'gyangs par bod kyi rtsom rig sngar las rgya che zhing / ga ting zab la/ rin thang shin tu che ba'i me tog gi phon po bla na med pa zhig tu 'gyur bar bkra shis bde legs shog/122
44lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉las 'phyur ba'i rlabs kyi zegs ma/mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyi rtsom yig bklags pa/kye'di ni rang bzhin gyi rbab chu dkyus ma zhig ma yin te/brjid cing rngam pa'i nyams/'jigs pa med pa'i snying /zhum pa med pa'i dpa'/dar zhing rgyas pa'i lus/mdzes shing 'phyor blta rgyan/snyan zhing 'jibs pa'i glu/'di ni bod gangs can gyi gzhon nu rnams kyi lang tsho'i rbab chu red/'di ni dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i bod rigs gzhon nu rnams kyi/123
gsar gtod kyi snying stobs/'thab 'dzing gi nyams 'gyur/gang tsho'i glu sgra red/ces pa'i snyan tshig 'di bklags pa na ha cang cha rgyus yod pa'i snang ba zhig ster bar khag ci yod/ de ni sku zhabs don grub rgyal gyis bris shing snyan grags che ba'i snyan tshig 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉yi nang gi tshan pa zhig yin zhing / snyan ngag des lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i snyan ngag pa rnams kyis snyan ngag rtsom pa'i thad la shan chen po zhig zhugs su bcug yod pas/ snyan ngag de la dbyar gsum gyi 'brug sgra lta bu'i grags pa 'bar ba dang / mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal yang don grub rgyal gyi snyan ngag 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉yi shan zhugs thebs pa'i snyan ngag pa zhig yin/mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyis kho'i snyan ngag 〈 phugs bsamaji kyi gangs chu 〉yi nang du 'di ltar/ 89kye wa wa 'di ni rang dgar gyi gangs chu zhig ma yin te/ 'jigs pa med pa'i dpa'/ nyams pa med pa'i stobs/ 'gyur ba med pa'i snying / lus kyi mdzes sdugbzhur ba'i nyams 'gyur/ sgrog pa'i rlabs sgra ༷ ༷ 'di ni wa wabod kha ba can gyi gzhon nu rnams kyi phugs bsam gyi gangs chu red/'di ni wa wa dus rabs nyi shu pa'i bod rigs gzhon nu rnams kyi gsar gtod kyi sna 'dren red/〉〉ces 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉la mngon sum sgrib med kyis lad zlos byas te bris pa zhig yin pa tshig don gnyis kyi cha nas tshegs med du rtogs thub/ de yang sngon dus snyan ngag 〈lang tsho'i 124
rbab chu 〉yis kho'i yid kyi brtan pa cig car du 'phrog pas snyan ngag rtsom par blo kha phyogs pa'i 'dun pa zhig byung na yang / yid phangs pa zhig la snyan ngag rtsom pa'i dus su 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉yi dus rabs kyi khyad chos dang / dus rabs kyi snying stobs/ rjod byed tshig gi sdeb sbyor sogs gas thar ma thub par bskyar zlos byed pa lta bu zhig tu gyur yod/ yin na yang bskyar zlos byed pa de las don grub rgyal sugyi snyan ngag gi stobs shugs dang bod kyi rtsom rig gi skyed tshal du rtsom lus gsar ba'i snyan tshig gi me tog bzhad par na gzhon rtsom mkhan rnams kyis yi rang byed pa mtshon zhing / de ni rtsom lus rigs sna tshogs bod kyi rtsom rig tu 'dzul nas 'phelargyas su 'gro ba'i lo rgyus kyi khrod nas nga tshos dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig la 'gyur ba byung dang 'byung bzhin yod pa shes thub pa yin/〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉la tshig sbyor rang mos su spel chog pa'i dge mtshan ldan pa ma zad/ da dung mi rigs kyi snying stobs cher skyed pa'i nus shugs dang dus rabs kyi snying stobs las 'phos pa'i yid 'phrog nus pa bcas ldan zhing / don grub rgyal gyis gsar rtsom byas pa'i nyams 'gyur rmad du byung ba zhig yin pas/ nga tsho phyi rabs pa rnams kyis kho'i snyan ngag gi phyi'i ro nyams phul du byung ba zhig ldan pa mthong dgos pa ma zad/ da dung kho'i snyan ngag nang gi brjod bya'i don gyi snyan nyams la zhib 'jug byas te 66lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉las lhag cing dus rabs dang mthun pa'i snyan ngag 'bri dgos pa dang / 〈lang tsho'i rbab 125
chu 〉las lhag pa'i snyan ngag ji ltar 'bri ba'i thad la mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gcig pus zhib 'jug byed dgos pa tsam zhig min te/ nga tsho'i lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po yod do cog gis bsam gzhigs dang zhib 'jug byed dgos pa'i gnad dam pa zhig yin/mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyi snyan tshig 〈bcos bsgyur gyi rbab chu 〉yi nang du/〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉yi 'bri stangs ltar bris pa'i tshig don gnyis yod pa ma zad/ da dung 64rbab chu 〉〉zhes pa'i tshig kyang g.yar yod pa dang /des bsgyur bcos sgo 'byed byed par bkag 'gog byed mi thubartapa'i stobs shugs mtshon yod de/ de'i nang du 'di ltar/ 44stos dang /rlabs phreng gi wu ba dkar zhing gtsang la/ rlabs phreng gi rtsen rtsal ni khug rta'i gshog 'gyur dang mtshungs/ kye wa wa 'di ni bcos bsgyur gyi rbab chu red/ ༷ ༷bcos bsgyur gyi rbab chu yis/ nga tshor 'bod skul gtong bzhin yod/ gangs ljongs kyi gzhon nu/ rjes lus kyi ritshang nas longs dang / sngon skyod kyi lam la rgyugs shig 9 ces bris yod/de yang bsgyur bcos bya pa ni mngon sum mam rnyog 'dzing che ba'i spyi tshogs kyi dngos don zhig yin zhing / don de nyid 64rbab chu 〉〉zhes pa'i g.yar ming gi thog nas mtshon yod pas/ de ni nges pa don gyi rgyun du dmigs pa'i phugs bsam zhig tu gyur na yang / rtsom mkhan gyis bod yul du bsgyur bcos byed par bcol ba'i re 'dun zhig yin/mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal ni srol rgyun snyan ngag dang dpyad rtsom sogs 'bri bar dga' ba'i bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po yin zhing /126

nye ba'i lo 'gar bya ba'i dbang gis rtsom pa po dang rtsom sgrig pa gang mang ngo shes su gyur cing / kho tsho dang mnyam du bod kyi rtsom rig gi sngar song lo rgyus dang da lta'i gnas tshul/ 'byung 'gyur gyi mdun ljongs bcas la gleng mol gang mang byas/ bdag gis bsam par bod kyi rtsom rig gi mi rigs rang bzhin dang 'dzam gling rang bzhin gcig 'gyur yong bar gtsigs su 'dzin dgos shing / mi rigs rang gi srol rgyun rtsom rig gi legs cha rgyud 'dzin byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog mi rigs gzhan dang rgyal khab gzhanan gyi phul byung gi sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs bsdu len byas te bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan zhing dus rabasakyi rang bzhin mchis pa'i gsar rtsom gyi mdun lam zhig gtod dgos shing / de las rgyud 'dzin ni rmang gzhi dang bsdu len ni byed thabs shig dang gsar gtod ni rtsa gnad du 'dod do/ dus rabs gsar par dbyangs rta gsar pa dgos shing rtsom rig la thod brgal dang gsar gtod med tshe 'phel rgyas su brtsi ga la rigs/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa bsu ma byed pa'i dus 'dir/ nga tshos da dung dus rabs bdun pa'i rtsom 'bras gzhan la ngom pa'am de lad zlos byas te bsdad na 'phel rgyas zhes pa stong gtam kho na'o/ rnying zhen ni rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi lcags sgrog dang lad zlos/ ni rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi lam log ma yin nam/ nga tshos rtsom lus sam rtsom stangs sna mang can dang / bsam blo dang rtsom sros mi rigs can/ sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs deng rabs can du bsgyur bas brtson pas 'tshol snyeg byas tshe/ da gzod bod kyi deng rabs rtsom 137
rig gi dga' tshal yangs por mdzes shing yid dbang 'phrog pa'i dpyid dpal zhig 'char nges so/ /nga rang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi lta ba dang khong gi blo spobs la snying nas mos gus che la/ khong gis bod mi rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho bar spyan zung gtad de spobs pa chen pos kha ba ri bo'i mi rnams la 'bod pa btang ba ste/rnying ba thams cad lha yi srol du bsgrags/ /gsar pa thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du bsam/ /ngo mtshar thams cad bltas ngan nyid du bsgoms/ / 'di ni da lta'i bar du rang re'i srol/ /zhes pa ni ci 'dra'i don dang ldan zhing bsam blor 'od zer 'phro ba'i legs bshad cig red ang 'dod/rang nyid ches sdang ba ni rtsom yon gyi ched du rtsom yig 'bri ba'i bya spyod de'o/ /1994lo'i ston nar gtsos nas bris/138
brtse sems kyis 'khyud pa'i gangs ljongs/chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi rtsom yig bklags pa/lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i skabs su gangs can ljongs kyi dus rabs gsar pa'i snyan rtsom yar ngo'i zla bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang nye bar bsdongs te blo rig rno cizhing deng rabs bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i blo gros kyi nor dang ldan pa'i rtsom pa po'i dpung sde chen po zhis byung zhing / kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring yang de'i nang nas gcig yin pa dang / lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i mjug nas da lta'i bar du snyan rtsom brgya dang lnga bcu lhag brtsams te bod kyi dus deb dang tshags par rnams su bkod yod/ snyan rtsom brgya dang lnga bcu'i ljon par rtsom mkhan gyi brtse dung gi me tog bzhad cing brtse sems kyi 'bras bu smin pa dang / de las rtsom mkhan gyi rtsom gyi bsam pa'i 'khyer so rgya skyed pa'i dri bsung zhig kyang 'thul bzhin gda'/ kho lo na phra ba'i dus su a phas brjod bya'i don rgya mtsho las zab pa'i gtam rgyud yid dbang 'phrog pa mang du gsungs pa de ni kho'i 139
gsar rtsom la phan pa'i blo gros kyi sgo mo 'byed pa'i rin chen gser gyi lde mig cig dang mtshungs shing / khyim mi rnams dang phangs med du bral nas dgon pa'i chos sgor zhugs 'dod kyang byung myong mod/ 'on kyang 'jig rten bya ba bshad mi rung / / bshad na bya ba'i mtha' mi rdzogs/ /'dod don mang po yod chog kyang / / thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dka'/ / zhes grags pa ltar kho yang slob grwar zhugs nas spyi tshogs kyi gar stegs su gom pa'i 'degs 'jog sgyur pas/ khos gsar rtsom byed par gnam lcags thog gis kyang gtor dka' ba'i rmang gzhi brtan po zhig bting yod cing / deng sang kho ni gsar rtsom gyi thad nas 'bras bu g.yur du za ba blangs pa'i rtsom mkhan zhig yin/ lo ngo bcu phrag 'ga'i ring la khos snyan rtsom gyi brjod bya'i don zab mo mtshon pa'i las la brtson pa lhur blangs shing/ snyan rtsom gyi mngon sum rang bzhin dang rtog dpyod rang bzhin don du gnyer yod tshul sogs gsham du mdor bsdus shig gleng bar bya'o/ /gcig brtse sems dang 'brel ba'i sems kyi 'khyer so/snyan ngag ni snyan ngag smra ba po dag gi rnam dpyod rgya skyed de snyan ngag gi srog mtshon pa las byung zhing / chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi snyan ngag klog pa'i tshe/ nga'i dran 'dzin gyi chu gter klong du 'char tshul gyi chu phran mang po babs pa dang / kho'i snyan ngag las rtsom mkhan gyi brtse 140
sems dang 'brel ba'i sems kyi 'khyer so dang brjod don zab mo mtshon pa zam mi —'chad par sngar las lhag pa zhig tu gyur tshul rang bzhin gyis rtogs thub/chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gis sngar brtsams pa'i snyan ngag rnams ni brtse sems mtshon pa sha stag yin zhing / khos 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang gi dga' skyo 'du bral gyi gnas tshul la dmigs pa dang / pha yul gyi gnyen tshan rnams la ring nas bral tshul mtshon pa des ci yin 'di yin la nges pa med pa'i skyo snang zhig skyes su 'jug pa ste/ dper ne 〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi dpe tshogs 〉zhes pa'i nang 'khod pa'i 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉zhes pa'i le'u yi nang du kho'i 〈mtsho dkyil gyi zla gzugs 〉dang / 〈dod yal ba'i sor gdub〉/ 〈chu mig kha ru 〉sogs tshab byed kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i snyan ngag bko da yod pa lta bu de dag yin pa'i phyir/ 〈mtsho dkyil gyi zla gzugs 〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag tu rtsom mkhan gyis 'di ltar bris yod de/ 64 khor rkyang gi 'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal zhig gis/bdag gi rnam shes mtsho mo yi ngogs su khrid/ 'jam thing thing gi mtsho dkyil du/ mnyam bgrod kyi ngang ba zung / rang 'dod kyis gnas der rgyu/ gser mdog gi nyi ma nub phyogs su bzhud cing/ sa srod kyi mtshams sprin 'od lam lam du 'phros/ re sgug dang dran gdung gi rlung bus/ bdag gi sems khams rab rib tu dkrugs/ a a wa wa mdun phyogs kyi mtsho mo'i dkyil nas/ bdag gi snying nye ba'i mi des/ nga la brtse ba'i 'dzum mdangs ston bzhin chas byung / nga rang 141
myur du mtsho mo yi klong du mchongs te/ kho mor 'khyud na snyam/ kye ma wa wa bdag gis phyi mig cig bltas tshe/ dbang phyogs kyi gnam ṭa/'i mtshams na/ dkar gsal gyi zla bas nga la khrel dgod byed bzhin :'dug〉〉ces bris yod pa dang / snyan ngag mkhan gyi snyan ngag gi tshig gseb tu brtse dung gis yongs su gtams shing / brtse sems kyis 'khyud pa'i srod kyi mtshams sprin dang / srod kyi mtshams sprin las snyan ngag mkhan gyis 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i myong tshor mtshon yod/ kho'i brtse dung gi lcags kyus zin pa'i dga' snang dang 'tsher snang dag gi rgyud mang lan brgyar 'khrol bas klog mkhan rnams kyi yid dbang cig car du 'phrog cing 〈dod yal ba'i sor gdub 〉las rtsom mkhan gyis snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor snyan zhing 'jibs pa zhig bris med par kun gyis do snang chen po mi byed pa'i 66sor gdub lhagal brten nas mi'i blo pham dang sems mi skyid pa mtshon yod/ de 'dra'i brtse sems kyi mtshams sprin kho'i snyan ngag gi lha lam du yongs su bkra ste/ 〈chu mig kha ru 〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag las/ 64 dben thing thing gi mtshan mo 'dir/ kho bo gcig pu srog med kyi bem po zhig dang 'dra bar/ dwangs gsal gyi chu mig kha ru yun ring langs na'ang / yal zin pa'i brtse dung ga ༷༷ / dran gdung gi mig zung yin gyi/ yin gyi/ mchi ma yi yol bas bsgribs/ mig chu yi thigs pa re re/ re re/ chu mig gi snying khar 'thor/ ༷༷༷ ༷kho bos skad shugs mthon pos gdung 'bod byas/ 'on te wa wa yod tshad gnyid du yur ba'am/ yod tshad dbugs chad pa ji bzhin/142
'jam thing nger/ khu sim mer ༷ zhes bris yod/ mtshan mo'i bsil rlung / zla ba'i bsil 'od/ mchi ma yi rgyun bzang / chu mig gi dwangs gtsang bcas kyis skyo ba dang kher rkyang du lus pa'i sdug bsngal mtshon pa'i thabs kyis 'tsho bar sngar las lhag pa'i re ba chen po zhig brtan pas/ bltas na yid dbang gi dang ba 'dren zhing / thos na dram 'dzin gyi brtan pa 'phrog pa dang / bklags na dga' sdug gi tshor ba ster ba la sogs pa'i snyan dag gi nyams rtsol med du thon yod/gong du drangs pa'i snyan ngag gsum po de ni nyams dang 'gyur ba dag gis legs par phyug pa zhig yim zhing / de dag gis snyan ngag pa'i tshor ba'i rgyud las drangs pa'i snyan ngag gi khyad chos mtshon pa dang /snyan ngag pa'i rang nyid kyi rtsom gshis dang 'phrul snang gi 'bri thabs sogs la brten nas khos 'tsho ba las byung ba'i tshor ba de dag snyan ngag gi nang du bris pas klog mkhan yod do cog gi 'dren byed kyi dga' ston darje thos 'dzin gyi bdud rtsir 'gyur ba zhig g.yin/gal srid kho'i sngar gyi snyan rtsom phal mo che zhig ni tshor ba brjod pa'i snyan ngag yin zer na/ kho'i dus phyis kyi snyan rtsom 〈gangs ri/ma yum 〉dang 〈sprin par blangs pa'i glu dbyangs 〉la sogs pa'i snyan ngag tu brjod pa'i tshor ba ni 〈mi lam khrod kyi 'dzum mdangs 〉dang 〈mtsho dkyil gyi zla gzugs 〉bcasasu mtshon pa'i brtse dung dang dga' snang lta bu zhig min zhing / khos rang nyid kyi snyan ngag la nam yang nyams pa med pa'i bla srog cig byin pa 4dang / kher rkyang du lus pa'i 143
sdug bsngal dang skyo snang dag mtshon pa las mi rigs dang / mi dmangs/ pha yul bcas la dga' zhing brtse ba'i sems kyi 'gyur ba mtshon pa zhig tu gyur yod/ rtsom mkhan gyis sngar snyan ngag las brtse sems mtshon pa'i nus pa gces su bzung zhing / dus phyis snyan ngag ni spyi tshogs kyi mgrin tshab pa yin pa'i nas pa gces su bzung nas gangs can mi dmangs la dga' zhing sems khur byed pa'i sems kyi 'gyur ba mtshon yod pa'i khar/ kho'i brtse ba dang 'brel ba'i sems kyi 'khyer so'i rgya mtsho las brtse 'dod kyi bsam tshul dang rtsom 'dod kyi blo stobs dag gi rba rlabs 'gog med du 'phyur bar brten nas gsar rtsom gyi lam bu zhig bskrun yod/khos sngar bris pa'i 〈nga ni chu thigs kyi zegs ma zhig yin na nyidang kur+sā phran gyi 'bel gtam 〉la sogs pa'i snyan rtsom las kho'i bsam pa rgya che ba mngon par mtshon yod cing / kung ni chu thigs kyi zegs ma zhig yin na 〉zhes pa'i snyan rtsom du/ 66gal te wa wa nga ni chu thigs kyi zegs ma zhig yin na/ bdag gis lhag bsam gyi zegs ma re re/nor 'dzin ma'i phang bar gtor te/ drag rlung gis kha lo sgyur ba'i/rdul phran gyi mgo bo gnon nges/ bdag gis tsha skam gyi gdung bas mnar ba'i/ gnam 'og gi skye dngos kun la/ rlan gsher kyi zungs khrag sbyin zhing / skye stobs kyi rnam shes stsol nges/nya zhes bris yod/kho'i snyan rtsom 〈tswa phran gyi 'theg gtam 〉du/ 64nga ni mtho sgang gi rtswa thang gi ming med kyi rtswa phran zhig yin/ nga rang nam yang 144
mdzes sdug gi rtswa thang dang 'bral 'dod med cing / mtho sgang gi mi rnams la/ de bas dga' 〉〉zhes bris yod/ —de dag la zhib tu brtags na nga tshos rtsom mkhan ni mi rigs dang gangs ljongs la dga' zhing brtse ba zhig yin pa tshegs med du rtogs thub/ khos sngar bris pa'i snyan rtsom gyi nang du brtse dung phran bu tsam las klog pa po rnams kyi yid dbang gi dang ba 'dren pa'i yon tan chen po zhig med mod/ 'on kyang dus phyis kho'i brtse dung dang dga' snang gi mtshams sprin snyan rtsom gyi mkha' dbyings su rnam par bkra zhing / klog mkhan yod do cog gi yid kyi brtan pa phrogs myong ba dang / mthar gyis de ni kho'i snyan rtsom 'bri ba'i rten gzhi nyid du gyur pa'i khar/ bsam blo'i 'khyer so de ni snyan rtsom spyi'i srog dang snyan rtsom gyi yid dbang 'phrog pa'i rgyu kho na nyid du gyur / snyan rtsom 〈mtsho dkyil gyi zla gzugs 〉dang / 〈mtshams sprin brtse dung 〉nas 〈sprin par blangs pa'i klu dbyangs 〉bar rtsom mkhan gyi bsam pa'i 'khyer so rim bzhin zab nas zab tu song zhing / kho'i rang nyid kyi brtse dung de nyid rim bzhin gangs ljongs la dga' ba'i bsam pa dang rig gnas la 'dud pa'i sems par gyur pa dang chabs cig tu bod kyi rig gnas la bsam gzhigs byed pa'i las su zhugs/ de'i nang du rtsom pa bo'i mi tshe'i lta tshul dang / phugs bsam la yang bskyar ngos 'dzin byed pa/ dus skabs shig gi nang nas byung ba'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so sogs 'du ba yin/ de 'dra zhig yin tshul 〈gangs ri/ ma yum 〉zhes pa las mtshon yod de/ 44gangs dkar ya ma yum/ btsan 145
po rim byon gyi mtshan snyan/ khyod kyi dpa' bo'i gzugs brnyan de/ nga tsho'i snying dbus su krong nger 'gying la/ bdag gi ma yum gyi lang tsho la rgas pa med cing / khyod kyi 'od mdangs de rtag tu gnas par/ rang lus kyi zungs khrag yod tshad/ 'bul dgos kyang 'gyod pa med/〉〉ces dang / yang 〈sprin par blangs pa'i glu dbyangs 〉su 'di ltar 64gzi 'od 'bar ba'i lo rgyus de dag da lta ming gi lhag ma tsam/ /'on te yid la dran thengs re la sems pa mi skyo blo ldan su/ / kye kye a ma gnyid du yur ba'i ngal gso'i dus tshod ga la yod/ / spobs pa rab bskyed am gtsigs bsdams te myur du rmo/ngas gnyid las longs shigsngar las gzi 'bar a ma'i lo rgyus nga tshos gsar du 'bri 'go brtsams/ /zungs khrag zad pa'i a ma bgres mo'i lus kyi rtsal ma yangs po ru/ / nga tsho'i lus su lhog lhog bzhur ba'i khrag 'di phangs med du drangs te/ / mi sdug gnyer mas zhal ras g.yogs pa'i a mar lang tsho bsu bar 'dod/ /ga ces bris yod pa dang / de las rtsom mkhan gyi dga' blo dang 'dud sems kyis bod kyi lo rgyus dang bod kyi rig gnas dam por 'khyud cing yang bskyar ngos 'dzin byed pa'i las la brtson pa dang / mi rigs la 'gan 'khur ba'i bsam pa dang mi tshe la yang bskyar bsam gzhigs byed pa ngacas mtshon pa ma zad/ da dung mi rigs kyi 'angs pa'i rngam brjid la sems pa shor zhing mi rigs kyi phyis 'byung la sems tshegs byed pa'i bsam pa dang / bod kyi srol rgyum dang /: bod kyi rig gnas / bod kyi las skal bcas la bsreg bcad 146
brdar ba'i gser bzhin du brtags te ma tshon yod/ ngas bltas na rtsom mkhan rang nyid 〈sprin par blangs pa'i glu dbyangs 〉zhes pa'i snyan rtsom la rab tu dga' ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig yin pa'ang rtogs par gyur/kho'i dga' ba dang brtse ba'i rgya mtsho las byung ba'i bsam gzhigos kyi rlabs phreng gi me tog gatha' yas pa zhig kho'i sgrung gtam gyi chu phran las kyang 'phyur bzhin yod pa dang / de ni kho'i sgrung gtam gsar rtsom gyi brjod bya gtso bor gyur yod/ — gnyis/ srol rgyun dang mngon sum gyi 'gal ba'i bar gyi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul mtshon yod/98rnying ba thams cad lha yi srol du bsgrags/ / gsar ba thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du sems/ /ngo mtshar thams cad than ltas nyid du bsgoms/ /99zhes pa'i dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi zur za'i snyan ngag 'dir chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gis bsngags pa'i rol mo lan brgyar 'khrol bzhin shes rig dang gna' srol la bsam gzhigs byed cing /mngon sum dang srol rgyun gnyis blang dor 'byed pa'i 'gal zla'ikhod du khos bsam gzhigs byed bzhin yod tshul de sgrung gtam las mngon par mtshon yod/chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gis bris pa'i sgrung gtam la kyag kyog gi gtam rgyud dang kun la ngo mtshar 'bum dgu'i tshor ba ster ba'i khyad chos 147
kyis phyug pa zhig min na yang / 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim gyi dum bu zhig dmigs su bzung zhing / yin min bden 'dzin gyi blang dor 'byed pa'i thabs kyis 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi spyir btang gi gnas tshul rnams yi ge'i ri mo'i gzugs su bskrun yod/ khos 'brog pa'i dus rgyun gyi 'tsho bar brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas thog 'tsho ba'i yul zhig dang / 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim dum bu zhig dang / 'tsho ba'i bden lugs shig gces su bzung nas 'brog pa'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi gna' rabs dang srol rgyun las 'phos pa'i shugs rkyen gang yin pa thams cad ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon yod de/ sgrung gtam 〈lte tsho spo ba 〉zhes par gong smos kyi khyad chos yongs su rdzogs shing / sgrung gtam las rdza ri'i lte ba nas ri 'dabs su gnas spos rjes/ sde tsho dar zhing rgyas pa'i snang tshul zhib tu bris nas rjes lus kyi snga srol mkhregs bzung byas na bod spyi la phan med gnod byed du 'gyur ba zhig yin tshul mtshon pa dang /de la re zhig bsams na don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i 〈rkang lam phra mo 〉zhes pa'i lhug rtsom gyis kho'i yid du bag chags bzlog tu med pa zhig bzhag yod pa'ang gor ma chag ste/ sgrung gtam gyi nang du 44ri 'dabs nas ri sgang der 'then pa'i rkang lam phra mo de'ang sems mi thang ba'i byis pa zhig gis ri mo bris pa ltar phar 'khyog tshur 'khyog byas yod la/ sngar nas bltas na lam phran de da lta je dog tu gyur song ba 'dra/〉〉zhes bris yod/ rtsom mkhan gyis skyon brjod byed pa'i thabs la brten nas gna' rabs kyi lam phran de nyid deng sang ri mo'i steng gi gya gyu ldan 148 ca
pa'i ri lam ltar dog mo zhig tu gyur zhing/ de la lo rgyus kyi rjes shul tsam yod pa dang 'das pa'i dus gragatogs mod/ 'on kyang lam bu 'di'i steng du a khu 'gyur med lta bu'i bgres po mtha' yas pa zhig lus kyis mi lcogs bzhin gog 'gro byed bzhin yod la/ ri 'dabs kyi grong tsho de ni 64dkar chem chem gyi glog sgron gnam gyi skar ma tshom bu zhig sar lhung ba dang mtshungs/ rlangs 'khor gyi kur sgra dang sgra sdud 'khor lo'i sgra/ mi rnams kyi dgod sgra bcas mthon po'i rdza ri dang dma' mo'i sa gzhi/ yangs pa'i bar snang kun tu khyab/〉〉ces bris yod pa'i rlung gzhon gyis klog pa po rnams kyi dran 'dzin gyi 'khri shing rnam par g.yos pa dang chabs cig tu bsngags pa'i 'brug sgra ldir ba'i rgyu ru gyur/ sgrung gtam 'di ring po zhig min zhing / gtam rgyud dang / mi sna/brjod rim sogs kyang mang po zhig med mod/ 'on kyang lta tshul gsal po yin pa dang / khos dper mtshon gyi rang bzhin gces su bzung ste mngon sum 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mtho sgang dang gangs ri'i rtsa bar gnas shing 'tsho ba'i 'brog yul gyi gna' rabs kyi khyad chos 'dzin pa'i rnam pa dang gna' rabs kyi rjes lus dag mtshon parir brten nas deng rabs kyi dpal yon ldan pa'i 'tsho ba'i phyogs su 'gro bar skul ba'i ri mo zhig bris yod/ ca de ni rtsom mkhan rang nyid mi rigs rang gi rig gnas la dga' ba'i rtags mtshan zhig yin la/ khos srol rgyun dang wa wa'gyur ba/ wa wa dar rgyas bcas cha yongs su tshang bar re ba'i nyag phrag 'phangs pa zhig kyang yin/ z+ya149
chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi sgrung gtam ni thung zhing mdor bsdus shig yin mod/ 'on kyang de la rgya mtsho las zab pa'i don ldan zhing /shugs las bstan pa'i brjod don khyab che ba zhig yin pa dang / khos srol rgyun dang mngon sum gyi 'gal zla nye bar spyad nas spyi tshogs kyi gnad don dang mngon sum gyi gnad don la 'grel bshad don la gnas pa zhig brgyab yod pa'i khar/ bud med kyi 'tsho ba spyad nas 'gal zla de rigs mngon par mtshon yod/ kho'i blo gros rig pa'i bang mdzod las phyung ba'i 〈ma ṇi khang 〉dang 〈〈smug rlangs khrod kyi ri grong 〉la sogs pa'i sgrung gtam nang du srol rgyun dang mngon sum dag gi 'gal zla'i khrod du 'tsho ba'i bud med dper mtshon du byas te khos srol rgyun la bsam gzhigs byed tshul bris yod/ sgrung gtam 〈ma ṇi khang 〉las ma ṇi khang sogs yul du gtan 'khel byas shing / a ma bgres mo gsum gyis gsol ba chag med du 'debs pa'i skabs su gleng mol byed pa'i gtam rnams khungs sne lta bur byas nas srol rgyun ni yin min bden rdzun gyi dpang bor 'jog pa'i khrod kyi 66bud med kyi gnad don 〉〉dang slob gso'i gnad don sogs zhib tu bris yod/ nyi gzhon ri rtser 'phags shing / bud med rnams kyis mig phur phur byed bzhin 'thung chu len par 'gro ba'i tshe/ a ma bgres mo gsum gyis 66gan su red/ nyi ma yong do la shar rag bar du nyal 'dug da so ma chu len du yong gin 'dug ji 'dra'i rul ma zhig red ha ces gleng mol byed 'go brtsams/kho tshos mo dang khyo bo gnyis 'khon 'dzing byas tshul dang / sgyug po 150
sogs dang mi mthun pa'i bya gtsogs ma dang rgyud ngan pa zhig yin tshul gleng ba ma zad/ da dung gnyen sgrig ma byas shing dar che ba'i rol dbyangs la nyan pa'i bkra dga' mtsho'i skor yang gleng mol byed par brel ba'i thog nas kyang zhib tu bris yod/ sgrung gtam las rgyal lo'i chung ma dang bkra dga' mtsho'i gtam rgyud zhib cha ldan pa zhig brjod med na yang des klog mkhan rnams kyi blo sgo 'byed thub cing / lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus su'ang da dung gna' rabs kyi srol rgyun dam por 'dzin pa'i bud med rnams kyis zhogs par 'thung chu zo ba gang 'khur nas 'gro ba ni bod kyi bud med kun las la brtson pa zhig yin pa'i tshad gzhi zhig yin pas/ de la nga tshos lan brgyar bsngags pa'i rol mo 'khrol rin yod/ de lta na yang deng rabs kyi dpal yon gyis rjes nas ded cing mdun nas bsu ba'i khrod du bod kyi bud med yod do cog la 'tsho bar gdam ga byed pa dang 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi yod mi chog pa zhig ga la yin/ de yang sgrung gtam du gum ṇi 'khor lo bar med du 'khor 〉gzhes pa de bsam gzas nas bskyar zlos byas yod cing / de ni sgrung gtam de'i khungs sne gnyis pa yin par gor ma chag pa dang / des sgrung gtam la yid 'phrog pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi yon tan zhig byin/ de ni sgrung gtam gyi brjod bya'i srog dang gzhi gcig tu 'dres te 'gal zla'i kha gtad 'jal yul du gyur pas/ sgrung gtam la don zab mo gzhan pa zhis kyang rang bzhin gyis ldan par gyur zhing / lag tu ma ṇi 'khor lo dang phreng ba thogs pa dang / ngag nas khyim tshang dag gi skyon yon zad 151
pa med par brjod par dga' ba'i bud med rnams la zur za byas yod/bo'i sgrung gtam 〈smug rlangs khrod kyi ri grong 〉las bud med gleng gzhi byas te grong gseb kyi khyim dbul bo rnams la brtag dgos snyam nas grong tsho'i mi rnams 'jigs shing skrag pa'i 'dre tshang la bcar 'dri zhus shing /deng sang 'dre tshang na 'dre mo zhig ma gtogs med tshul brjod pa'i thabs kyis lo bcu phrag 'ga'i sngon gyi skyi g.ya' ba'i 'dod brtse'i gtam rgyud cig drangs pa dang / 'dre mo lta bu'i dpa' zhing brtan pa dang las dbang la mgo sgur ba'i bud med cig gi snang brnyan zhib 'bri byas yod/sgrung gtam nang gi 'dre mo la ming nges pa can zhig med cing / de ni rtsom mkhan gyis 'bri bar 'dod pa'i bod kyi bud med dang cha rkyen zhan pa'i khrod kyi bod kyi bud med dag gis snying stobs dang bsam spyor yag po zhig yin shas che'o/ / sgrung gtam las 'dre tshang gi sdug bsngal gyi lo rgyus dang 'dre mo'i 'tsho ba'i rol lugs dag brjod pa'i thabs kyis grong tsho chung ngu de'i rjes lus dang / mi rnams glen zhing gti mug pa dang rmongs dad kyi g.yang du lhung ba mngon par mtshon yod/ chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi sgrung gtam la kyag kyog gi gtam rgyud kyi brjod rim med na yang / mdor bsdus shing don dril ba'i sgrung gtam de'i don gyi bro ba myong ba'i tshe/ kho'i sgrung gtam la phul du byung ba'i yon tan ldan pa mthong thub pa ma zad/ da dung sgrung gtam nang du srol rgyun dang mkhregs bzung spyi ldog ma mtshon byed kyi 'jigs med dang a ma 'gres mo gsum zhib tu bris yod pa'ang rang bzhin gyis rtogs par 'gyur zhing /152
de la'ang sgrung gtam 〈 smug rlangs khrod kyi ri grong 〉jigabu'i mtshon byed dang dpe mtshon gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i mi sna yod pa dang / kho'i lhun chags shing yid du 'ong —ba'i pir rtse yis mngon sum gyi don snying ldan pa'i brjod bya gtso bo rnams yi ge'i ri mo'i gzugs su bskrun yod/kho'i sgrung gtam 'di'i nang du gtam rgyud kyis stong ba'i gnas bsam bzhin du bzhag pa ni yid 'phrog gi nus pa je cher gtong bar phan da pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang sgrung gtam nang du de 'drazhi stong pa'i gnas ha cang mang po zhig bzhag pa'i dbang gis :yid 'phrog gi nus pa gzhan pa kun nyams nyes par byas 'dug chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gis bris pa'i sgrung gtam ni mdor bsdus shing don dril ba zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang sgrung gtam gyi sgrig gzhi'i thad nas bltas na klog mkhan rnams yid phangs pa'i gnas kyang du ma zhig yod pa dang / de la rtsom mkhan gyis mnyam 'jog byas nas legs pa'i phyogs su bsgyur ba'i las la re zhig brtson pa lhun blangs na rang gzhan gnyis kur phan par 'gyur ro/ /sgrung gtam 〈smug rlangs khrod kyi ri grong 〉nang gi mi sna gtso bo kho mo zhes pa'i rang gshis kyi nus mthu dmigs su bkar nas brjod pa las —sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho khol mo'i khrod kyi mi yod do cog gis mnyam 'jog byed cing skyo nyams ston pa'i kho mo'i 'tsho ba dang las dbang mtshon yod na yang / rtsom mkhan gyis mi sna dang don rkyen dag sngar las lhag cing zhib cha thon pa zhig bris med cing / gal srid rtsom mkhan gyis tshod 'dzin mi byed par kho mo'i khyim gyi dka' sdug dang mo rang nyid kyi 'tsho 153
ba'i brgyud rim rnams gcig la gcig 'brel gyi gnas tshul brjod par brten nas zhib tu bris pa dang / rjes lus dang glen zhing gti mug pa'i rang bzhin de mi sna'i sdug bsngal ba'i las dbang dang gzhi gcig tu sbrel nas mtshon zhing dgag sgrub kyang gnad la 'khel ba zhig byas yod pa'i dbang du byas na/ kho'i sgrung gtam de ni klog pa po rnams kyis bskal ba ma stong gi bar du gces su 'dzin pa'i snyan rtsom phul du byung ba zhig tu 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o/ / gzhan yang chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi sgrung gtam gyi nang du stong ba bzhag pa 'ga' zhig ni don la gnas pa zhig yin zhing / de ni kho'i sgrung gtam mjug bsdu ba'i skabs su bsam bzhin du bzhag pa'i stong pa de yin pa dang / de la klog mkhan rang nyid kyis bsam gzhigs byed bzhin don gyi bro ba myong dgos pa zhig yin la/ brjod don shugs las bstan pa de'i rigs la dge mtshan ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams rtsol med du thon yod/ 〈ma ṇi khang 〉ni ma ṇi 'khor lo bar med du 'khor ba zhes pas mjug bsdus yod cing /des dus rabs la 'gyur ba byung dang 'byung bzhin yod la/ lo rgyu sa zam mi 'chad par 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin yod na yang / ma ṇi 'khor lo bskor pa'i las la ring nas brel ba'i 'brog pa rnams 'byung 'gyur ji lta bu zhig tu 'gyur ram zhes sems khur byed bzhin yod pa'i sgrung gtam zhig yin/ 〈sde tsho spo ba 〉zhes pa ni ri rtse nas ri gsham du lta bzhin pa'i a khu 'gyur med zhib 'bri byed par brten nas klog mkhan rnams la dri ba gting zab mo zhig bton yod cing / da ltar rig gnas la 154
'byung ba rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung bzhin pa'i khrod du srol rgyun rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos sam zhes mjug bsdu ba'i skabs su dri ba bcon pa des rtsom mkhan gyis snyan rtsom nang du bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum ji ltar byed pa'i thad la bsam gzhigs byed bzhin yod pa mtshon 'dugsgrung gtam ni bsam blo zhig dang / brjod don gtso bo zhigsgyu rtsal gyi lam nas mtshon pa'i rtsom lus shig yin pa'i khar/ yid 'phrog pa'i nyams dang slob gso bcas gzhi gcig du 'dres pa zhig yin pas/ sngar las nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa'i sgrung gtam zhig yang bskyar ji ltar 'bri rgyu ni chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring kho nas bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig min par bod gangs can pa'i brda'i lam nas snyan rtsom 'bri ba'i rtsom mkhan yod do cog gis bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhig yin par sems so /—155
