1979lo'i ston khar/ nga rang reb gong mi rigs slob 'bring du zhugs/ skabs der 'dzin grwa'i nang du tha mag lkog 'then byed pa'i slob grogs skor zhig yod la/ 'jig rten kha dper 64bzang bslab kyang shes dka'/ ngan ma bslab kyang shes sla 〉〉zer ba ltar/ skabs shig la nga rang yang tha mag 'then mkhan gyi dpung khag de'i nang gi mi sna zhig tu gyur/ 'dzin grwa'i kru'u rin dge rgan 'khon thar tshe ring ni sgrig lam dam zhing slob khrid la ha cang nan tan byed pa'i dge rgan phul du byung ba zhig yin la/ khong ni tha mag dang chang la 'brel 'dris gtan nas med pa'i mi zhig yin stabs slob ma rnams la yang phyi'i kun spyod dang nang kun slong gang gi cha nas blang bya tshad mthon po zhig bzung yod/thengs shig la ngas tha mag 'then skabs khong gis gzigs te nga la ngos zin yi ge zhig 'bri par bcug bod kyi gtam dper 44las ngan dus sen mo rdo la thogs ha zer ba ltar/ yang thengs shig la ngas tha mag 'then skabs khong gis gzigs byung / skabs der khong gis 'dzin grwa'i slob ma thams cad kyi mdun du 64da nas bzung / rdo rje gcod pas mdzub mo lnga yi steng la lha lnga bzhengs kyang ngas 'dre lnga red zer rgyu yin/99zhes gsungs/ skad cha de las dge rgan khong ni kha bshad don la gnas pa'i mi dam can zhig yin pa shes thub la/ de bas kyang gsal por shes ba ni khong gis nga la sems gting nas re thag chad pa de red/skabs der nga rang la cha mtshon na lo na phra zhing shes rgya dog pa'i dbang gis dge rgan gyi skad cha de sems la ha cang gnod myong mod/ 'on 160
kyang nga rang nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor zhugs pa nas bzung rang gi bsam tshul der sems gting nas 'gyod pa drag po skyes myong la/rang nyid la mi tshe 'dir bod yig gi chu tshad cung bzang po zhig yod pa 'di dge rgan 'khon thar tshe ring gi rngul chu'i thigs pa re re dang ngag gi 'gyur khugs re re/ re ba'i mig mdangs re re dang sems tshegs kyi 'khur bo re re bcas dang kha 'bral thabs ga la yod/ / red ya/ lo zla ni reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi dgu chu dal 'gro ring mo'i bzhur rgyun dang 'dra bar 'das nas nga rang slob 'bring nas mthar phyin pa'i dus la slobs/ skabs der nga tsho 'dzin grwa'i slob grogs skor zhig gis 'bring rim ched gnyer slob grwar rgyugs sprad pa dang / slob grogs skor zhig gis slob grwa chen mor rgyugs sprad/ nga rang ni slob grwa chen mor rgyugs sprod pa'i gras yin la/ zla gcig gi rjes su nga tsho'i nang nas slob grwa chen mor mi gcig kyang rgyugs 'phrod med pa shes song / skabs de'i nyin zhig la/ slob grogs byams pa rgya mtsho (skabs der kho ni rma lho khul mi rigs dge thon slob grwar zhugs yod/)dang 'phrad pas khos nga la phyin chad ci zhig byed rtsis yod pa'i skor dris/ ngas ci yin 'di yin med par 64khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste shākya'i dge slong zhig byed rgyu yim 99zhes bshad myong / de nas nyin 'ga'i rjes su dge rgan 'khon thar tshe ring gis nga la khong dang thug dgos pa'i skad btang 'dug nga rang slob grwar song ba na khong gis ha cang gzab nan gyis 44go thos su khyod rang rab tu byung rgyu red zer/ ngas bltas na khyod yang bskyar slob 161
grwar shog khyod kyi rig pa rno bas slob grwa chen mor zhugs thub rgyu kho thag yin/ gtso bor khyod rang nyid kyi spobs pa dang brtson 'grus la rag las yod/lnga ces gsungs pa'i skad cha de rnams da lta yang dran pa'i ras yol ngos su glog brnyan bzhin gsal ler sing nger shar ba zhig yin la/de nas cang ma 'gor bar nga rang yang bskyar mi rigs slob 'bring du zhugs/ / tshode'i phyi lo ste 1983lo'i ston khar/ nga rang slob grwa yongs kyi skar grangs ang dang po'i rgyugs 'bras bzang bo blangs te dga' ba'i 'dzum dang bcas nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod yig tshan khag tu zhugs/lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i bod rigs slob grwa chen mo pa phal che ba ni mi rigs kyi la rgya gleng mkhan sha stag yin la/ nga rang yang kho tsho dang 'dra ba'i sems pa'i 'khyer so zhig gis 'tsho ba rol cing / 1984lor zi khron gyi dus deb 〈gangs dkar ri bo 〉zhes bya ba'i steng du nga'i rtsom yig thog ma 〈rtogs sad〉bkod pa nas bzung rtsom rigs sgyu rtsal gyi lam du gom pa thengs dang po spos pa yin/ de nas snga phyir 〈zang char〉dang 〈bod kyi rtsom rigs sgyu rtsal 〉sogs dus deb steng rtsom yig khag cig bkod myong la/ 1986lor spobs pa chen pos yig 'bru bdun khri ribrgyad stong lhag yod pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈kyag kyog〉ces pa brtsams shing / nye char mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byed rtsis yod kyang / dpe skrun khang de da lta 'gan gtsang lam lugs kyi lam du 162
zhugs te ma dngul ha cang dkon zhing / dpar 'grem ma dngul gyi thad rgyab skyor byed mkhan gyi dpe khang dang sbyin bdag ma byung pa'i stabs kyis lo ngo brgyad la mi rigs dpe skrun khang du lus pa'i 〈kyag kyog 〉de da rung yang kyag kyog gi rkang lam phra mo'i steng du lus te rgya che'i klog mkhan rnam pa'i spyan sngar 'bul ma thub par lus yod/ slob grwa chen mo nas mthar phyin skabs dge rgan rnam pa'i thugs dgongs ltar slob grwa de ga'i bod kyi rtsom rigs slob dpyod khang du bya ba bgos te slob grwa chen mo'i dge ming 'dzin mkhan zhig tu gyur/ skabs de dag la rtsom rig gi slob khrid byed zhor du bod kyi rtsom rig la zhib 'jug byas pa'i ched rtsom 'ga' re yang bris nas 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉dang 〈bod ljongs slob gso 〉sogs kyi steng du bkod myong / ma yum slob grwa de gar dge slob kyi 'tsho ba nyis brtsegs rol pa'i ring la/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo tshe tan zhabs drung 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros dang rig pa'i dpa' bo dpa' ris dor zhi gdong drug snyems pa'i blo ldan gnyis gtso byas pa'i dge rgan yongs kyi bka' drin ji srid bar du brjed mi srid la/ bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i snyan tshig dbyangs la bkug nas smras pa 'dag ltar blo yi mun pa stug po gzhom la 'jigs med 'od kyi go khrab bklubs/ /rigs pa'i 'od snang phyogs bcur spros nas gdul bya'i pad tshal rgyas par mdzad/ /blo chen blo chung blo dang 'tsham pa'i blo gros chu gter 'byams klas pa/ /163
dge legs 'od stong rab tu 'bar ba'i smra ba'i nyi mar snying nas 'dud/ /rnam dag dpyad gsum phra zhib rigs pas blang dang dor bya'i gnas kun gzigs/ /bla med yon tan rin chen bang mdzod ring nas brnyes kyang zhi dul gyis/ /rig pa'i chu bo blo ldan blo yi mtsho mor drangs la mi ngal ba /gzhan phan gser gyi 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rkang rten byas gang gtsug gis mchod/ /rig pa'i gnas kyi chu gter yangs po mi zab gang yang yod ma yin/ /rig pas gsos pa'i snying stobs ri rab mi mtho gang yang yod ma yin/ /rig pas slob bu skyong bar ma byas dge rgan su yang yod ma yin/ /rig pa'i ral gris ma rig dra ba gcod pa'i dge rgan rnams la 'dud/ /rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer zhes su grags pa'i yul de'i lte ba ru/rig pa'i g.yu ral rab tu rgyas ba'i seng ge rtsen pa'i gshong sa nas/ /rig pa'i dpal la chags zhen che ba'i seng phrug rdo rje gcod pa yis/ /rig pas gsos pa'i bka' drin dran nas glu 'di blangs pa shis gyur cig /1989lo'i dgun khar/ ldog tu med pa'i 'dun pa zhig gi 164
dbang gis slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gyi slob khrid stegs bu bskyur nas bya ba'i las gnas spor te mtsho sngon lho phyogs kyi rma lho rtswa thang du slebs pa dang / rma lho rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi yig sgyur khang du lo tsā ba'i bya ba sgrub pa yin/ rma lho rtswa thang gi snang tshul mtha' dag gis nga yi sems 'di dal cag ger 'dang rgyag gi nang du lhung par bcug myong la/rma lho rtswa thang gis nga la me tog gi 'jig rten zhig bstan pa tsam ma yin par de las kyang mang ba ni mi dang rang byung khams bar gyi 'thab rtsod drag po zhig dang / mi dang dud 'gro bar gyi mdza' brtse zab mo zhigmi dang mi'i bar gyi rtsod sems drag po zhig ste bgrang gis ma langs pa'i gtam rgyud gson po tag tag red/ de 'dra'i gtam rgyud la bltas nas khu sim mer lo ngo bsum lhag 'das song / 〈rdza thang gi 'char snang 〉dang 〈lcang sdong 〉kur+sā thang gi snang tshul dang nga yi sems〉〈mdzo mo 〉sosas ni skabs de'i snyan rtsom red/ /1993lo'i dbyar khar/ rma lho'i rtswa thang du me tog sna tshogs rnam par bzhad pa'i dus su/ bya ba'i dgos mkho'i dbang gis nga rang rma lho rtswa thang nas bya ba'i las gnas spor te lo ngo bcu la kha bral ba'i pha yul reb gong du slar yang 'byor zhing / rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul dmangs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi mi rigs chos lugs las don 165
u yon lhan khang du drung yig gi bya ba sgrub dgos byung / 'das zin pa'i lo ngo nyer brgyad kyi rkang rjes la phyir mig gis bltas tshe 'dzum mdangs lhang nger 'char pa'i skyid yod la/ mig chu thags se lhung pa'i sdug kyang yod/ nga rang 'tshar longs byung pa'i lo zla yis nga rang 'di 'dra'i lam zhig tu skyod dgos pa'i gshis ka 'di bskrun pa gor ma chag1994 6 14nyin reb gong du bris pa'o/166
rtsom rig la 'jug pa'i myong tshor thor bu/rdo rje gcod pas bris/gcigrtsom rig gi gzhung lugs kyis brtsams chos kyi spus tshad mthor 'degs gtong thub pa bden yang / lcags smyug lag tu bzung nas yid kyi 'gyur ba shog ngor phab pa'i tshe nga'i klad pa'i nang du rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs gtan nas 'char mi thub la/ gal te 'char par gyur tshe brtsams chos de legs po zhig tu 'gyur thub pa thengs gcig kyang byung ma myong /gnyis/rang gi 'tsho ba'i khrod byung myong pa'i don de rnams 'bri skabs/dran snang gi bye'u chung de yangs ba'i bar snang la gshog 'gyur byas te 167
brtsams chos kyi 'phel rim la rtog bzo yi 'gyur khugs ldan zhing/brtsams chos kyi rba rlabs dang bstun nas yid kyi 'gyur bar g.yo 'gul thebs srid la/ yid kyi 'gyur ba'i 'phyur 'jags la brten nas brtsams chos la nyams 'gyur 'byung srid/ brtsams chos kyi nyams 'gyur gyis klog pa por dga' ba'i spobs pa ster thub la/ skyo ba'i mig chu yang gtor bar bcug thub/ 'dzum mdangs dang mig chu gnyis ka rtsom rigs sgyu rtsal gyi longs spyod las byung ba'i bro ba mi 'dra ba gnyis yin la/ bro ba de gnyis las gang zhig nyams su myong yang des khyed kyi sems la skyid snang zhig ster pa ra nges/gsum/rang gis nyams su ma myong ba'i 'tsho ba zhig 'bri skabs/ mi cha yod cig la mi cha med cig gi gtam rgyud bshad pa ji bzhin nga la mtshon na ngal ba 'bras med red/ de'i phyir 'tsho ba ni rtsom rig gi 'byung khungs yin zer ba cis ma bden/bzhi/mi dmangs kyis ches sems 'khur byed bzhin pa'i don dag ni nga tshos nges par du 'bri dgos pa'i brtsam bya yin la/ klog pa po'i bsdu len gyi nus pa la brtsi 'jog byas na da gzod brtsams chos de yongs 'grub 'byung thub/168
lnga/rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs su khyad gzugs snang brnyan der yongs la khyab pa'i spyi yi mtshan ma dang rang kho nar khyab pa'i rang ldog gi mtshan ma gnyis ro gcig tu gyur na jibazang zer pa'i bshad srol yod/ 'on kyang ches gal che ba ni 'tsho ba'i gtan tshigs dang mthun la/ brjod bya zab cing nyams dang 'gyur bas klog mkhan gyi yid dbang 'gugs rgyu de red/drugrgyun goms kyi skad cha phal ba des ma shes4 pa'i don dag gsar pa'i don gsal por mtshon pa la brtsams chos gsar pa zer zhing /des klog mkhan gyi sems nas yal ba med pa'i snang brnyan skrun thub la/klog mkhan gyis ches dga' bsu byed pa'i brtsams chos kyang de las ma 'das/bdun/sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi nus pa dngos ma ni rtsom pa pos bstan pa'i nyams myong de klog pa po'i sems kyis nyams su ste yid ches skyes pa dang /de dang bstun nas yang bskyar nyams myong gson po zhig tu gyur pa dang /169
des nyams su myong mkhan gyi bsam blor phan nus thon thub/ de'i phyir klog pa pos nyams su myong mi thub pa'i brtsams chos de da rung gson po zhig tu 'gyur thub med/brgyad/rtsom yig gang dang gang zhig yin rung / thad dar du shes thub pa'i snang tshul steng gi brjod bya dang / bsam gzhigs byas nas shes dgos pa'i gnas tshul steng gi brjod bya re yod/ snang tshul ma shes na gnas tshul shas dka' bas nges par du snang tshul de gsal por brjod dgos/ dper na/ rdza mgor na bun cung zad yod na rgyang nas bltas kyang rdzo ri yin pa shes thub mod/ 'on kyang thams cad na bun stug pos g.yogs na rdza ri yin pa gtan nas mi shes ba bzhin du sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi nang du go ba lon thabs med pa'i bsdus brjod kyi sgyu rtsal bed spyad na sgyu rtsal du mi 'gro/dgungas bltas na/ bod rigs kyi rtsom pa pos bod rigs la skyon brjod byed par shin tu dga'/ gal te rtsom pa pos rtsom yig nang du dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi sgo nas rang mi rigs kyi skyon mtshang gi rtsa ba'i ngo bo dmar rjen du gsal ston byas yod na rang rigs kyi klog pa por skyon mtshang de rnams la bsam gzhigs kyis rang gi mi rigs kyi —170
'das dus kyi rmongs mun dang da lta'i zhan cha/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam sogs la rgyang lta byed rgyur skul ma dang phan nus chen po thon srid la/ rtsom pa po'i rang mi rigs kyi skyon cha sel nas legs lam du skyod rgyu'i 'dun pa yang mtshon thub/ 'on te mi su 'dra zhig gis kyang mi rigs shis gi skyon mtshang brjod skabs don dngos dang mthun dgos par ma zad yongs khyab kyi rang bzhin ldan dgos/ gal te don dngos dang mi mthun zhing yongs khyab kyi rang bzhin med par tshod med kyis mi re dga' ba'i skyon de mi rigs de ga'i mi spyi la khyab par byas nas skyon brjod byas na de ni mi rigs la gnya' gnon dang brnyas bcos byas pa zhig yin/bcu/deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 'di thog mar bstod pa'i tshogs pa zhig yin la/ de nas rnying zhen dang bag 'khum la dgag pa brgyab/ de'i rjes su go ba lon dka' ba'i rtsom yig khag cig byung /da lta ni tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi brjod bya gtso bo ston pa'i phyogs su rim gyis 'phel bzhin yod/ /171
mig gi bdud rtsir 'gyur ba'i mdzes sdug gi ri mo/rdo rje gtsod pa'i lhug rtsom bklags pa/phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gyi ri klung dang nags klong / rdza ri dang spang thang sogs la mun nag gi kha dog nag pos byugs/ kha dog nag po de je nag nas je nag tu 'gro ba'i mod la/ rgyu skor phreng ba'i chem chem gyi mig brda de je gsal nas je gsal du gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi mtshan mo'i gsang mthil mthong bar lkog lta byed pa bzhin/chem chem gyi mig 'od las yid tshim ba'i 'dzum mdangs shig kyang rang shugs su ston gyin gda'/ skabs 'dir/ mdun phyogs kyi ri rtse gnyis kyi bar nas 'od mdangs rnam par rgyas pa'i dngul dkar kyi sder ma chen po zhig rim gyis yar la 'phags/ de ni rgyu skar gyi rgyal po yin la/ gangs can pa rnams kyis de'i ming la zla ba zer/ thang chen 'di na gzugs brnyan ring thung gnyis gshibs nas yod de/ gcig ni nga dang / gzhan gcig ni nga'i grib gzugs yin/ ༷ ༷ lhug rtsom 〈zla 172
ba dang gangs dkar 〉bklags pas bdag gi mig lam du shar ba ni mtho sgang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i mdzes sdug ri mo zhig dang / skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i mkha' dbyings dang dngul dkar gyi sder mar 'khrul ba'i nya gang zla ba/ shel gyi lhun por mngon pa'i gangs dkar ri bo dang mtho sgang gi mtshan mor langs yod pa'i bdag bcas kyis grub pa'i ri mo zhig yin te/ ri mo'i nang gi bdag dang bdag gi grib gzugs gnyis ma 'grogs cing bdag kher rkyang du mtshan mor lus/ rgyu skar gyi mig 'od rim gyis nyams/ nga'i gam gyi gzugs brnyan de je thung du gyur/ bdag gi mig zhags je ring du gyur te thag ring gi zla ba dang gangs dkar la 'phangs/ rtsom pa pos mngon sum gyi ri mo las shin tu lkog gyur gyi gnas lugs zhig 'tshol bzhin mchis/ ri mo de la phyi rnam pa las 'das pa'i nang gi mtshon bya zhig yod nges shing / phyi'i kher rkyang gi myong tshor las nang bsam gzhigs kyi skar tshogs bkra chub dang /snyemasablos 'phangs pa'i mig zhags kyis zin pa'i zla ba dang gangs dkar las gzhan bla na med pa'i gtong phod kyi sems pa rnyed/ zla ba yod na/ da gzod mtshan mo'i gangs dkar gyi rang mdangs mthong pa dang / gangs dkar yod na/ da gzod zla ba'i yon tan mthong thub/gangs dkar kyis zla ba la 'khang ra byas myong med la zla bas gangs dkar la sbyin pa ma btang ba'ang med/ phan tshun gyi bar thag ni je nye nas je nye dang 'dzum mdangs kyang je rgyas nas je rgyas su song /spyir brtse sems mtshon pa'i lhug rtsom la ni mngon la mi mngon pa'i 173
brtse sems kyi mu tig bstar la brgyus pa'i phreng thag zhig yod la/ rtsom pa pos phreng thag 'di brgyud nas brtse sems kyi phreng ba bgrang ngo / /〈zla ba dang gangs dkar〉gyi phreng thag ni mtshan mo'i mkha' dbyings su 'phags pa'i zla ba dang thag ring 'dzin ma'i lto bar brjid pa'i gangs dkar gnyis yin/ rtsom pa pos rtsom 'gor kho'i mtshar sdug gi ri mo de 'bri bar ras yog rnam par brdal pas ri mo'i rgyab ljongs ni mun nag gi kha dog gis byugs pa'i nam mkha'i 'og tu ri klung dang nags klung /rdza ri dang spang thang rnams je nag tu 'gro ba'i srod dus su skar tshogs kyi mig chem chem du gsal zhing / thang chen du bdag gi grib ma gnyis langs yod pa dang / yud tsam nas mun nag gi mkha' dbyings su dngul dkar gyi sder ma lta bu'i zla ba shar byung / bdag gi mig zhags ni thag ring du 'gying zhing brjid pa'i gangs dkar la 'phangs pas ri mo'i spyi khog yongs su grub cing / de yang ri mo 'di'i grub cha gtso bo ni zla ba dang gangs dkar yin la gzhan dag ni de'i rgyab ljongs dang rgyan nam grogs su gyur pa'o/ /de nas dbyibs dang kha dog thog nas bdag gi grib ma ni je thung du gyur zhing rgyu skar gyi mig 'od nyams song /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi ri klung dang nags klung / rdza ri dang spang thang dag ni mun nag gi skabs su bkrag mdangs med la zla ba dang gangs dkar ni dkar gsal gyi mdangs dang bcas te yar 'phags zhing / gzugs brnyan de dag las 64ngas 99ni zla bas gangs dkar gyi rang mdangs mthong pa dang gangs dkar gyis zla ba'i yon tan mtshon 174
pa'i phan tshun brten grogs su 'gyur ba'i bden don gyi gnas lugs shig rnyed byung /lhug rtsom gyi brtse dung bcol sa'i gzhi ni skyes bu'i mig gi bdud rtsir gyur ba'i ri mo zhig yin te/ ri mo 'di la mdzes sdug gi rnam pa ldan ma zad/ da dung mtho sgang na 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i bod mi'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs dang mi tshe/ ri klung spang thang sogs kyang ri mo 'di'i nang bsdus pas nang bcud kyi yon tan gyis rnam par gtams/rtsom pa pos kho'i brtse dung dang bsam blo/ kho'i tshe srog bcas ri mo 'di dag la bcol pa dper na kho'i 〈kha ba〉zhes pa'i lhug rtsom 'di'ang kho'i brtse sems mtshon byed kyi ri mo zhig yin/ 'di las rtsom pa pos kha ba'i mdzes sdug gi rnam pa zhig zhib tu bris pa ma zad/ da dung pha yul gyi kha ba dang kha ba'i rdul brtsegs te/ 'di las rtsom pa pos kha ba'i mdzes sdug gi rnam pa zhib 'bri byas shing / pha yul gyi kha ba dang kha ba'i rdul brtsegs te gangs ri sogs bris nas bod gangs can gyi yun ring gi lo rgyus dang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs mtshon pa dang / rtsom pa pos kha ba la snying thag pa nas dga' zhen byed pa'i brtse sems dag kyang shugs nas mtshon yod/ 'on kyang rtsom pa pos kha ba'i rnam pa zhib 'bri byed pa'i smyug kha'i stangs stabs bsgyur pas klog mkhan gyi mdzes rig la lta ba'i mig kyang rnam par bsgyur te/ dper na de las/thengs shig la/ kha ba mthug po zhig babs byung bas/ a mas nga 'khur nas slob grwar 'gro skabs/ ngas phyir mig bltas nas bsdad pa 175
na/ a ma'i kyag kyog tu gyur ba'i rkang rjes ni rgyang ringatsho po 'then 'dugrkang rjes ni ji 'dra'i zab mo zhig dang / ji 'dra'i kyag gyog ji 'dra'i ring po zhig red ang / gal te nga a ma'i rgyab tu med rgyu na/rkang rjes de 'dra zab mo zhig e yin nam/ slob grwa grol rjes ngas a ma'i rkang rjes la brten nas khyim du log thub snyam pa'i spobs pa skyes byung / nyin de'i nyin gong la/ yang kha ba'i 'dab ma 'jo lo lo babs byung / nga khyim la log skabs/ a ma'i rkang rjes brten nas 'gro dgos bsams kyang/ a ma'i rkang rjes ni sngar nas kha bas mnan 'dug pas shul tsam yang mthong rgyu med pa ma zad/ ngas tshod dpag kyang byed ma thub/ nyin der/ ngas thengs dang por kha ba la ngan bshad byas te kha ba ma babs na a ma'i rkang rjes zab mo de gsal por mthong bar nges/ 99 zhes gcig lab byas/ zhes pa lta bu yin/rtsom pa pos ma yum gyis kha ba nang bzhag pa'i zhabs rjes de btsal pa brgyud nas rang nyid kyi sems khong gi skyo snang mtshon pa dang / dus mtshungs su klog mkhan rnams la'ang bsam gzhi zhig bstsal pa ni rab btags kyi thabs jus bkod pa dang don dngos su ma brjod pas brjod bya gzhan zhig yod pa yin nam snyam pa'i snang ba zhig 'gog med du skyes/rtsom pa po'i gzengs bstod nang gi 'khang ra dang dga' zhen nang gi skyo snang 'di ni lo rgyus la phyir mig bltas pa dang 'byung 'gyur la mos 'dun bcangs pa'i bsam pa bstan pa zhig yin zhing / bod kyi lo rgyus 'phel rgyas song nas deng gi dus su 'od stong 'bar ba dang gzi brjid 176
ldan pa'i rnam pa 'di lta bu zhig tu chags pa dang / de ni mes po rnams kyis dka' ngal kyi lam 'phrang mang du brgyud pa dang dga' spro dang skyo snang yang mang du myangs pa las byung ba yin/ de yang da lta'i lo rgyus kyi 'gan khur ljid mo ni deng rabs kyi na gzhon rnams kyi phrag tu lhung zhing /nga tshos lo rgyus kyi 'phrang lam rnying pa de brgyud nas lo rgyus bskyar bzlas bya dgos sam bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi 'gros dang bstun nas kha ba'i ljongs su lam gsar pa zhig gtod dgos/ 'di ni nga tshos gom pa ma spel gong du bsam blo gtong dgos pa zhige yin te/ de yang lhug rtsom 'di las/ nga tsho'i dus rabs 'dir dgos pa ni/ gangs ri la bkrag mdangs 'phros pa'i nyi 'od dang / gangs ri la dkar mdangs chags pa'i zla zer yin la/ de bas kyang mkho ba ni bkrag mdangs 'phros pa'i gangs dkar lhun po dang / dkar mdangs chags pa'i kha ba'i rdul brtsegs yin pa las/ kha ba'i 'dab ma ni ye nas min zhes pa lta bu yin/ gangs ri'i gzi brjid mngon byed kyi nyi zla zung la mos pa 'di ni rtsom pa pos dngos yod gnas tshul la brtag dpyad kyi blo mig phyogs pa dang bsam gzhigs kyi dri bzang 'thul pa zhig ci'i phyir ma yin nam/rdo rje gcod pa'i lhug rtsom 〈sems kyi 'bod sgra/ gangs dkar lha mor phul ba'i mchod pa〉dang / 〈〈 thang / me tog gi 'jig rten〉/ 〈mdzo mo〉/ 〈lcang sdong 〉sogs kyang rtswa thang gi mdzes sdug mngon byed kyi me long lta bu yin pa ma zad rtsom pa po'i sems khong du 177
gnas pa'i brtse dung gi ri mo mtshon byed kyi mdzes ris zhig kyang yin te/lhug rtsom 'di dag las rtsom pa pos mdzes sdug ldan pa'i yul ljongs kyi tshon ris bzhengs pa dang dngos yod 'tsho ba'i thang chen du skyid sdug gi me tog btus pas/ klog mkhan dag gis kyang khong gi nang sems kyi skyid sdug dga' sdang sogs rtogs pa dang rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i myong tshor gyis der grogs su sdeb bzhin mchis/ rdo rje gcod pa'i lhug rtsom 〈mdzo mo 〉'di'ang brtse sems kyi dri ngad 'thul pa'i spos rdzing zhig ste/rtsom pa pos bdag dang mdzo mo'i 'brel ba dang bdag 'tshar longs byung ba'i lo zla bcas zhib 'bri byas pa las klog mkhan la sems bskyed zhig gnang pa ni gangs ljongs ma yum gyi 'o ma'i drin las bdag gi lus byung zhing cher bskyed pa dang / gangs can rig mdzod kyis bdag gi blo sems bskrun pa/ rtsom pa po'i sems kyis mdzo mo dang ma yum brgyud nas gangs ljongs dang bod mi rigs la 'khyud cing / 'o ma las ni rang rigs kyi gzhan phan gyi bsam pa dang gtong phod kyi snying stobs byung pa mtshon no/ / lhug rtsom du mdzo mo dang ma yum/ bod mi rigs bcas la bla na mtho ba'i rtsem sems bcangs pa dang gzengs su bstod kyang shugs las yid rmugs pa'i skyo snang zhig kyang ngang ngam shugs su thon te/ rtsom pa pos mdzo mo'i ṅga sa 'khogs kyi nyams 'gyur mthong pas yid kyi phye thang du skyo snang gi rlung dmar drag tu ldang bar gyur la/ rtsom pa pos gangs ljongs dang rang rigs la bcangs pa'i yid kyi dwangs pa dang sems kyi brtse ba/ dga' zhen dang skyo snang rnams blo spobs dang 178
snying stobs su bsgyur te gangs ljongs ma yum gyi 'o drin gyis gsos pa'i bu phrug rnams la 'od stong 'bar ba'i lo rgyus kyis 'byung 'gyur gyi tshab byas mi thub la mtshar sdug ldan pa'i kha sang gis de ring gi tshab byas mi thub pa gdams yod/ gzi brjid ldan zhing bstod 'os pa'i lo rgyus dang rig gnas 'di rnams deng 'dir khur bo zhig tu mi mthong bar gyis shig nga tsho'i phrag tu lhung ba'i las 'gan ni yang mo zhig ma yin pa'o/rdo rje gcod pa'i lhug rtsom phal che ba zhig ni shugs bstan gyi brjod bya yin pas klog pa'i skabs su'ang gsal la mi gsal ba'i mdzes rig gi myong tshor zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis ster zhing / klog pa'i tshe sems kyi ngang ba ni khos bskrun pa'i brtse dungs kyi mtsho mor rnam par rol thub pa ma zad/ khong nyid kyi sgyug kha'i dri bzhon gyis rnam par bskyod pa'i thigs phreng re re yis gnyid blo rgya skyed thub pa dang / kho'i 〈tswa thang wa wa me tog gi 'jig rten 〉las khyod char chu dang zil ba'i khrod du gang bu sbrum zhing / bser bu dang nyi 'od kyi khrod du rtsa lam rgyas te/ rtswa thang gi nyin mo la mdzes sdug gi lang tsho gsar ba phul byung /zhes pa lta bu klog pa'i tshe mig gis me tog gi mdzes ba'i rnam pa mthong ba dang dus mnyam du bsam gzhigs kyi me long tu 'brog mi'i 'tsho ba'i rnam pa gsar pa'ang ma bsam bzhin du 'char ba red/ rtsom pa po rdo rje gcod pa ni rang nyid kyis dmigs pa'i brjod don gyi ri mo ni rgyab ljongs sam khor yug zhib 'bri byed pa las byung ba zhig kyang yin te/179
dper na zla 'od dang gangs ri/ yangs pa'i rtswa thang du khor rkyang du 'greng ba'i nga sogs lta bu dang / bang rtsal rgyas pa'i rta pho dang / sha shed rgyas pa'i nor lug sngo zhing yangs pa'i rtswa thang sogs dang / kha ba dang yum gyi zhabs rjes/ yum gyis rgyab tu khur ba'i nga sogs lta bu yin/ mig mthong lag zin med pa'i yid kyi spyod yul kho na las byung ba'i khor yug 'di las klog pa pos thun mong ma yin pa'i dran tshul zhig rtogs thub cing / gzhan yang de las/ nyin re bzhin yar la skye skabs/ khyod dang gnas kyi bar thag ji nye yin/ ngo ma/ dgung a sngon yang de 'dra'i mthon po zhig ma red ya/ khyod kyi rtsa ba sa 'og tu brkyangs skabs/ ma yum sa gzhi'i rang bzhin ni je nyid je snyid red/dngos gnas/ sa gzhi yang brtse med kyi sra mkhregs rang bzhin can zhig ga la yin zhes brjod pa lta bu yin/ sa dang gnam/ rtswa thang dang me tog rang byung khams dang mi bcas 'gal med gcig mthun du gnas pa'i mdzes sdug gi tshor snang zhig dang / 'gal med gcig mthun gyi khor yug las 'das pa'i snang ba zhig kyang ster/ rdo rje gcod pa'i lhug rtsom 'di dag ni brjod bya don gyis phyug cing rjod byed tshig gi tshon ris rnam par bkra ba'i mdzes ris zhig yin zhing / de bklags pa —na blo rgya ches cher bskyed cing nyams 'gyur gyi ro bcud rmad du byung ba zad med ldan pa zhig yin no/ /180
dkon mchog skyabs kyi lo rgyus/kha ba shin tu mthug pa'i zhogs pa der mtho sgang gi 'brog khyim zhig tu btsas dus/ lo rabs drug cu ba'i 'brug gi lo yin skad/ rma chu dang 'bri chu'i 'go khungs kho'i pha sa red la/ e ma mtsho sngon po'i glu ngag gi 'byung khungs kho'i ma sa yin pas ljang tig tig gi rtswa thang de nas khos rkang rjen du be'u rdzi byas myong la/ a ma'i thal lcag gi drin na snum stug ge'i dpe deb cig 'khyer nas slob grwa brgyud myong /dus nam zhig gi tshe/ srol rgyun gyi lta ba mkhregs po dang dus rabs kyi 'du shes gsar ba'i phog thug bar nas kho rang chas ar bha hi'i 44dbul po tshos da gzod lha phyug por dad pa byed 〉〉ces pa'i legs bshad la rlom pa gyur/ de mur khor rang skya mi thub pa'i gsar byung gi lta ba mang du byung la de ga gzhan la lab gleng bya rgyu'i ched du rtsom rig la 'dris 'dang che bar gyur/ de nas bzung 〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du〉'am 〈rig ma bde mtsho 〉 (sgrung gtam ste 〈 smrang char〉 du)/kushugs kyis blangs pa'i glu〉 (lhug rtsom snyan ngag tshan pa gsum ste 〈gangs rgyan me tog〉 tu)/ 〈 〈 thang gi bu mo〉 (9 sprang char〉)/181
〈'bar khams kyi bu lo〉(〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉)/ 〈dur sngog mkhan pha bu gnyis〉 (khrag gsum ste 〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉)sogs pa'i snyan rtsom 'ga' dang gzhan 〈gling sgrung las khro thung dang khro thung gi gshis rgyud la dpyad pa〉(gling ge sar shes rig skor gyi rgyal spyi'i gros mol tshogs 'du thengs gnyis pa'i ched bdams dpyad rtsom ste 〈shes bya'i zegs ma〉ru)dang kujing ger rgyal po'i rtogs brjod〉(sgyur rtsom ste go bzhi lor ldan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun)bcas pa'i brtsams chos rdog re 'bri khul byas mod/ da phan phyi 'dang zhig brgyab tshe/ rtsom mkhan rang lan pas los yin gyi/brtsams chos de dag mtsho sngon po'i nang du rdo 'phangs pa bzhin grags 'gul ci yang med par gyur 'dug pa 'di ci 'dra'i yid skyo ba la ang /'on kyang / rdo steng gi nyi 'od bldag pa'i lu gu ltogs pa de dang khangs gseb kyi rtswa skya dgum pa'i rta nag sgrog 'gros de dran la/ mes po'i gzhu rgyud du skam pa'i mda' mo'i gzas sa de bsam na kho yang bskyar rang snang mthon po des bkyags la stong sems spar mo gang brang khar sbyar nas 64'grul bzhud 〉〉kyi las su chas dgos 'duggnam mtha' nas gnam mthar snyeg r+yaṃ 'i sprin dkar gyi tshom bu ya/ sa mtha' nas sa mthar 'khyams pa'i 'brog phrug de'i las skal mtshon/ /1 khos rang blor 'bab pa'i brtsams chos ni kushugs kyis blangs pa'i glu 〉las 〈brjed du med pa'i sgrol dkar ma〉dang 〈li yul gyi rna lung ma〉red la/ blor mi 'bab pa ni 〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du〉182
zhes pa 'o/2 kho rang ches dga' sa'i legs bshad ni/ 〈 ge sar sgrung 〉las/pha ni dkon mchog dang po yin/ /ma ni dkon mchog gnyis pa yin/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum pa yin/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa de'o/2 98mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i kha sang gis de ring gi tshab byed mi nus 99na/ nga tshos mar kho sis4srol rgyun gyi rtog ge'i gzhung lugs ji snyed kyis 'jig rten la 'grel brgyab pa red mod gnad 'gag 'jig rten bsgyur bcos byed par thug ces pa'i man ngag 'dir yid rton byed 'os snyam/ de bas rtsom rig gsar bar phyogs pa'i 44gzhun nu mgo yangs 〉〉dag la babs che ba ni nga tsho'i snyu gu des srol rgyun gyi lta ba mkhregs por rgol rdung dang gangs ljongs kyi gnas bab bsgyur bcos byed pa'i lam snyon sgron me nyan dgos pa'o/ de bas kho bos bzod gsol byed thabs bral ba ni 89sngon byon mkhas pas ma bshad pa bshad mi nyan 〉〉la/ sngon byon mkhas pas ma las pa las mi nyan pa'i bsam blo de'o/ /9183
mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i kha sang gis de ring gi tshab byed mi thub/ dkon mchog skyabs kyi zang thung 〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du 〉bklags pa'i 'char snang /dkon mchog skyabs ni 〈dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa 〉zhes bya ba'i dpe cha'i nang du bkod pa'i rtsom pa po zhig yin pas/ 1995lo'i dbyar dus bdag bsam gzas nas mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi rma lho khul du rtsom mkhan la 'tshams 'dri zhu bar song zhing / rtsom mkhan gyis nga rang gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar kho'i pha yul gser lung du phyin pa dang / de ga'i rtse chu sngon mo ni dwangs bsil rnyog ma bral zhing / mtha' yas rtswa thang du rta nor lug gsum mchong lding gar la rol ba dang / mu mtha' bral zhing bslu brid kyi byed las ldan pa'i g.yu mdog gis nga rang rang byung khams chen po'i mdzes shing blta na sdug pa'i yul ljongs su khrid nas rtsom pa po'i pha yul gyi mdzes ljongs 'dren byed zung gi bdud tsir 'gyur thub pa byung / rtse chu'i 'gram gyi rtswa thang steng du 'phub pa'i sog gur 184
gyis jing gir rgyal po'i zhabs rjes bzhag shul mngon pa mtshon bzhin yod cing / ri bo hi ma la ya'i gangs chus rtswa thang brlan par byas pas/skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba lta bu'i dge mtshan gyis khyab 'dug dus der bdag la rtsom mkhan ji lta bu zhig yin pa'i cha rgyus cung zad lon no snyam pa'i snang ba zhig byung / da thengs nged gnyis 'grogs te song zhing / rtsom mkhan gyis skad cha mang po mi bshad na yang / kho'i bab chags pa'i rnam 'gyur las bdag gis kho'i brtsams chos kyi khyad chos mngon sum du mthong ste/ de ni khos 64mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i kha sang gis de ring gi tshab byed mi thub 〉〉ces bshad pa dang yang dag mtshungs/bdag gis kho'i sgrung thung 〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du 〉zhes pa'i skor gleng ba'i tshe/ kho na re/ de ni khos yag po 'bri ma thub pa'i sgrung thung zhig yin zhes bshad cing / kho la de'i rgyu mtshan dris pa na/kho na re/ gtam rgyud ni bden pa bden thub cig yin mod/ 'on kyang slob grwa chen mo'i skabs su bris pa zhig yin pas/ da lta de la bltas na blor mi 'bab sa mang po zhig yod ces bshad byung / rtsom mkhan gyis thad kur dris lan ma btab mod/ 'on kyang ngas bltas na de la dris lan btab yod snyam pya dang / khos bdag dang klog mkhan rnams brtsams chos kyi rgya mtsho'i klong du khrid nas mno bsam gyi gser mig 'dzin par bskul byung /6tsanga'i brtsams chos de dag ni mtsho la g.yugs pa'i rdo ba ji bzhin 185
grags 'gul ci yang med 〉〉ces dkon mchog skyabs kyis khengs skyung dang bcas te kho'i brtsams chos kyi skor gleng zhing / de ni khos dus rgyun par yar thon yong bar brtson pa dang gsar gtod byed pa don du gnyer ba'i gtam zhig yin te/ dper na kho'i lhug rtsom 〈bdag gi pha sa dang ma sa 〉zhes pa'i nang du/ gnam mtha' nas gnam mtha' snyeg pa'i sprin dkar gyi tshom bu de rang sa dang mngon sum 'tsho ba la rgyun chad med par rjes 'ded 'tshol zhib byed pa'i 'brog phrug 88nga 99dang 'dra bar pha sa dang ma sa dar rgyas gong 'phe' dang / mes po'i mdzad rjes kyi rgyun 'dzin pa de 'bri chu ring ba'i phugs 'dun snyeg pa'i ched du 'bad brtson lhur len byed bzhin yod ces bris pa dang gcig tu mtshungs/ rtsom pa po'i khyad chos de nyid rtsom mkhan la dngos su thug pa'i skabs der mig lam du gzugs brnyan ji bzhin 'char gyin 'dugzam mi 'chad par 'thus tshang du gtong ba dang/ gsar gtod byed pa/don du gnyer pa bcas kyi khrod du mi'i 'gro ba'i bden lugs yod cing/sgrung thung 〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du 〉zhes pa lta bu ni rtsom mkhan gyi blor mi 'bab pa'i brtsams chos yin pa dang / snying stobs de 'dras kho la sngar las lhag pa'i brtsams chos gsar du rtsom dgos pa'i blang bya 'don bzhin yod las che mod/ 'on kyang sgrung thung de bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi dpe tshogs 〈gtsang po'i pha rol 〉zhes pa'i nang du bkod yod par brtag na/ de la tshab byed kyi rang bzhin dang bris legs pa'i yon tan zhig yod par gdon mi za'i/ /186
1 〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du 〉zhes pa'i sgrung thung de ni lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i dus stod du gsar rtsom byas pa zhig yin pas/skabs de'i bod kyi rtsom rig la cha mtshon nas bshad na/ de la dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos nyams su myong ba'i lta tshul zhig bton zhing / rtsom mkhan rang nyid kyi gzugs brnyan las drangs pa'i mi sna ang gsum pa dpal ldan la brten nas sgrung gtam gyi byung rim rgya bskyed pa dang /brjod bya'i don gyi sdun bsus te sems bsam pa'i gting nas mi sna gtso bo'i las dbang la thun mong gi bsam tshul gasna tshogs shig 'byung thub pas/gtam rgyud de ni bden pa bden thub yin pa'i snang ba zhig skyes su 'jug pa ste/ khrims rar 'dri gcod byed pa nas blo gsal dang lha mo/de gnyis kyi tsha mo dang bu skal ma yum skyid la sogs pa'i bar gyi dga' sdug skyo gsum gyi gnas tshul bris yod/ sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna yum skyid chur lcebs skabs shul du bzhag pa'i kha chems kyi yi ge gzhir bzhag byas te gtam rgyud dkyis su spel zhing / phyugs las kyis ta krer slob pa'i las 'gul rgya cher spel ba'i slad du pha yar blo gsal dar gdamar kung hrer slebs pa dang/ dza de gar kung hre'i sman khang du las ka byed pa'i bu mo yum skyid la btsan g.yem byas te yid skyo ba'i gtam rgyud cig byung / de nas bu mo yum skyid kyi lus sems gnyis ka lan gcig min par nyams nyes par byas shing /nga ma yar lha mo dang khyim mtshes zha'o hwa dag gis mo la ngan smras dang mthong 4chung byas stabs/ yum skyid kyi snying 187
dbus su yun ring nyal ba'i zhe sdang gi me lce dang skyo ngal gyi rba rlabs lhan cig tu 'phyur ba dang / de nas zhe sdang dang skyo ngal de ni spyod lam ngan pa dang / stobs shugs ngan pa/ sdug bsngal bcas la drag tu rgol ba'i dpa' snying du gyur pa dang / mos rang srog rang gis gcod pa'i thabs kyis khrims lugs dang spyi tshogs la 'khang ra byed bzhin yod/'chi ba zhes pa ni yi mug cing skyo ba slong cig yin na yang / rtsom mkhan gis tshe srog gsar ba 'thob pa dang bde skyid don du gnyer bar yid smon byed pa'i bsam tshul mngon sum gsar rjen du mtshon yod/khrims lugs kyis yum skyid lcebs pa'i gyod don de la drang bo drang bzhag gis dpyad zhib byas te nyes can blo gsal la bca' khrims ltar nyes chad bcad pa red/ sgrung thung 'di ni phar bltas na sems kyi sdug bsngal mtshon byed kyi rtsom rig gi khyad chos 'dzin pa lta bu zhig tu snang ste/rtsom 'di'i nang du rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes bya ba'i dus ngan shar ba'i skabs kyi 'brog pa'i khyim tshang dkyus ma zhig gi yid skyo bldi gnas tshul bris yod pa'i phyir/ dar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig la cha mtshon nas bshad na/ 'bri stangs de ni dge mtshan ldan zhing / brjod bya'i don la dus rabs kyi khyad chos yod pa dang / mang nyung rgyas bsdus bcas la gzhan dring mi 'jog par 'das pa'i dus kyi ba kag rgya las thar ba zhig yin/ mi gshis la 'tshol zhib dang sems khral byed 'dod kyis rtsom rig la dgag bzhag dang mtha' dpyod byed pa'i srol de nyid bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi gleng rar 188
legs par bsus pas/ rtsom mkhan gyis brtsams chos blor mi 'bab pa ni sems khral de'i rigs la 'brel ba yod shas che ba dang / khos gtam rgyud zol med bden pa 'ani nyid gzhan la brjod 'dod med na yang / mngon sum 'tsho ba'i khrod canas yid skyo ba'i gnas tshul de 'dra yang zam mi 'chad par 'byung mi srid —par smon pa'i sems kyis sgrung gtam 'di bris pa red/ sgrung gtam nang du rtsom mkhan gyis blo bzang gis bu skal ma'i khyim gyi ma ṇi 'khor lo rnying ba de yum skyid la 'jigs snang skur ba'i rgyu ru byas pas/ yum skyid kyis gcan gzan ltar gdug rtsub che ba'i blo gsal gyi re ba mi skong ka med du gyur tshul bris yod cing / tshig rgyun thung ngu des skabs sgyude'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul kunaji zol med bden pa'i nyams kyis mtshon yod/ 44 gral srim 'thab rtsod 〉〉byed pa'i gdug rtsub che ba'i dngos don dang rnying bzhi gtor ba'i log lam du 'phyan pa zhib tu 'bri skabs/ thog mar ma ṇi 'khor lo rnying ba de yid skyo ba'i gnas tshul 'di 'byung rkyen nyag cig tu byas yod cing / lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring gi chos lugs kyi 'og rgyus — ldan pa'i mi rigs shig la cacha mtshon nas bshad na de la bsam blo dpyis phyin pa zhig gtong ltarin yod/ lo bcu phrag gcig lhag tu son pa'i bu mo yum skyid ni las 'gul des brlag cing / blo gsal ni sgrub byed kyi rang bzhin mnga' ba'i mi sna zhig dang /rin thang mthar phyin par mtshon pa'i khyad chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i mi sna zhig dang / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kyi g.yon thal lam phyogs 189
mtshon byed kyi mi sna zhig 64gral rim 'thab rtsod me byed pa'i gdong len pa zhig bcas kyang yin/ yum skyid kyis kho la 'khang gtam bshad pa dang / khrims lugs kyis kho la 'dri gcod byed pa bcas ni spyi tshogs thog tu gnas pa ste rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skyon la zhib tu brtag pa'i rtags mtshan zhig yin pas/ skabs de'i bod kyi rtsom rig la cha mtshon nas bshad na de ni lo rgyus dang dus rabs kyi don snying ldan pa zhig yin/2 bdag gis rtsom pa po dang gleng mol byed skabs/ khos sngon dus bris pa'i ched rtsom 〈gling sgrung las khro thung dang khro thung gi gshis rgyud la dpyad pa 〉zhes pa de'i skor gleng ba yid kyi me long ngos su shar zhing / rtsom yig de'i nang du khro thung gi gshis rgyud 'dra min gnyis la zhib tu dpyad cing / mi gshis kyi dge sdig dang bzang ngan sogs rtsod sgrub kyis gcig gyur byed pa'i khrod du mi sna'i gshis rgyud grub lugs dang 'phel rgyas 'gro tshul bcas la dpyad pa zhib mo zhig btang yod pa dang /de ni dko na mchog skyabs kyis mi sna gtso bor tshod 'dzin byed pa dang/khos mi sna'i gshis rgyud 'bri bzhengs byed pa'i gzhi'am rtsa ba bcol sa zhig kyang yin/ 〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du 〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtayonang gi mi sna lha mo ni rtsom mkhan gyis mi gshis 'dra min gnyis ldan pa zhig tshod 4lta byed bzhin 'bri bzhengs byas pa red/ khos bshad pa ltar sgrung gtam 'di ni kho'i thog ma'i dus kyi brtsams chos shig yin 190
pa sa/ tshig don gyi nyams rtsol med lhun gyis thon yod pa zhig mim te/sgrung gtam gyi nang du kho'i lta tshul yongs su gsal bar byed pa'i gsar rtsom gyi bsam blo zhig mtshon med pa'i phyir/ gal srid rtsom mkhan gyis phyis 'byung gi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mi sna de dag rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi byed thabs phul du byung ba legs par spyad nas gson nyams ldan pa'i mi sna 'bri bzhengs byed pa yin na/ 4khos mi sna gtso bor tshod 'dzin byed pa de ni khos sgrung gtam gsar rtsom byed pa'i rtsom gshis shig tu 'gyur srid pa dang / khos 'bri bzhengs byas pa'i lha mo'i steng na rtsom gshis de ldan pa mngon par mtshon yod/ sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna blo gsal gyi chung ma lha mos rang nyid kyi tsha mo chu la lcebs nas tshe las 'das pa rtogs rjes/ mi'i sems gting du nyal ba'i zhe sdang gi stobs kyis mo la mchi ma bzhur du ma bcug cing / gnyen nyi dang dus gtan du bral yang sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rdul phran tsam yang med pa dang / mo la yod pa ni rang khe rang phan gyi bsam pa dang sdang sems sha stog yin/ lha mos shul du bzhag pa'i tsha mo yum skyidang kyi kha chems yi ge bklags pa na/ tsha mo yum skyid kyis sdug bsngal sna tshogs myangs pa ste zhe skyo ba'i gnas tshul ji ltar byung ba shes rjes/ dug khongabar song ba lta bu'i blo 'gyod skyes pa dang chabs cig tu 66sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung zhing / mig zung las mchi ma ni dbang med9 du shor gsong /29 lha mos rang gi tsha mo yum skyed snying rje ba dang / sems phangs pa/ bsam tshul shes pa bcas la brten nas mchi ma zhig mu tig gi phreng thag chad pa ltar bzhur ba dang /191
mo'i sems kyi sdug 4bsngal de nyid mchi ma'i rgyun dang 'grogs te phyi ru bzhur byung / lha mos dbugs ring nar zhes 'byin pa des mo'i nang sems kyi 'jig rten 'di lan gcig min par zab gsal yangs gsum du gyur pa mtshon pa dang / mos rang nyid kyi dga' sdang gi 'du shes de nyid dpa' snying dang stobs shugs su bsgyur te khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du langs nas yum skyid la bden dpang byed pa dang 44mi dmangs kyi spyi dgra 〉〉la nyes chad bcad yin/ sgrung gtam gyi nang du dkon mchog skyabs kyis khor yug gi khyad chos dang rnam pa bcas la dmigs nas thabs mkhas kyis mi sna'i gshis rgyud 'bri bzhengs byas yod de/ a ce lha mos rang nyid dang mnyam du sdod pa'i zha'o hwa bos te nam gung gi dus su mo dang 'grogs nas khyim 'a/ 'gro ba'i tshe/ 66 grang rlung 'ur 'ur du ldang zhing skyi bser rlung gis bslangs pa'i sa rdul gyis snying rje med par gdong la 'brab na yang a ce lha mos grang rlung gdong gis bsus te gom stabs chen pos bgrod pa 〉〉zhes rtsom mkhan gyis khor yug zhib 'bri byas pa'i sdeb legs snyan pa'i tshig sbyor spyad nas lha mo'i gnya' mi chag pa'i gshis rgyud khung sems gting gi sdug bsngal bcas mngon par mtshon yod pa lta bu yin/ lha mo'i skyid sdug dga' sdang sogs mi gtam rgyud kyi brjod rim la 'gyur ldog byung ba dang bstun nas 'phel 'gyur ci risas byung bas/ sgrung gtam gyi brjod rim des yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog pa zhig tu 'gyur ba'i thad la nisnga na med pa'i snyan nyams shig gsar du bsnan yod/192
〈khrims lugs kyi rgya ma'i steng du 〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam 'di ni dkon mchog skyabs kyis lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i dus stod rdu bris pa'i rtsom rig gi dpyad gzhi'i me long dang rtsom rig la bsam gzhigs byas pa zhig yin/ khos rtsom gyi rnam pa de lta bu spyad nas lo rabs bdun cu —ba'i dus stod du byung ba'i zol med bden pa'i gtam rgyud bris te khrims lugs dang spyi tshogs kyis mi gshis la 'dri gcod byed pa de nyid log par bsgyur ba sogs mtshon yod/ de'i thad nas bshad na rtsom mkhan gyis gsar rtsom byed sems ni rgya mtsho las gting zab pa zhig yin/gsar rtsom byed pa'i skabs su kho'i ches thog ma'i dus kyi bsam pa'i 'khyer so gzhir bzhag byas te thog mtha' bar gsum du rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtso ma gshis 'thon du bcug yod/ de'i nang du spyi tshogs kyi bsam tshul zhig blo'i rgyan du bzung nas spyi tshogs thog gi skyon rnams gsal bshad byas shing / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kyi spyi tshogs hril bor 'gyur ldog byung ba dang / mi rigs shig gi las dbang gi 'du shes sogs sor mo'i 'dun byed kyis zhib tu bris yod la/ rtsom mkhan rang nyid kyang spung go'i lo rgyus kyis spyi tshogs la sprad pa'i 'gan 'khri sgrub pa'i las su zhugs pa dang / rtsom rig gi rnam pa spyad nas mi gshis kyi dge sdig gi 4 khyad par la blo zhib mos brtag par brtson na /phyis 'byung khos gsar rtsomo byed pa sngar las khyad du 'phags shing /gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur nges yin/ blo phangs pa zhig la rtsom mkhan gyis rtsom mdzug tu 98chang ga gi skor bris yod cing /193

byed pa'i bsam blo'i sgyu rtsal ni gtso bo zhig yin pa dang / rtsom mkhan gyis thog mar bris pasne'i rtsom yig las kho'i bsam pa'i brtse dung zab nas zab tu song ba dang 'bri stangs kyang sngar las je legs su gyur tshul mthong thub pa yin/ rtsom yig 〈byas nyes 〉las/ khos yul lha gzhi bdag gi sgo zog wa mo dmare chung bsad pa'i dbang gis sems su dogs pa dang rnam rtog ci rigs kyi sdug bsngal sa gsum gyis mi theg pa byung zhing / dus phyis 'gal zla'i rgya las thar tshul zhib tu bris nas rgan pa rnams kyi yid ches dang / sngags pa'i ham sems/ skal bzang gi dngangs skrag dang sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems pa bcas mngon sum gsal rjen du mtshon yod/ gal srid rtsom mkhan gyis gong gsal gyi rtog pa'i 'gyu ba de lta bu gzhir bzhag byas te bris pa na/ ngas bltas na kho'i 〈byas nyes 〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam 'dir yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog pa'i yon tan du ma zhig ldan par 'gyur mod/'on kyang yid phangs pa zhig la sgrung gtam de'i nang mi sna dang sems khams zhib 'bri byed pa ha cang mang po zhig med pa dang / de ni sngon dus kyi rtsom yig 〈dga' skyo zung gi mchi ma 〉dang 〈bskur zin pa'i yi ge 〉sogs dang bsdur na mi sna dang sems khams zhib 'bri byed pa cung tsam mang ba zhig yin na yang / sgrung gtam gyi mjug bsdu ba'i tshe/mi zhig glo bur du sdod yul nas bral te song ba dang chabs cig tu sgrung gtam gyi mjug bsdus pas/ klog mkhan rnams la phangs sems dang /the tshom/ dri ba/ ha mi go ba bcas kyi snang ba zhig ster zhing / mi de 213
sngags pa la brda gtong bar song ba /yin nam/ yang na zhang gi 'go khrid kyi gtam bshad la nyan rjes rgyu mtshan shes te sngags pa la gnas tshul ci yin skor 'dri bar song ba yin nam ci/ de dag las gang zhis yin pa gtan nas mi rtogs pa yin/ de 'dra'i don gab sbas byed pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi thabs de ni glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin gyi rig gnas mdzes min la lta ba'i mtshon stangs shig yin mod/ 'on kyang mi sna gtso bo'i gzugs brnyan dang / sems khams khor yug gi khyad chos sogs zhib tu 'bri ba'i thabs kyis mdzes min la lta ba'i spro snang yod du bcug na sgyu rtsal gyi 'bras bu de'i rigs thob thub pa yin/ mi sna'i rang gshis dang / sems khams/ gnas tshul sogs zhib tu bris te don du rtsognyer ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi grub 'bras len pa las ldog na rtsom yig gi sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur brlag par nges te/ dper na 〈dga' skyo zung gi mchi ma 〉dang / 〈 bskur zin pa'i yi ge〉/ 〈rdzong mkhar dang thag ring ba'i sde'i/ 〈 kha par〉/ 〈byas nyes〉〉la sogs pa lta bu yin/ de yang rtsom mkhan gyis yid 'phreng ba'i sgyu rtsal don du gnyer ba dang /brjod bya'i don zab rgyas su gtong ba/ yid dbang 'phrog pa'i nas pa rgya bskyed pa bcas kyi ched du glo bur du 'bri mtshams bzhag ste mjug bsdus pa'i sgrung gtam spel nas klog mkhan la bsam blo gtong sa zhig bzhag pa yin las che yang / nges pa don gyi klog mkhan la rtogs thabs med pa'i phangs sems shig bzhag pa las gnas pa'i dge mtshan ci yang med par sems/214
khyung thar rgyal la'ang bod kyi rtsom pa po gzhan rnams dang 'dra bar don grub rgyal gyi rtsom yig gi shan zhugs thebs yod de/ kho'i 〈 seng ras g.yogs pa'i 'tsho ba'i lam phran 〉zhes pa de nyid don grub rgyal gyi ku sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog 〉la lad zlos byas te bris pa'i mngon rtags yod cing / rtsom mkhan gyis phun tshogs dang bde skyid lha mo'i zol med rnam dag gi 'dod brtse'i gtam rgyud brjod pa'i tshe/ choṭaṭa sgor 'jug mi rung yang chos sgor zhugs shid / 'khor ba'i zhen chags ldog med grwa pas 'jig rten 'khor bas bslu brid byed pa'i mdun sar rang tshugs ma thub par sdom pa shor zhing nang ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed par rma 'byin par byas tshul mngon par mtshon yod pa dang / sgrung thung nang gi phun tshogs kyi sems khams rags bsdus shig bris yod kyang / phun tshogs kyi sems khams zab tsha da la dpyad zhib btang nas mtshon pa zhig min par kho'i 'gyod pa dang skyo ngal brjod par brten nas kho'i re 'dun mtshon yod/ gzhan yang sgrung thung gi brjod rim bkod sgrig byed pa'i thad la'ang bsam blo yag po btang med pas rtsom mkhan gyi gsar rtsom byed pa'i dmigs yul zab mo yang zhan pa'i skyon dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / de ni phal cher rtsom mkhan gyis dus rabs kyi snying stobs dang bsam pa'i snying bcud 'bri dgos kyi/phyi'i rtsam pa'i steng nas gzhan la lad zlos byas te hom yig 'brir mi rung ba dang / rtsom yig gi brjod bya'i don 'bur du thon ma thub na rtsom gyi nang don dang 'brel ba'i sgrig gzhi'i thad nas klog mkhan rnams 215
la ngal ba'i rjor ba dang phangs sems ma gtogs ster mi thub pa yin/khyung thar rgyal gyis nye sngon gyi rtsom yig bklags pa na/ khos 64dmar po'i khrag gi snyan ngag 〉〉la brten nas sems bsam pa'i gting gi dga' sa dang skyo sa brjod bzhin mchis shing / khos kha mtshar gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i pir rtse yis bod 'bangs kyi bde sdug gi ched du bsam blo gtong ba dang / bod 'bangs kyi dar rgud kyi ched du sems khur byed pa/ bod 'bangs la dus rnam kun tu sems khrul byed pa'i 'du shes bcas mtshon pa'i tshe/ khos thog mar zur za byed pa'i thabs kyis mngon sum 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi ma rabs tha shal gyi rigs la mi dga' ba'i bsam tshul klog mkhan rnams la dngos su bstan yod de/ sgrung gtam 〈 rdzong mkhar dang thag ring ba'i sde 〉 dang / 〈 kha par〉/〈'brug rgyal gyi 'brug 〉la sogs pa'i nang du bod kyi mngon sum 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi ma rabs tha shal gyi srol lugs dang shes rmongs rjes lus sogs mdor bsdus shig mtshon nas klog mkhan rnams la thun mong gi skyo snang zhig nyams su myong du 'jug pa red/ de ni rtsom mkhan gyis rab btags kyi sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs don du gnyer ba zhig yin shas che ste/sgrung gtam 〈kha par 〉gyi nang du rtsom mkhan gyis khrims khang gi khrims dpon zhig gis sger skyong khrims 'gal gyi log lam du 'jug par ma 'dod pa'i dbang gis rim pa gong ma'i 'go 'dzin gyis nyin lnga'i rjes su 'grim 'grul stabs mi bde pa'i kung hre'i slob chung gi dge rgan du mngags tshul bris yod/ 〈rdzong mkhar dang thag ring ba'i sde 〉zhes pa'i 216
sgrung gtam gyi nang du rtsom mkhan gyis bod kyi spyi tshogs su 'brog pa'i mda' las drang ba'i gzhung rgyud dang / gangs las dkar ba'i lhag bsam/ g.yo sgyu med pa'i snying rje sogs bed spyad nas bslus tshul bris yod cing / de la bltas na mi'i yid ngal bar byed pa'i skyo ba zhig skyes na yang / zhib tu bsames na rtog bzo byas pa'i cha cung zad mang ba'i snang ba zhig ster/ ngas bltas na rtsom mkhan gyis bsam pa'i bkod pa de 'dra zhig spyad nas sgro btags pa de ni spyi tshogs kyi ma rabs tha shal gyi skyon la dgag pa rgyag pa dang / mi rnams kyi shes rmongs la skyon brjod byed pa/ kho'i sems kyi zhe sdang phyi ru mngon pa bcas kyi ched du yin pa'i khar/ sgrung gtam gyi skyo ngal gyi rang bzhin rgya cher bskyed pa dang de'i zur za'i nyams 'gyur shin tu gsal zhing 'bur du thon pa zhig tu 'gyur ba'i ched du yin las che snyam du sems/ de ni dngos yod spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i skyon cha dang bod 'bangs rang steng du gnas pa'i )skyon cha las gang dang gang zhig gis rtsom mkhan gyi dran 'dzin rlung gis btab pa'i ljon pa ltar g.yo bar byas na yang / des klog mkhan yod do cog la blang dor 'phyugs med du 'byed pa'i blo gros dang sdug yus kyi snang ba zhig ster/ dus rabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig yar ngo'i zla ltar ོdar rgyas 'gro ba'i dus su nga tshos lo na nyer drug tu son pa'i bod kyi na 217
gzhon rtsom pa po khyung thar rgyal gyis skyon spangs bzang len dang /snyigs dor bcud len/ legs nyes blang dor bcas byas te kha mtshar dang zur za'i tshig gi nyams dod nas mdzes min la blta ba'i sgyu rtsal don du gnyer ba dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan zhing /bsam blo zab mo ldan pa dang/ bsam zhib byed pa'i rang bzhin mnga' ba'i rtsom yig phul du byung ba klog pa po rnams kyi 'dren byed kyi bdud rtsi dang sgra 'dzin gyi dga' ston du spel bar re ba byed bzhin yod/218
mjug byang /nga'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du dga' zhing gces par 'os pa ni sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur stong gis legs par spud pa'i rtsom rig yin zhing /brjod bya'i don gyis phyug cing rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor snyan pa'i snyan rtsom gyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil nas 'tsho ba'i bde sdug gi gser mig 'dzin par dga' zhing spro/ sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i rtsom rig ni nga'i yid dbang gi gsos su gyur zhing / des nga la dbul bo nor la 'phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spro dang / ma bu glo bur bral ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis gtong dgos pa'i bsam gzhigs bcas ster bas/ rtsom yig gi brjod rim la bltas te rab dga'i spu long g.yo ba'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas myornga ba dang / yid la skyo bas mnan pa'i mchi ma'ang bzhur myo rnga ba'i khar/ sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i rtso ma yig rmad du byung b.re yid smone yang shor myong ba yin/ sngon gyi dus na bdag gis sgyu rtsalatshom rig don du gnyer dgos zhes blo ngor gtan nas 'char ma myong zhirnga / zus phyiso sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs su gtogs 219
pa'i rtsom rig la brtag pa'i las su zhugs pa dang / de nas bdag gi dge rgan sku zhabs ban kho lags kyis phran la rtsom rig tu dngos su 'jug par khrid ston gnang ba'i drin las rtsom rig nyags su myong ba'i skal ba ldan par gyur/ ying phangs pa zhig ni sngon dus bdag la rtsom rig skor gyi ched gnyer slob gso thob ma myong ba de yin zhing / ngas tshad yod pa'i dus tshod bed spyad nas rtsom rig la sbyangs pa dang / sku zhabs zla ba blo gros kyi drung nas thob pa'i shes bya dang rang nyid kyis dpe cha bklags pa las byung ba'i shes bya bcas la brten nas rtsom mkhan gyi sems kyi 'khyer so 'tshol ba'i dpyad rtsom 'bri ba'i las la gzhol ba las 〈dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa 〉zhes pa'i deb chung 'di klog pa po'i 'dren byed kyi dpyid du spel thub pa byung ngo / /〈 dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa 〉zhes pa 'di ni bdag gis pe cin du slob gnyer byed pa'i skabs su bris shing / dpe deb de 'bri ba'i skabs su bod kyi deng rabs kyi rtsom pa po sku zhabs rdo je mkhar la mjal ba dang /sku zhabs rdo rje mkhar gyis khrid ston gnang bar brten nas deb chung rdzogs par bris pa yin/ skabs 'dir phran gyis dge rgan chen mo rdo rje mkhar lags la snying thag pa nas thugs je che zhu ba dang / gzhan yang bdag la rogs skyor gnang ba'i mgon po bkra shis la'ang bsam pa rnam 220
dag gis thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ 4rtsom mkhan 'di dag gi snyan rtsom la dpyad pa'i rtsom yig 'bri ba'i las 'gan cu nga tsam legs po zhi ga 'grub pa'i ched du bdag gis 〈krung rtsogo'i nub yul gyi rtsom rig smra ba 〉dngo / 〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rirge 〉/ 〈 sgrungagugatam nyi shwe rtsa bzhi'i yid 'ong gi nyams 'gyur〉/〈 rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig〉 (dus deb)/ 〈rtsom rig dpyad brjod 〉(dus deb)/ 〈dpe klog 〉 (dus deb)/ 〈spyi tshogs rig pa'i byed thabs kyi tshad gzhi 〉/ 〈rig gnas kyi tshan rig〉/ 〈rig gnas dang spel res 〉bcas kyi dpe deb rtse gcig yid kyis bklags pa las sems kyi 'khyer so dang gzhung lugs thad kyi nyer mkho'i shes bya mtha' yas pa zhig rgyud la 'byor bar gyur pas/ da pe deb 'di 'bri bar blo skyed mang po zhig thob/ ngas bslabs pa'i rgya yig dang bod yig gi shes byar brten nas dpe deb 'di chad lhag ci yang med par rdzogs par bris na yang / da dung 'khrul ba'i g.yang sar 'phyan pa'i skyon ci rigs yod par gdon mi za na/ shes ldan klog pa po rnams kyis skyon bsal dag 'bud kyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu/ nga'i yid du krung dbyang mi rigs slob chen gyi dge rgan chen mo la'e khron kyang gi drung nas deng rabs rtsom rig gi slob khrid dang / mi rigs kyi rig pa/ 'gro 221
ba mi'i rig pa bcas kyi zhib 'jug slob ma'i slob khrid mtha' dag la rdzogs par nyan rjes/ bdag gis rtsom rig dang 'gro ba mi'i rig pa'i khyab khongs nas bod kyi rtsom rig la slar yang lta zhib bam bsam gzhigs byed phyogs dang gzhung lugs gsar pa rnyed srid pa dang / de dus dpe deb 'di sngar las kyang cha tshang zhing rna bar snyan pa zhig tu bzo bcos byed rgyu yin no/ /skabs 'dir bdag la rogs ram mi dman pa gnang ba'i sku rnazhabs dang las grogs rnams la yang bskyar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o/ /pad+ma 'tsho yis 1998lo'i zla 5par pe cin nas bris/
